                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
                data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
                id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`O`,
                `key`, `value`).

            Recall that if `member` has a
            <a href="#dfn-dictionary-member-default-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-dictionary-member-default-value①②"
            data-link-type="dfn">default value</a>, then `key` will
            always <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
            id="ref-for-map-exists②" data-link-type="dfn">exist</a> in
            `V`.

4.  Return `O`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.18. </span><span id="es-enumeration" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Enumeration types</span><a href="#js-enumeration" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#idl-enumeration" id="ref-for-idl-enumeration①"
data-link-type="dfn">enumeration types</a> are represented by JavaScript
String values.

<div id="js-to-enumeration" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to enumeration">

<span id="es-to-enumeration"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value②⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#dfn-enumeration" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">enumeration type</a> value as follows (where `E` is
the <a href="#dfn-enumeration" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">enumeration</a>):

1.  Let `S` be the result of calling
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-tostring"
    id="ref-for-sec-tostring④" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToString</a>(`V`).

2.  If `S` is not one of `E`’s
    <a href="#dfn-enumeration-value" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration-value④"
    data-link-type="dfn">enumeration values</a>, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①①"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

3.  Return the enumeration value of type `E` that is equal to `S`.

</div>

<span id="enumeration-to-es"></span> The result of
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value②⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> an IDL
<a href="#dfn-enumeration" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">enumeration type</a> value to a JavaScript value is
the String value that represents the same sequence of
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-unit"
id="ref-for-code-unit④" data-link-type="dfn">code units</a> as the
<a href="#dfn-enumeration-value" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration-value⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">enumeration value</a>.

#### <span class="secno">3.2.19. </span><span id="es-callback-function" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Callback function types</span><a href="#js-callback-function" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#idl-callback-function" id="ref-for-idl-callback-function⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">callback function types</a> are represented by
JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object⑧" data-link-type="dfn">function objects</a>,
except in the \[<a href="#LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull"
id="ref-for-LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull③" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull</code></a>\] case, when they can
be any object.

<div id="js-to-callback-function" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to callback function">

<span id="es-to-callback-function"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value②⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-callback-function" id="ref-for-idl-callback-function①"
data-link-type="dfn">callback function type</a> value by running the
following algorithm:

1.  If the result of calling <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iscallable"
    id="ref-for-sec-iscallable②" data-link-type="abstract-op">IsCallable</a>(`V`)
    is false and the conversion to an IDL value is not being performed
    due to `V` being assigned to an
    <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute③⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> whose type is a
    <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable</a>
    <a href="#dfn-callback-function" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-function②③"
    data-link-type="dfn">callback function</a> that is annotated with
    \[<a href="#LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull"
    id="ref-for-LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull④" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull</code></a>\], then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①②"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

2.  Return the IDL
    <a href="#idl-callback-function" id="ref-for-idl-callback-function②"
    data-link-type="dfn">callback function type</a> value that
    represents a reference to the same object that `V` represents, with
    the <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#incumbent-settings-object"
    id="ref-for-incumbent-settings-object③" data-link-type="dfn">incumbent
    settings object</a> as the
    <a href="#dfn-callback-context" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-context⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">callback context</a>.

</div>

<span id="callback-function-to-es"></span> The result of
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value②⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> an IDL
<a href="#idl-callback-function" id="ref-for-idl-callback-function③"
data-link-type="dfn">callback function type</a> value to a JavaScript
value is a reference to the same object that the IDL
<a href="#idl-callback-function" id="ref-for-idl-callback-function④"
data-link-type="dfn">callback function type</a> value represents.

#### <span class="secno">3.2.20. </span><span id="es-nullable-type" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Nullable types — `T`?</span><a href="#js-nullable-type" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②①"
data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> values are represented by values
of either the JavaScript type corresponding to the
<a href="#dfn-inner-type" id="ref-for-dfn-inner-type①②"
data-link-type="dfn">inner IDL type</a>, or the JavaScript null value.

<div id="js-to-nullable" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to nullable">

<span id="es-to-nullable"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value②⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②②"
data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> `T``?` value (where `T` is the
<a href="#dfn-inner-type" id="ref-for-dfn-inner-type①③"
data-link-type="dfn">inner type</a>) as follows:

1.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type④" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>, and the conversion
    to an IDL value is being performed due to `V` being assigned to an
    <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute④⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> whose type is a
    <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②③"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable</a>
    <a href="#dfn-callback-function" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-function②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">callback function</a> that is annotated with
    \[<a href="#LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull"
    id="ref-for-LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">LegacyTreatNonObjectAsNull</code></a>\], then return the
    IDL <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> `T``?` value null.

2.  Otherwise, if `V` is undefined, and `T`
    <a href="#dfn-includes-undefined" id="ref-for-dfn-includes-undefined③"
    data-link-type="dfn">includes undefined</a>, return the unique
    <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined⑨"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a> value.

3.  Otherwise, if `V` is null or undefined, then return the IDL
    <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> `T``?` value null.

4.  Otherwise, return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` using the rules for the
    <a href="#dfn-inner-type" id="ref-for-dfn-inner-type①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">inner IDL type</a> `T`.

</div>

<div id="nullable-to-js" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a nullable to a JavaScript value">

<span id="nullable-to-es"></span>

The result of <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value②⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> an IDL
<a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> value to a JavaScript value is:

1.  If the IDL
    <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> `T``?` value is null, then
    the JavaScript value is null.

2.  Otherwise, the JavaScript value is the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> the IDL
    <a href="#dfn-nullable-type" id="ref-for-dfn-nullable-type②⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">nullable type</a> value to the
    <a href="#dfn-inner-type" id="ref-for-dfn-inner-type①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">inner IDL type</a> `T`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.21. </span><span id="es-sequence" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Sequences — sequence\<`T`\></span><a href="#js-sequence" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①③"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> values are
represented by JavaScript Array values.

<div id="js-to-sequence" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to sequence">

<span id="es-to-sequence"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①④"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> value as follows:

1.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>,
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①③"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①③"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

2.  Let `method` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②①" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
    id="ref-for-sec-getmethod" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`V`,
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
    id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①⓪" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>).

3.  If `method` is undefined,
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①④"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

4.  Return the result of <a href="#create-sequence-from-iterable"
    id="ref-for-create-sequence-from-iterable" data-link-type="dfn">creating
    a sequence</a> from `V` and `method`.

</div>

<div id="sequence-to-js" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a sequence to a JavaScript value">

<span id="sequence-to-es"></span>

An IDL sequence value `S` of type
<a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> is
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to a JavaScript Array object as
follows:

1.  Let `n` be the length of `S`.

2.  Let `A` be a new Array object created as if by the expression `[]`.

3.  Initialize `i` to be 0.

4.  While `i` \< `n`:

    1.  Let `V` be the value in `S` at index `i`.

    2.  Let `E` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③①"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to a JavaScript value.

    3.  Let `P` be the result of calling
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②②" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-tostring"
        id="ref-for-sec-tostring⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToString</a>(`i`).

    4.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②③" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`A`,
        `P`, `E`).

    5.  Set `i` to `i` + 1.

5.  Return `A`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.2.21.1. </span><span class="content">Creating a sequence from an iterable</span><a href="#create-sequence-from-iterable"
id="ref-for-create-sequence-from-iterable④" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create sequence from iterable">

To create an IDL value of type
<a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> given an iterable
`iterable` and an iterator getter `method`, perform the following steps:

1.  Let `iteratorRecord` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getiteratorfrommethod"
    id="ref-for-sec-getiteratorfrommethod"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">GetIteratorFromMethod</a>(`iterable`,
    `method`).

2.  Initialize `i` to be 0.

3.  Repeat

    1.  Let `next` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iteratorstepvalue"
        id="ref-for-sec-iteratorstepvalue"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">IteratorStepValue</a>(`iteratorRecord`).

    2.  If `next` is done, then return an IDL sequence value of type
        <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> of length
        `i`, where the value of the element at index `j` is
        `S`<sub>`j`</sub>.

    3.  Initialize `S`<sub>`i`</sub> to the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③①"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `next` to an IDL value of
        type `T`.

    4.  Set `i` to `i` + 1.

</div>

<div id="example-8d9e263c" class="example">

<a href="#example-8d9e263c" class="self-link"></a>

The following <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①①①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> defines an
<a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute④①"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> of a sequence type as well as an
<a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> with an argument of a sequence type.

``` highlight
[Exposed=Window]
interface Canvas {

  sequence<DOMString> getSupportedImageCodecs();

  undefined drawPolygon(sequence<double> coordinates);
  sequence<double> getLastDrawnPolygon();

  // ...
};
```

In a JavaScript implementation of this interface, an Array object with
elements of type String is used to represent a `sequence<DOMString>`,
while an Array with elements of type Number represents a
`sequence<double>`. The Array objects are effectively passed by value;
every time the `getSupportedImageCodecs()` function is called a new
Array is returned, and whenever an Array is passed to `drawPolygon` no
reference will be kept after the call completes.

``` highlight
// Obtain an instance of Canvas.  Assume that getSupportedImageCodecs()
// returns a sequence with two DOMString values: "image/png" and "image/svg+xml".
var canvas = getCanvas();

// An Array object of length 2.
var supportedImageCodecs = canvas.getSupportedImageCodecs();

// Evaluates to "image/png".
supportedImageCodecs[0];

// Each time canvas.getSupportedImageCodecs() is called, it returns a
// new Array object.  Thus modifying the returned Array will not
// affect the value returned from a subsequent call to the function.
supportedImageCodecs[0] = "image/jpeg";

// Evaluates to "image/png".
canvas.getSupportedImageCodecs()[0];

// This evaluates to false, since a new Array object is returned each call.
canvas.getSupportedImageCodecs() == canvas.getSupportedImageCodecs();

// An Array of Numbers...
var a = [0, 0, 100, 0, 50, 62.5];

// ...can be passed to a platform object expecting a sequence<double>.
canvas.drawPolygon(a);

// Each element will be converted to a double by first calling ToNumber().
// So the following call is equivalent to the previous one, except that
// "hi" will be alerted before drawPolygon() returns.
a = [false, "",
     { valueOf: function() { alert("hi"); return 100; } }, 0,
     "50", new Number(62.5)];
canvas.drawPolygon(a);

// Modifying an Array that was passed to drawPolygon() is guaranteed not to
// have an effect on the Canvas, since the Array is effectively passed by value.
a[4] = 20;
var b = canvas.getLastDrawnPolygon();
alert(b[4]);    // This would alert "50".
```

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.22. </span><span class="content">Async sequences — async_sequence\<`T`\></span><a href="#js-async-iterable" class="self-link"></a>

In the JavaScript binding, IDL
<a href="#async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-async-sequence-type②"
data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> values are represented by a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct" id="ref-for-struct①"
data-link-type="dfn">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="ref-for-struct-item④" data-link-type="dfn">items</a>:

- <span id="js-async-sequence-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="JS async sequence" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">object</span>,
  a JavaScript value

- <span id="js-async-sequence-method" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="JS async sequence" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">method</span>,
  a JavaScript value

- <span id="js-async-sequence-type" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="JS async sequence" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">type</span>,
  either "`sync`" or "`async`"

<div id="js-to-async-iterable" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to async sequence">

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③②"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">async_sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> value as
follows:

1.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type⑥" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

2.  Let `method` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
    id="ref-for-sec-getmethod①" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(obj,
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
    id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①①" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a>).

3.  If `method` is undefined:

    1.  Set `syncMethod` to
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
        id="ref-for-sec-getmethod②" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(obj,
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①②" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>).

    2.  If `syncMethod` is undefined,
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①⑥"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    3.  Return an IDL
        <a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type①"
        data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> value with
        <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
        id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>
        set to `V`, <a href="#js-async-sequence-method"
        id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-method" data-link-type="dfn">method</a>
        set to `syncMethod`, and
        <a href="#js-async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-type"
        data-link-type="dfn">type</a> set to "`sync`".

4.  Return an IDL
    <a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type②"
    data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> value with
    <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
    id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object①" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>
    set to `V`, <a href="#js-async-sequence-method"
    id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-method①" data-link-type="dfn">method</a>
    set to `method`, and
    <a href="#js-async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-type①"
    data-link-type="dfn">type</a> set to "`async`".

</div>

<div id="async-sequence-to-js" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert an async sequence to a JavaScript value">

An IDL
<a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type③"
data-link-type="dfn">async_sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> value `V` is
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③②"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to a JavaScript object as follows:

1.  Return `V`’s <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
    id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object②" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.2.22.1. </span><span class="content">Iterating async sequences</span><a href="#js-async-sequence-iteration" class="self-link"></a>

An
<a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type④"
data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> is not directly iterated over.
Instead, it is first opened to create an
<a href="#async-iterator" id="ref-for-async-iterator"
data-link-type="dfn">async iterator</a>. The
<a href="#async-iterator" id="ref-for-async-iterator①"
data-link-type="dfn">async iterator</a> can be asynchronously iterated
over to produce values.

<span id="async-iterator" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="" lt="async iterator">Async iterators</span> are
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct" id="ref-for-struct②"
data-link-type="dfn">structs</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="ref-for-struct-item⑤" data-link-type="dfn">items</a>:

- <span id="js-async-iterator-underlying-record" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="JS async iterator" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">underlying
  record</span>, an
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-iterator-records"
  id="ref-for-sec-iterator-records" data-link-type="dfn">Iterator
  Record</a>

- <span id="js-async-iterator-type-parameter" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="JS async iterator" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">type
  parameter</span>, an IDL type representing the type of values produced
  by the async iterator

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="open an async sequence">

To <span id="async-sequence-open" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="" lt="open an async sequence">open</span> an
<a href="#async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-async-sequence-type③"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>async_sequence&lt;</code><var>T</var><code>&gt;</code></a>
`sequence`:

1.  Let `iterator` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getiteratorfrommethod"
    id="ref-for-sec-getiteratorfrommethod①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">GetIteratorFromMethod</a>(`sequence`’s
    <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
    id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object③" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>,
    `sequence`’s <a href="#js-async-sequence-method"
    id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-method②" data-link-type="dfn">method</a>).

2.  If `sequence`’s
    <a href="#js-async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-type②"
    data-link-type="dfn">type</a> is "`sync`", set `iterator` to
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-createasyncfromsynciterator"
    id="ref-for-sec-createasyncfromsynciterator"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateAsyncFromSyncIterator</a>(`iterator`).

3.  Return an <a href="#async-iterator" id="ref-for-async-iterator②"
    data-link-type="dfn">async iterator</a> value with
    <a href="#js-async-iterator-underlying-record"
    id="ref-for-js-async-iterator-underlying-record"
    data-link-type="dfn">underlying record</a> set to `iterator` and
    <a href="#js-async-iterator-type-parameter"
    id="ref-for-js-async-iterator-type-parameter" data-link-type="dfn">type
    parameter</a> set to `T`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="get an async iterator next value">

To <span id="async-iterator-get-next-value" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="" lt="get an async iterator next value">get the
next value</span> of an
<a href="#async-iterator" id="ref-for-async-iterator③"
data-link-type="dfn">async iterator</a> `iterator`:

1.  Let `nextResult` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iteratornext"
    id="ref-for-sec-iteratornext"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IteratorNext</a>(`iterator`’s
    <a href="#js-async-iterator-underlying-record"
    id="ref-for-js-async-iterator-underlying-record①"
    data-link-type="dfn">underlying record</a>).

2.  If `nextResult` is an <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    data-link-type="dfn">abrupt completion</a>, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a>
    `nextResult`.\[\[Value\]\].

3.  Let `nextPromise` be
    <a href="#a-promise-resolved-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-resolved-with"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise resolved with</a>
    `nextResult`.\[\[Value\]\].

4.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    data-link-type="dfn">reacting</a> to `nextPromise` with the
    following fulfillment steps, given `iterResult`:

    1.  If `iterResult`
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
        id="ref-for-sec-object-type⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>,
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①⑦"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  Let `done` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands②⑨" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iteratorcomplete"
        id="ref-for-sec-iteratorcomplete"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">IteratorComplete</a>(`iterResult`).

    3.  If `done` is true:

        1.  Return
            <a href="#end-of-iteration" id="ref-for-end-of-iteration①"
            data-link-type="dfn">end of iteration</a>.

    4.  Otherwise:

        1.  Let `V` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iteratorvalue"
            id="ref-for-sec-iteratorvalue"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">IteratorValue</a>(`iterResult`).

        2.  Let `value` be the result of
            <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③③"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value of
            type `iterator`’s
            <a href="#js-async-iterator-type-parameter"
            id="ref-for-js-async-iterator-type-parameter①" data-link-type="dfn">type
            parameter</a>.

        3.  Return `value`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="close an async iterator">

To <span id="async-iterator-close" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="" lt="close an async iterator">close</span> an
<a href="#async-iterator" id="ref-for-async-iterator④"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>async iterator&lt;</code><var>T</var><code>&gt;</code></a>
`iterator`, with an ECMAScript value `reason`:

1.  Let `iteratorRecord` be `iterator`’s
    <a href="#js-async-iterator-underlying-record"
    id="ref-for-js-async-iterator-underlying-record②"
    data-link-type="dfn">underlying record</a>.

2.  Let `iteratorObj` be `iteratorRecord`.\[\[Iterator\]\].

3.  Let `returnMethod` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
    id="ref-for-sec-getmethod③" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`iteratorObj`,
    "`return`").

4.  If `returnMethod` is an <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-completion-record-specification-type①"
    data-link-type="dfn">abrupt completion</a>, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with①"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a>
    `returnMethod`.\[\[Value\]\].

5.  If `returnMethod` is undefined, return
    <a href="#a-promise-resolved-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-resolved-with①"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise resolved with</a>
    <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>.

6.  Let `returnResult` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`returnMethod`.\[\[Value\]\],
    `iteratorObj`, « `reason` »).

7.  If `returnResult` is an <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-completion-record-specification-type②"
    data-link-type="dfn">abrupt completion</a>, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with②"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a>
    `returnResult`.\[\[Value\]\].

8.  Let `returnPromise` be
    <a href="#a-promise-resolved-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-resolved-with②"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise resolved with</a>
    `returnResult`.\[\[Value\]\].

9.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled①"
    data-link-type="dfn">reacting</a> to `returnPromise` with the
    following fulfillment steps, given `returnPromiseResult`:

    1.  If `returnPromiseResult`
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
        id="ref-for-sec-object-type⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>,
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  Return <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①①"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>.

</div>

<div id="example-js-async-sequence" class="example">

<a href="#example-js-async-sequence" class="self-link"></a>

`concatN` is an <a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation③⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> that returns a promise that will be
fulfilled with the concatenation of all the strings yielded by the async
sequence passed to it. It stops concatenating and closes the iterator
once the async sequence has yielded `maxN` strings.

    interface I {
      Promise<DOMString> concatN(async_sequence<DOMString> strings, unsigned long maxN);
    };

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="concatN">

The `concatN(``sequence``, ``maxN``)` method steps are:

1.  Let `promise` be <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a>.

2.  Let `result` be the empty string.

3.  Let `n` be 0.

4.  Let `iterator` be the result of
    <a href="#async-sequence-open" id="ref-for-async-sequence-open"
    data-link-type="dfn">opening</a> `sequence`.

5.  Let `step` be a sequence of steps that will be used to process the
    async sequence:

    1.  Let `next` be the result of
        <a href="#async-iterator-get-next-value"
        id="ref-for-async-iterator-get-next-value" data-link-type="dfn">getting
        the next value</a> of `iterator`.

    2.  <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
        id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled②"
        data-link-type="dfn">React</a> to `next`:

        - If `next` was fulfilled with value `v`:

          1.  If `v` is
              <a href="#end-of-iteration" id="ref-for-end-of-iteration②"
              data-link-type="dfn">end of iteration</a>,
              <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve" data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a>
              `promise` with `result`.

          2.  Set `result` to the result of concatenating `result` and
              `v`.

          3.  Set `n` to `n` + 1.

          4.  If `n` is `maxN`, then:

              1.  Let `finish` be the result of
                  <a href="#async-iterator-close" id="ref-for-async-iterator-close"
                  data-link-type="dfn">closing</a> `iterator` with
                  reason
                  <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①②"
                  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>.

              2.  <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
                  id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled③"
                  data-link-type="dfn">React</a> to `finish`:

                  - If `finish` was fulfilled,
                    <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve①"
                    data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `promise` with
                    `result`.

                  - If `finish` was rejected with reason `r`,
                    <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject②" data-link-type="dfn">reject</a>
                    `promise` with `r`.

          5.  Otherwise:

              1.  Call `step`.

        - If `next` was rejected with reason `r`,
          <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject③" data-link-type="dfn">reject</a>
          `promise` with `r`.

6.  Call `step`.

7.  Return `promise`.

</div>

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.23. </span><span id="es-record" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Records — record\<`K`, `V`\></span><a href="#js-record" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record②"
data-link-type="dfn">record</a>\<`K`, `V`\> values are represented by
JavaScript Object values.

<div id="js-to-record" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to record">

<span id="es-to-record"></span>

A JavaScript value `O` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③④"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record③"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<``K``, ``V``>` value as
follows:

1.  If `O` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>,
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw①⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror①⑨"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

2.  Let `result` be a new empty instance of
    <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record④"
    data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<``K``, ``V``>`.

3.  Let `keys` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③①" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    `O`.\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]().

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate⑦" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `key`
    of `keys`:

    1.  Let `desc` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③②" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
        `O`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](`key`).

    2.  If `desc` is not undefined and `desc`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] is
        true:

        1.  Let `typedKey` be `key`
            <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">converted to an IDL value</a> of type
            `K`.

        2.  Let `value` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-get-o-p"
            id="ref-for-sec-get-o-p①" data-link-type="abstract-op">Get</a>(`O`,
            `key`).

        3.  Let `typedValue` be `value`
            <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">converted to an IDL value</a> of type
            `V`.

        4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set" id="ref-for-map-set②"
            data-link-type="dfn">Set</a> `result`\[`typedKey`\] to
            `typedValue`.

            <span class="marker">Note:</span> It’s possible that
            `typedKey` is already in `result`, if `K` is
            <a href="#idl-USVString" id="ref-for-idl-USVString①③"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">USVString</code></a>
            and `key` contains unpaired surrogates.

5.  Return `result`.

</div>

<div id="record-to-js" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a record to a JavaScript value">

<span id="record-to-es"></span>

An IDL <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record⑤"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<…>` value `D` is
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③③"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to a JavaScript value as follows:

1.  Let `result` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object③"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Object.prototype%</code></a>).

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-iterate"
    id="ref-for-map-iterate" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `key` →
    `value` of `D`:

    1.  Let `jsKey` be `key`
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③④"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    2.  Let `jsValue` be `value`
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    3.  Let `created` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③④" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdataproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdataproperty"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataProperty</a>(`result`,
        `jsKey`, `jsValue`).

    4.  Assert: `created` is true.

3.  Return `result`.

</div>

<div id="example-js-record" class="example">

<a href="#example-js-record" class="self-link"></a>
<span id="example-es-record"></span>

Passing the JavaScript value `{b: 3, a: 4}` as a
<a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record⑥"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<DOMString, double>`
argument would result in the IDL value «\[ "`b`" → 3, "`a`" → 4 \]».

Records only consider
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-own-property"
id="ref-for-sec-own-property" data-link-type="dfn">own</a>
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-attributes"
id="ref-for-sec-property-attributes" data-link-type="dfn">enumerable</a>
properties, so given an IDL operation
`record<DOMString, double> identity(record<DOMString, double> arg)`
which returns its argument, the following code passes its assertions:

``` highlight
let proto = {a: 3, b: 4};
let obj = {__proto__: proto, d: 5, c: 6}
Object.defineProperty(obj, "e", {value: 7, enumerable: false});
let result = identity(obj);
console.assert(result.a === undefined);
console.assert(result.b === undefined);
console.assert(result.e === undefined);
let entries = Object.entries(result);
console.assert(entries[0][0] === "d");
console.assert(entries[0][1] === 5);
console.assert(entries[1][0] === "c");
console.assert(entries[1][1] === 6);
```

Record keys and values can be constrained, although keys can only be
constrained among the three string types. The following conversions have
the described results:

| Value | Passed to type | Result |
|----|----|----|
| `{"😞": 1}` | <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record⑦"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<ByteString, double>` | <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror⑦"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> |
| `{"\uD83D": 1}` | <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record⑧"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<USVString, double>` | «\[ "`\uFFFD`" → 1 \]» |
| `{"\uD83D": {hello: "world"}}` | <a href="#idl-record" id="ref-for-idl-record⑨"
data-link-type="dfn"><code>record</code></a>`<DOMString, double>` | «\[ "`\uD83D`" → 0 \]» |

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.24. </span><span id="es-promise" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Promise types — Promise\<`T`\></span><a href="#js-promise" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a> values are represented by
JavaScript
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-promisecapability-records"
id="ref-for-sec-promisecapability-records"
data-link-type="dfn">PromiseCapability</a> records.

<div id="js-to-promise" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to promise">

<span id="es-to-promise"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise②" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` value as
follows:

1.  Let `promiseCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

2.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call①" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`promiseCapability`.\[\[Resolve\]\],
    undefined, « `V` »).

3.  Return `promiseCapability`.

</div>

<span id="promise-to-es"></span> The result of
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> an IDL
<a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a> value to a JavaScript value is the
value of the \[\[Promise\]\] field of the record that IDL
<a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a> represents.

<div class="note" role="note">

When converting a JS value to a `Promise<T>` IDL value, first the value
is wrapped in an (IDL) Promise, then later machinery ensures the promise
correctly resolves to a value of type `T`.

This means that, for example, a method defined to take a `Promise<T>`
argument will automatically accept both
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Promise</code></a> objects (which
must eventually resolve to a `T` object) and `T` objects themselves.

(It will also, initially, accept *any other* type of object, but will
eventually auto-reject the promise for resolving to the wrong type.)

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.2.24.1. </span><span id="es-promise-manipulation" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Creating and manipulating Promises</span><a href="#js-promise-manipulation" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="a new promise">

To <span id="a-new-promise" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="" lt="a new promise">create</span> a new
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise④" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm⑧" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `constructor` be `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor①" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>\]\].

2.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(`constructor`).

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="a promise resolved with">

To create a <span id="a-promise-resolved-with" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="" lt="a promise resolved with">resolved
promise</span> of type
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise⑤" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>`, with `x`
(a value of type `T`) in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm⑨" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `value` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `x` to a JavaScript value.

2.  Let `constructor` be `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor②" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>\]\].

3.  Let `promiseCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(`constructor`).

4.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands③⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call②" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`promiseCapability`.\[\[Resolve\]\],
    undefined, « `value` »).

5.  Return `promiseCapability`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="a promise rejected with">

To create a <span id="a-promise-rejected-with" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="" lt="a promise rejected with">rejected
promise</span> of type
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise⑥" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>`, with
reason `r` (a JavaScript value) in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `constructor` be `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor③" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>\]\].

2.  Let `promiseCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability③"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(`constructor`).

3.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④①" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call③" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`promiseCapability`.\[\[Reject\]\],
    undefined, « `r` »).

4.  Return `promiseCapability`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="resolve">

To <span id="resolve" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="">resolve</span> a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise⑦" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `p` with
`x` (a value of type `T`), perform the following steps:

1.  If `x` is not given, then let it be the
    <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①③"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a> value.

2.  Let `value` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `x` to a JavaScript value.

3.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④②" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call④" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`p`.\[\[Resolve\]\],
    undefined, « `value` »).

If `T` is <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①④"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>, then the
`x` argument is optional, allowing a simpler
"<a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve②"
data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> p" usage.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="reject">

To <span id="reject" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="">reject</span> a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise⑧" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `p` with
reason `r` (a JavaScript value), perform the following steps:

1.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④③" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
    id="ref-for-sec-call⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`p`.\[\[Reject\]\],
    undefined, « `r` »).

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="react" algorithm-for="promise">

To <span id="dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="promise" dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="react|reacting">react</span> to a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise⑨" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `promise`,
given one or two sets of steps to perform, covering when the promise is
fulfilled, rejected, or both, perform the following steps:

1.  Let `onFulfilledSteps` be the following steps given argument `V`:

    1.  Let `value` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value of type
        `T`.

    2.  If there is a set of steps to be run if the promise was
        fulfilled, then let `result` be the result of performing them,
        given `value` if `T` is not
        <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①⑤"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>.
        Otherwise, let `result` be `value`.

    3.  Return `result`, <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value③⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

2.  Let `onFulfilled` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`onFulfilledSteps`,
    1, "", « »):

3.  Let `onRejectedSteps` be the following steps given argument `R`:

    1.  Let `reason` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value③⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `R` to an IDL value of type
        <a href="#idl-any" id="ref-for-idl-any①③" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">any</code></a>.

    2.  If there is a set of steps to be run if the promise was
        rejected, then let `result` be the result of performing them,
        given `reason`. Otherwise, let `result` be
        <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with③"
        data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> `reason`.

    3.  Return `result`, <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

4.  Let `onRejected` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`onRejectedSteps`,
    1, "", « »):

5.  Let `constructor` be
    `promise`.\[\[Promise\]\].\[\[Realm\]\].\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor④" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>\]\].

6.  Let `newCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability④"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(`constructor`).

    <span class="marker">Note:</span> Not all callers will use the
    returned <a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Promise</code></a>.
    Implementations might wish to avoid creating `newCapability` in
    those cases.

7.  Perform <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
    id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`promise`.\[\[Promise\]\],
    `onFulfilled`, `onRejected`, `newCapability`).

8.  Return `newCapability`.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> This algorithm will behave in a very
similar way to the
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-promise.prototype.then"
id="ref-for-sec-promise.prototype.then" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">promise.then()</code></a> method. In particular, if the
steps return a value of type `U` or
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①①" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``U``>`, this
algorithm returns a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①②" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``U``>` as well.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="upon fulfillment">

To perform some steps <span id="upon-fulfillment"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">upon fulfillment</span>
of a <a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①③" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `promise`
given some steps `steps` taking a value of type `T`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled④"
    data-link-type="dfn">reacting</a> to `promise`:

    - If `promise` was fulfilled with value `v`, then:

      1.  Perform `steps` with `v`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="upon rejection">

To perform some steps <span id="upon-rejection" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">upon rejection</span> of a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①④" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `promise`
given some steps `steps` taking a JavaScript value, perform the
following steps:

1.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">reacting</a> to `promise`:

    - If `promise` was rejected with reason `r`, then:

      1.  Perform `steps` with `r`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="wait for all">

To <span id="wait-for-all" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export="" lt="wait for all|waiting for all">wait for all</span> with a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⑤" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` values
`promises`, with success steps `successSteps` that take a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①①"
data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of `T` values and failure steps
`failureSteps` that take a rejection reason
<a href="#idl-any" id="ref-for-idl-any①④" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">any</code></a> value, perform the following steps:

1.  Let `fullfilledCount` be 0.

2.  Let `rejected` be false.

3.  Let `rejectionHandlerSteps` be the following steps given `arg`:

    1.  If `rejected` is true, abort these steps.

    2.  Set `rejected` to true.

    3.  Perform `failureSteps` given `arg`.

4.  Let `rejectionHandler` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`rejectionHandlerSteps`,
    1, "", « »):

5.  Let `total` be `promises`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="ref-for-list-size③" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>.

6.  If `total` is 0, then:

    1.  <a
        href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-microtask"
        id="ref-for-queue-a-microtask" data-link-type="dfn">Queue a
        microtask</a> to perform `successSteps` given « ».

    2.  Return.

7.  Let `index` be 0.

8.  Let `result` be a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> containing `total` null values.

9.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate⑧" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
    `promise` of `promises`:

    1.  Let `promiseIndex` be `index`.

    2.  Let `fulfillmentHandler` be the following steps given `arg`:

        1.  Set `result`\[`promiseIndex`\] to `arg`.

        2.  Set `fullfilledCount` to `fullfilledCount` + 1.

        3.  If `fullfilledCount` equals `total`, then perform
            `successSteps` given `result`.

    3.  Let `fulfillmentHandler` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`fulfillmentHandler`,
        1, "", « »):

    4.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
        id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen①"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`promise`,
        `fulfillmentHandler`, `rejectionHandler`).

    5.  Set `index` to `index` + 1.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="get a promise to wait for all">

To <span id="waiting-for-all-promise" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="get a promise to wait for all|getting a promise to wait for all">get
a promise for waiting for all</span> with a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①③"
data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⑥" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` values
`promises` and a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①①" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `promise` be
    <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise①"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a> of type
    <a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⑦" class="idl-code"
    data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<`<a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn"><code>sequence</code></a>`<``T``>>` in `realm`.

2.  Let `successSteps` be the following steps, given `results`:

    1.  <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve③"
        data-link-type="dfn">Resolve</a> `promise` with `results`.

3.  Let `failureSteps` be the following steps, given `reason`:

    1.  <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject④" data-link-type="dfn">Reject</a>
        `promise` with `reason`.

4.  <a href="#wait-for-all" id="ref-for-wait-for-all"
    data-link-type="dfn">Wait for all</a> with `promises`, given
    `successSteps` and `failureSteps`.

5.  Return `promise`.

This definition is useful when you wish to aggregate the results of
multiple promises, and then produce another promise from them, in the
same way that <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise.all"
id="ref-for-sec-promise.all" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Promise.all()</code></a> functions for JavaScript code. If
you do not need to produce another promise, then
<a href="#wait-for-all" id="ref-for-wait-for-all①"
data-link-type="dfn">waiting for all</a> is likely better.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="mark a promise as handled">

To <span id="mark-a-promise-as-handled" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="mark a promise as handled|mark as handled">mark as handled</span> a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⑧" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<``T``>` `promise`,
set `promise`.\[\[Promise\]\].\[\[PromiseIsHandled\]\] to true.

This definition is useful for promises for which you expect rejections
to often be ignored; it ensures such promises do not cause <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/indices.html#event-unhandledrejection"
id="ref-for-event-unhandledrejection" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">unhandledrejection</code></a> events. The most common use
case is for promise properties, which the web developer might or might
not consult. An example is the
<a href="https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#default-writer-closed"
id="ref-for-default-writer-closed" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">writableStreamWriter.closed</code></a> promise.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.2.24.2. </span><span id="es-promise-examples" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Examples</span><a href="#js-promise-examples" class="self-link"></a>

<div id="promise-example-delay" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-delay" class="self-link"></a>

`delay` is an <a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation③⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> that returns a promise that will be
fulfilled in a number of milliseconds. It illustrates how simply you can
resolve a promise, with one line of prose.

``` highlight
interface I {
  Promise<undefined> delay(unrestricted double ms);
};
```

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="delay">

The `delay(``ms``)` method steps are:

1.  Let `realm` be
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②④" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>’s
    <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ref-for-concept-relevant-realm①" data-link-type="dfn">relevant
    realm</a>.

2.  Let `taskSource` be some appropriate <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#task-source"
    id="ref-for-task-source" data-link-type="dfn">task source</a>.

3.  If `ms` is NaN, let `ms` be +0; otherwise let `ms` be the maximum of
    `ms` and +0.

4.  Let `p` be <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise②"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a> in `realm`.

5.  Run the following steps <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
    id="ref-for-in-parallel" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

    1.  Wait `ms` milliseconds.

    2.  <a
        href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
        id="ref-for-queue-a-task" data-link-type="dfn">Queue a task</a>
        on `taskSource` to <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve④"
        data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `p`.

6.  Return `p`.

</div>

</div>

<div id="promise-example-validatedDelay" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-validatedDelay" class="self-link"></a>

The `validatedDelay`
<a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation③⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> is much like [the `delay`
function](#promise-example-delay), except it will validate its
arguments. This shows how to use rejected promises to signal immediate
failure before even starting any asynchronous operations.

``` highlight
interface I {
  Promise<undefined> validatedDelay(unrestricted double ms);
};
```

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="validatedDelay">

The `validatedDelay(``ms``)` method steps are:

1.  Let `realm` be
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②⑤" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>’s
    <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ref-for-concept-relevant-realm②" data-link-type="dfn">relevant
    realm</a>.

2.  Let `taskSource` be some appropriate <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#task-source"
    id="ref-for-task-source①" data-link-type="dfn">task source</a>.

3.  If `ms` is NaN, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with④"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> a
    <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror⑧"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> in
    `realm`.

4.  If `ms` \< 0, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> a
    <a href="#exceptiondef-rangeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-rangeerror④"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">RangeError</code></a> in
    `realm`.

5.  Let `p` be <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise③"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a> in `realm`.

6.  Run the following steps <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
    id="ref-for-in-parallel①" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

    1.  Wait `ms` milliseconds.

    2.  <a
        href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
        id="ref-for-queue-a-task①" data-link-type="dfn">Queue a task</a>
        on `taskSource` to <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `p`.

7.  Return `p`.

</div>

</div>

<div id="promise-example-addDelay" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-addDelay" class="self-link"></a>

`addDelay` is an <a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> that adds an extra number of
milliseconds of delay between `promise` settling and the returned
promise settling.

``` highlight
interface I {
  Promise<any> addDelay(Promise<any> promise, unrestricted double ms);
};
```

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="addDelay">

The `addDelay(``ms``, ``promise``)` method steps are:

1.  Let `realm` be
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②⑥" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>’s
    <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ref-for-concept-relevant-realm③" data-link-type="dfn">relevant
    realm</a>.

2.  Let `taskSource` be some appropriate <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#task-source"
    id="ref-for-task-source②" data-link-type="dfn">task source</a>.

3.  If `ms` is NaN, let `ms` be +0; otherwise let `ms` be the maximum of
    `ms` and +0.

4.  Let `p` be <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise④"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a> in `realm`.

5.  <a href="#dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-steps-once-promise-is-settled⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">React</a> to `promise`:

    - If `promise` was fulfilled with value `v`, then:

      1.  Run the following steps <a
          href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
          id="ref-for-in-parallel②" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

          1.  Wait `ms` milliseconds.

          2.  <a
              href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
              id="ref-for-queue-a-task②" data-link-type="dfn">Queue a task</a>
              on `taskSource` to
              <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve⑥"
              data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `p` with `v`.

    - If `promise` was rejected with reason `r`, then:

      1.  Run the following steps <a
          href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
          id="ref-for-in-parallel③" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

          1.  Wait `ms` milliseconds.

          2.  <a
              href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
              id="ref-for-queue-a-task③" data-link-type="dfn">Queue a task</a>
              on `taskSource` to
              <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject⑤" data-link-type="dfn">reject</a>
              `p` with `r`.

6.  Return `p`.

</div>

</div>

<div id="promise-example-environment-ready" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-environment-ready" class="self-link"></a>

`environment.ready` is an
<a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute④②"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> that signals when some part of some
environment, e.g. a DOM document, becomes "ready". It illustrates how to
encode environmental asynchronicity.

``` highlight
interface Environment {
  readonly attribute Promise<undefined> ready;
};
```

Every `Environment` object must have a
<span id="environment-ready-promise" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="Environment" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">ready promise</span>,
which is a
<a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise①⑨" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>Promise</code></a>`<`<a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①⑥" class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface"><code>undefined</code></a>`>`.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="Environment-ready">

The `ready` attribute getter steps are:

1.  Return
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②⑦" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>’s
    <a href="#environment-ready-promise"
    id="ref-for-environment-ready-promise" data-link-type="dfn">ready
    promise</a>.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="Environment-create">

To create an `Environment` object in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①②" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `taskSource` be some appropriate <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#task-source"
    id="ref-for-task-source③" data-link-type="dfn">task source</a>.

2.  Let `environment` be
    <a href="#new" id="ref-for-new" data-link-type="dfn">new</a>
    `Environment` object in `realm`.

3.  Set `environment`’s <a href="#environment-ready-promise"
    id="ref-for-environment-ready-promise①" data-link-type="dfn">ready
    promise</a> to <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a> in `realm`.

4.  Run the following steps <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
    id="ref-for-in-parallel④" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

    1.  Do some asynchronous work.

    2.  If `environment` becomes ready successfully, then <a
        href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
        id="ref-for-queue-a-task④" data-link-type="dfn">queue a task</a>
        on `taskSource` to <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `environment`’s
        <a href="#environment-ready-promise"
        id="ref-for-environment-ready-promise②" data-link-type="dfn">ready
        promise</a>.

    3.  If `environment` fails to become ready, then <a
        href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
        id="ref-for-queue-a-task⑤" data-link-type="dfn">queue a task</a>
        on `taskSource` to
        <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject⑥" data-link-type="dfn">reject</a>
        `environment`’s <a href="#environment-ready-promise"
        id="ref-for-environment-ready-promise③" data-link-type="dfn">ready
        promise</a> with a
        "<a href="#networkerror" id="ref-for-networkerror" class="idl-code"
        data-link-type="exception"><code class="idl">NetworkError</code></a>"
        <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④⓪"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>.

5.  Return `environment`.

</div>

</div>

<div id="promise-example-addBookmark" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-addBookmark" class="self-link"></a>

`addBookmark` is an
<a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation④①"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> that requests that the user add the
current web page as a bookmark. It’s drawn from [some iterative design
work](https://github.com/domenic/promises-unwrapping/issues/85) and
illustrates a more real-world scenario of appealing to environmental
asynchrony, as well as immediate rejections.

``` highlight
interface I {
```
