``` highlight
  Promise<undefined> addBookmark();
};
```

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="addBookmark">

The `addBookmark()` method steps are:

1.  Let `taskSource` be some appropriate <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#task-source"
    id="ref-for-task-source④" data-link-type="dfn">task source</a>.

2.  If this method was not invoked as a result of explicit user action,
    return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> a
    "<a href="#securityerror" id="ref-for-securityerror"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SecurityError</code></a>"
    <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If the document’s mode of operation is standalone, return
    <a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> a
    "<a href="#notsupportederror" id="ref-for-notsupportederror①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">NotSupportedError</code></a>"
    <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④②"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  Let `promise` be
    <a href="#a-new-promise" id="ref-for-a-new-promise⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">a new promise</a>.

5.  Let `info` be the result of getting a web application’s metadata.

6.  Run the following steps <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#in-parallel"
    id="ref-for-in-parallel⑤" data-link-type="dfn">in parallel</a>:

    1.  Using `info`, and in a manner that is user-agent specific, allow
        the end user to make a choice as to whether they want to add the
        bookmark.

        1.  If the end-user aborts the request to add the bookmark
            (e.g., they hit escape, or press a "cancel" button), then <a
            href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
            id="ref-for-queue-a-task⑥" data-link-type="dfn">queue a task</a>
            on `taskSource` to
            <a href="#reject" id="ref-for-reject⑦" data-link-type="dfn">reject</a>
            `promise` with an
            "<a href="#aborterror" id="ref-for-aborterror" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">AbortError</code></a>"
            <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④③"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Otherwise, <a
            href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#queue-a-task"
            id="ref-for-queue-a-task⑦" data-link-type="dfn">queue a task</a>
            on `taskSource` to <a href="#resolve" id="ref-for-resolve⑧"
            data-link-type="dfn">resolve</a> `promise`.

7.  Return `promise`.

</div>

</div>

<div id="promise-example-batchRequest" class="example">

<a href="#promise-example-batchRequest" class="self-link"></a>

Several places in
<a href="#biblio-service-workers" data-link-type="biblio"
title="Service Workers Nightly">[SERVICE-WORKERS]</a> use
<a href="#waiting-for-all-promise" id="ref-for-waiting-for-all-promise"
data-link-type="dfn">get a promise to wait for all</a>. `batchRequest`
illustrates a simplified version of one of their uses. It takes as input
a <a href="#idl-sequence" id="ref-for-idl-sequence①"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence</a> of URLs, and returns a promise for a
<a href="#idl-sequence" id="ref-for-idl-sequence②"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence</a> of
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#response" id="ref-for-response"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Response</code></a> objects
created by fetching the corresponding URL. If any of the fetches fail,
it will return
<a href="#a-promise-rejected-with" id="ref-for-a-promise-rejected-with⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">a promise rejected with</a> that failure.

``` highlight
interface I {
  Promise<sequence<Response>> batchRequest(sequence<USVString> urls);
};
```

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="batchRequest">

The `batchRequest(``urls``)` method steps are:

1.  Let `responsePromises` be « ».

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate⑨" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `url`
    of `urls`:

    1.  Let `p` be the result of calling
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-global-fetch"
        id="ref-for-dom-global-fetch" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">fetch()</code></a> with `url`.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="ref-for-list-append⑨" data-link-type="dfn">Append</a> `p` to
        `responsePromises`.

3.  Let `p` be the result of
    <a href="#waiting-for-all-promise" id="ref-for-waiting-for-all-promise①"
    data-link-type="dfn">getting a promise to wait for all</a> with
    `responsePromises`.

4.  Return `p`.

</div>

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.25. </span><span id="es-union" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Union types</span><a href="#js-union" class="self-link"></a>

IDL <a href="#dfn-union-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-type③⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">union type</a> values are represented by JavaScript
values that correspond to the union’s
<a href="#dfn-union-member-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-member-type①①"
data-link-type="dfn">member types</a>.

<div id="js-to-union" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to union">

<span id="es-to-union"></span>

To <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">convert a JavaScript value</a> `V` to an IDL
<a href="#dfn-union-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-type③⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">union type</a> value is done as follows:

1.  If the <a href="#dfn-union-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-type③⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">union type</a>
    <a href="#dfn-includes-undefined" id="ref-for-dfn-includes-undefined④"
    data-link-type="dfn">includes undefined</a> and `V` is undefined,
    then return the unique
    <a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a> value.

2.  If the <a href="#dfn-union-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-type④⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">union type</a>
    <a href="#dfn-includes-a-nullable-type"
    id="ref-for-dfn-includes-a-nullable-type③" data-link-type="dfn">includes
    a nullable type</a> and `V` is null or undefined, then return the
    IDL value null.

3.  Let `types` be the <a href="#dfn-flattened-union-member-types"
    id="ref-for-dfn-flattened-union-member-types①①"
    data-link-type="dfn">flattened member types</a> of the
    <a href="#dfn-union-type" id="ref-for-dfn-union-type④①"
    data-link-type="dfn">union type</a>.

4.  If `V` is null or undefined, then:

    1.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#idl-dictionary" id="ref-for-idl-dictionary①⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">dictionary type</a>, then return the result
        of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④①"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that dictionary type.

5.  If `V`
    <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes an
        <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface①⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> that `V`
        <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements④"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a>, then return the IDL value
        that is a reference to the object `V`.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①②"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

6.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>,
    `V` has an \[\[ArrayBufferData\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, and <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is false,
    then:

    1.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>,
        then return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④②"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
        <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer②"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①③"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

7.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①①" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>,
    `V`, has an \[\[ArrayBufferData\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, and <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is true,
    then:

    1.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>,
        then return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④③"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
        <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer②"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①④"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

8.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①②" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>
    and `V` has a \[\[DataView\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots②"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-DataView" id="ref-for-idl-DataView①"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DataView</code></a>, then
        return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④④"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
        <a href="#idl-DataView" id="ref-for-idl-DataView②"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DataView</code></a>.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①⑤"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

9.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①③" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>
    and `V` has a \[\[TypedArrayName\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots③"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#dfn-typed-array-type" id="ref-for-dfn-typed-array-type①"
        data-link-type="dfn">typed array type</a> whose name is the
        value of `V`’s \[\[TypedArrayName\]\] <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
        id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots④"
        data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then return the result
        of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that type.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①⑥"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

10. If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iscallable"
    id="ref-for-sec-iscallable③" data-link-type="abstract-op">IsCallable</a>(`V`)
    is true, then:

    1.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#dfn-callback-function" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-function②⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">callback function</a> type, then return the
        result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that callback
        function type.

    2.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①⑦"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

11. If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①④" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>,
    then:

    1.  If `types` includes an
        <a href="#async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-async-sequence-type④"
        data-link-type="dfn">async sequence type</a>, then

        1.  If `types` does not include a
            <a href="#dfn-string-type" id="ref-for-dfn-string-type④"
            data-link-type="dfn">string type</a> or `V` does not have a
            \[\[StringData\]\] <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
            id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then

            1.  Let `asyncMethod` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
                id="ref-for-sec-getmethod④" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`V`,
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
                id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①③" data-link-type="idl"><code
                class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a>).

            2.  If `asyncMethod` is not undefined, return an IDL
                <a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type⑤"
                data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> value with
                <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
                id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object④" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>
                set to `V`, <a href="#js-async-sequence-method"
                id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-method③" data-link-type="dfn">method</a>
                set to `syncMethod`, and
                <a href="#js-async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-type③"
                data-link-type="dfn">type</a> set to "`async`".

            3.  Let `syncMethod` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
                id="ref-for-sec-getmethod⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`V`,
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
                id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①④" data-link-type="idl"><code
                class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>).

            4.  If `syncMethod` is not undefined, return an IDL
                <a href="#idl-async-iterable-type" id="ref-for-idl-async-iterable-type⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">async sequence</a> value with
                <a href="#js-async-sequence-object"
                id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-object⑤" data-link-type="dfn">object</a>
                set to `V`, <a href="#js-async-sequence-method"
                id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-method④" data-link-type="dfn">method</a>
                set to `syncMethod`, and
                <a href="#js-async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-js-async-sequence-type④"
                data-link-type="dfn">type</a> set to "`sync`".

    2.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type①⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">sequence type</a>, then

        1.  Let `method` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
            id="ref-for-sec-getmethod⑥" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`V`,
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
            id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>).

        2.  If `method` is not undefined, return the result of
            <a href="#create-sequence-from-iterable"
            id="ref-for-create-sequence-from-iterable①"
            data-link-type="dfn">creating a sequence</a> of that type
            from `V` and `method`.

    3.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#dfn-frozen-array-type" id="ref-for-dfn-frozen-array-type⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">frozen array type</a>, then

        1.  Let `method` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getmethod"
            id="ref-for-sec-getmethod⑦" data-link-type="abstract-op">GetMethod</a>(`V`,
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
            id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols①⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>).

        2.  If `method` is not undefined, return the result of
            <a href="#create-frozen-array-from-iterable"
            id="ref-for-create-frozen-array-from-iterable"
            data-link-type="dfn">creating a frozen array</a> of that
            type from `V` and `method`.

    4.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#idl-dictionary" id="ref-for-idl-dictionary①⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">dictionary type</a>, then return the result
        of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that dictionary type.

    5.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#record-type" id="ref-for-record-type③"
        data-link-type="dfn">record type</a>, then return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that record type.

    6.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#dfn-callback-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-interface②⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">callback interface</a> type, then return
        the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value④⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that
        <a href="#idl-callback-interface" id="ref-for-idl-callback-interface⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">callback interface type</a>.

    7.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object①⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a>, then
        return the IDL value that is a reference to the object `V`.

12. If `V` <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-boolean-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-boolean-type①"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a Boolean</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①②"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a>, then
        return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
        <a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①③"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a>.

13. If `V` <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-number-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-number-type⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a Number</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes a
        <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a>, then return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤①"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that
        <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①①"
        data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a>.

14. If `V` <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-bigint-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-bigint-type②"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a BigInt</a>, then:

    1.  If `types` includes
        <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①③"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>, then
        return the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤②"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
        <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①④"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>

15. If `types` includes a
    <a href="#dfn-string-type" id="ref-for-dfn-string-type⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">string type</a>, then return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤③"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that type.

16. If `types` includes a
    <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a> and
    <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>, then
    return the result of
    <a href="#converted-to-a-numeric-type-or-bigint"
    id="ref-for-converted-to-a-numeric-type-or-bigint"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to either that
    <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①③"
    data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a> or
    <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①⑥"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>.

17. If `types` includes a
    <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a>, then return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤④"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to that
    <a href="#dfn-numeric-type" id="ref-for-dfn-numeric-type①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">numeric type</a>.

18. If `types` includes
    <a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①④"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a>, then
    return the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
    <a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean①⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a>.

19. If `types` includes <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>, then
    return the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to
    <a href="#idl-bigint" id="ref-for-idl-bigint①⑧"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">bigint</code></a>.

20. <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw②⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">Throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror②⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

</div>

<span id="union-to-es"></span> An IDL union type value is
<a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④①"
data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a> according to
the rules for converting the
<a href="#dfn-specific-type" id="ref-for-dfn-specific-type③"
data-link-type="dfn">specific type</a> of the IDL union type value as
described in this section ([§ 3.2 JavaScript type
mapping](#js-type-mapping)).

#### <span class="secno">3.2.26. </span><span id="es-buffer-source-types" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Buffer source types</span><a href="#js-buffer-source-types" class="self-link"></a>

A value of an IDL
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> is
represented by an object of the corresponding JavaScript class. If it is
not <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
\[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, it can only be backed by
JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> objects `V` for which <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is true.

A value of an IDL
<a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> is
represented by an object of the corresponding JavaScript class. If it is
not <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
\[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, it can only be backed by
JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> objects `V` for which <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer①"
data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is true.

Values of the IDL
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types①"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view types</a> are represented by objects of
the corresponding JavaScript class, with the following additional
restrictions on those objects.

- If the type is not
  <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
  id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with⑨"
  data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> either the
  \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable③"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\] or
  \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute③⑦"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, if applicable, they can
  only be backed by JavaScript <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects①" data-link-type="idl"><code
  class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> objects `V` for which <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
  id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer②"
  data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is
  true.
- If the type is <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
  id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①⓪"
  data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
  \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable④"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute③⑧"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> but not with the
  \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared②"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute③⑨"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, if applicable, they can
  only be backed by JavaScript <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects②" data-link-type="idl"><code
  class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> objects.
- If the type is <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
  id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①①"
  data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
  \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared③"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④⓪"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> but not with the
  \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable⑤"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④①"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, they can only be backed
  by JavaScript <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects③" data-link-type="idl"><code
  class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> and <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects①" data-link-type="idl"><code
  class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> objects `V` for which <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
  id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer③"
  data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is
  true.
- If the type is <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
  id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①②"
  data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> both the
  \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable⑥"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\] and
  the \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared④"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]

<div id="js-to-buffer-source" class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to IDL ArrayBuffer">

<span id="es-to-buffer-source"></span>

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑤⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer④"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> value by
running the following algorithm:

1.  If `V` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type①⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>, or `V` does not
    have an \[\[ArrayBufferData\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw②①"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror②①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

2.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is true,
    then <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw②②"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror②②"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

3.  If the conversion is not to an IDL type
    <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
    id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①③"
    data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
    \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④③"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, and <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer④"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`) is
    false, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw②③"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror②③"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

4.  Return the IDL
    <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> value
    that is a reference to the same object as `V`.

</div>

<a href="#idl-BigUint64Array" id="ref-for-idl-BigUint64Array①"

<a href="#idl-Float64Array" id="ref-for-idl-Float64Array①"

    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③⓪"

    id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
    \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared⑥"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④⑦"

    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer⑤"

    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③①"

    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

4.  If the conversion is not to an IDL type
    <a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
    id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
    \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, and <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isfixedlengtharraybuffer⑦"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsFixedLengthArrayBuffer</a>(`V`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\])
    is false, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③②"

    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

5.  Return the IDL value of type `T` that is a reference to the same

dfn-for="ArrayBuffer" dfn-type="dfn" export="">create</span> an
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> from a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="ref-for-byte-sequence①" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
`bytes` in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①③" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands④⑨" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-allocatearraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-allocatearraybuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">AllocateArrayBuffer</a>(`realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-constructor" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%ArrayBuffer%</code></a>\]\], `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length" data-link-type="dfn">length</a>).

2.  Let `arrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥①"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsArrayBuffer` to an IDL value
    of type <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

3.  <a href="#arraybuffer-write" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-write"
    data-link-type="dfn">Write</a> `bytes` into `arrayBuffer`.

4.  Return `arrayBuffer`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create"
algorithm-for="SharedArrayBuffer">

To <span id="sharedarraybuffer-create" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="SharedArrayBuffer" dfn-type="dfn" export="">create</span> a
<a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> from
a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="ref-for-byte-sequence②" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
`bytes` in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①④" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `jsSharedArrayBuffer` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-allocatesharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-allocatesharedarraybuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">AllocateSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-sharedarraybuffer-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-sharedarraybuffer-constructor"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%SharedArrayBuffer%</code></a>\]\],
    `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length①" data-link-type="dfn">length</a>).

2.  Let `sharedArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥②"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsSharedArrayBuffer` to an IDL
    value of type
    <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>.

3.  <a href="#arraybuffer-write" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-write①"
    data-link-type="dfn">Write</a> `bytes` into `sharedArrayBuffer`.

4.  Return `sharedArrayBuffer`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create"
algorithm-for="ArrayBufferView">

To <span id="arraybufferview-create" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBufferView" dfn-type="dfn" export="">create</span> one of
the <a href="#ArrayBufferView" id="ref-for-ArrayBufferView"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBufferView</code></a> types
from a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="ref-for-byte-sequence③" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
`bytes` in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①⑤" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Assert: if the type is not
    <a href="#idl-DataView" id="ref-for-idl-DataView⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DataView</code></a>, then
    `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length②" data-link-type="dfn">length</a>
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#eqn-modulo" id="ref-for-eqn-modulo①"
    data-link-type="dfn">modulo</a> the
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#table-the-typedarray-constructors"
    id="ref-for-table-the-typedarray-constructors"
    data-link-type="dfn">element size</a> of that type is 0.

2.  Let `arrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#arraybuffer-create" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-create"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating</a> an
    <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer⑧"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> from
    `bytes` in `realm`.

3.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④③"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `arrayBuffer` to a JavaScript
    value.

4.  Let `constructor` be the appropriate constructor from
    `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\] for the type of
    <a href="#ArrayBufferView" id="ref-for-ArrayBufferView①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBufferView</code></a>
    being created.

5.  Let `jsView` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤①" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-construct"
    id="ref-for-sec-construct" data-link-type="abstract-op">Construct</a>(`constructor`,
    « `jsArrayBuffer` »).

6.  Return the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥③"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsView` into the given type.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="get a copy of the buffer source">

To <span id="dfn-get-buffer-source-copy" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="get a copy of the buffer source|get a copy of the bytes held by the buffer source">get
a copy of the bytes held by the buffer source</span> given a
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type③"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance `bufferSource`:

1.  Let `jsBufferSource` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④④"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `bufferSource` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be `jsBufferSource`.

3.  Let `offset` be 0.

4.  Let `length` be 0.

5.  If `jsBufferSource` has a \[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a>, then:

    1.  Set `jsArrayBuffer` to
        `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\].

    2.  Set `offset` to `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ByteOffset\]\].

    3.  Set `length` to `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ByteLength\]\].

6.  Otherwise:

    1.  Assert: `jsBufferSource` is an
        <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer⑨"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> or
        <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
        object.

    2.  Set `length` to `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ArrayBufferByteLength\]\].

7.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isdetachedbuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isdetachedbuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDetachedBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`)
    is true, then return the empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence④" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>.

8.  Let `bytes` be a new
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence⑤" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
    of <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length③" data-link-type="dfn">length</a>
    equal to `length`.

9.  For `i` in <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#the-range"
    id="ref-for-the-range④" data-link-type="dfn">the range</a> `offset`
    to `offset` + `length` − 1, inclusive, set `bytes`\[`i` − `offset`\]
    to <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-getvaluefrombuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-getvaluefrombuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">GetValueFromBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`,
    `i`, Uint8, true, Unordered).

10. Return `bytes`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="byte length"
algorithm-for="BufferSource">

The <span id="buffersource-byte-length" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="BufferSource" dfn-type="dfn" export="">byte length</span> of a
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type④"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance `bufferSource` is
the value returned by the following steps:

1.  Let `jsBufferSource` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `bufferSource` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  If `jsBufferSource` has a \[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] internal slot,
    then return `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ByteLength\]\].

3.  Return `jsBufferSource`.\[\[ArrayBufferByteLength\]\].

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="underlying buffer"
algorithm-for="BufferSource">

The <span id="buffersource-underlying-buffer" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="BufferSource" dfn-type="dfn" export="">underlying buffer</span>
of a
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance `bufferSource` is
the value returned by the following steps:

1.  If `bufferSource` is a
    <a href="#buffer-types" id="ref-for-buffer-types⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">buffer type</a> instance, then return
    `bufferSource`.

2.  Let `jsBufferView` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `bufferSource` to a JavaScript
    value.

3.  Let `jsBuffer` be `jsBufferView`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\].

4.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer⑥"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`jsBuffer`) is
    false, then return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥④"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsBuffer` to an IDL value of
    type <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

5.  Return the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsBuffer` to an IDL value of
    type
    <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer⑨"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="ArrayBuffer/write">

To <span id="arraybuffer-write" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBuffer,SharedArrayBuffer" dfn-type="dfn"
export="">write</span> a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="ref-for-byte-sequence⑥" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
`bytes` into a <a href="#buffer-types" id="ref-for-buffer-types⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer type</a> instance `arrayBuffer`, optionally
given a <span id="arraybuffer-write-startingoffset"
class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBuffer/write,SharedArrayBuffer/write" dfn-type="dfn"
export="">`startingOffset`</span> (default 0):

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `arrayBuffer` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  Assert: `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length④" data-link-type="dfn">length</a> ≤
    `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ArrayBufferByteLength\]\] − `startingOffset`.

3.  For `i` in <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#the-range"
    id="ref-for-the-range⑤" data-link-type="dfn">the range</a>
    `startingOffset` to `startingOffset` + `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length⑤" data-link-type="dfn">length</a> −
    1, inclusive, perform <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-setvalueinbuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-setvalueinbuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">SetValueInBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`,
    `i`, Uint8, `bytes`\[`i` - `startingOffset`\], true, Unordered).

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="ArrayBufferView/write">

To <span id="arraybufferview-write" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBufferView" dfn-type="dfn" export="">write</span> a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="ref-for-byte-sequence⑦" data-link-type="dfn">byte sequence</a>
`bytes` into an <a href="#ArrayBufferView" id="ref-for-ArrayBufferView②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBufferView</code></a>
`view`, optionally given a
<span id="arraybufferview-write-startingoffset" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBufferView/write" dfn-type="dfn"
export="">`startingOffset`</span> (default 0):

1.  Let `jsView` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `view` to a JavaScript value.

2.  Assert: `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length⑥" data-link-type="dfn">length</a> ≤
    `jsView`.\[\[ByteLength\]\] − `startingOffset`.

3.  Assert: if `view` is not a
    <a href="#idl-DataView" id="ref-for-idl-DataView⑥"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DataView</code></a>, then
    `bytes`’s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-length"
    id="ref-for-byte-sequence-length⑦" data-link-type="dfn">length</a>
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#eqn-modulo" id="ref-for-eqn-modulo②"
    data-link-type="dfn">modulo</a> the
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#table-the-typedarray-constructors"
    id="ref-for-table-the-typedarray-constructors①"
    data-link-type="dfn">element size</a> of `view`’s type is 0.

4.  Let `arrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a>
    `jsView`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] to an IDL value of type
    <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

5.  <a href="#arraybuffer-write" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-write②"
    data-link-type="dfn">Write</a> `bytes` into `arrayBuffer` with
    *<a href="#arraybuffer-write-startingoffset"
    id="ref-for-arraybuffer-write-startingoffset"
    data-link-type="dfn">startingOffset</a>* set to
    `jsView`.\[\[ByteOffset\]\] + `startingOffset`.

</div>

<div class="warning">

Extreme care must be taken when writing specification text that
<a href="#arraybuffer-write" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-write③"
data-link-type="dfn">writes</a> into a
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance, as the underlying
data can easily be changed by the script author or other APIs at
unpredictable times. This is especially true if a
<a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①⓪"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
object is involved.

For the non-shared cases, a more recommended pattern is to
<a href="#arraybuffer-transfer" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-transfer"
data-link-type="dfn">transfer</a> the
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> first if
possible, to ensure the writes cannot overlap with other modifications,
and then give the new
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> instance
to author code as necessary. Alternately, you can
<a href="#dfn-get-buffer-source-copy"
id="ref-for-dfn-get-buffer-source-copy" data-link-type="dfn">get a copy
of the bytes held by the buffer source</a>, modify those bytes, and then
use them to
<a href="#arraybuffer-create" id="ref-for-arraybuffer-create①"
data-link-type="dfn">create</a> a new
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①④"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> or
<a href="#ArrayBufferView" id="ref-for-ArrayBufferView③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBufferView</code></a> to
give back to author code.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="detach" algorithm-for="ArrayBuffer">

To <span id="dfn-detach" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="ArrayBuffer"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">detach</span> an
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⑤"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>
`arrayBuffer`:

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value④⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `arrayBuffer` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤②" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-detacharraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-detacharraybuffer"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">DetachArrayBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`).

<a href="#note-ArrayBuffer-detach-exceptions" class="self-link"></a>This
will throw an exception if `jsArrayBuffer` has an
\[\[ArrayBufferDetachKey\]\] that is not undefined, such as is the case
with the value of
<a href="https://webassembly.github.io/spec/js-api/#memory"
id="ref-for-memory" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">WebAssembly.Memory</code></a>’s
<a href="https://webassembly.github.io/spec/js-api/#dom-memory-buffer"
id="ref-for-dom-memory-buffer" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">buffer</code></a> attribute.
<a href="#biblio-wasm-js-api-1" data-link-type="biblio"
title="WebAssembly JavaScript Interface">[WASM-JS-API-1]</a>

Detaching a buffer that is already
<a href="#buffersource-detached" id="ref-for-buffersource-detached"
data-link-type="dfn">detached</a> is a no-op.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="detached"
algorithm-for="BufferSource">

A <a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance `bufferSource` is
<span id="buffersource-detached" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="BufferSource" dfn-type="dfn" export="">detached</span> if the
following steps return true:

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `bufferSource` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  If `jsArrayBuffer` has a \[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] internal slot,
    then set `jsArrayBuffer` to
    `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\].

3.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isdetachedbuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isdetachedbuffer①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDetachedBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`).

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="transferable"
algorithm-for="BufferSource">

A <a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> instance `bufferSource` is
<span id="buffersource-transferable" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="BufferSource" dfn-type="dfn" export="">transferable</span> if
the following steps return true:

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤①"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `bufferSource` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  If `jsArrayBuffer` has a \[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] internal slot,
    then set `jsArrayBuffer` to
    `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\].

3.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-issharedarraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-issharedarraybuffer⑦"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsSharedArrayBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`)
    is true, then return false.

4.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isdetachedbuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isdetachedbuffer②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDetachedBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`)
    is true, then return false.

5.  If `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ArrayBufferDetachKey\]\] is not undefined,
    then return false.

6.  Return true.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="transfer" algorithm-for="ArrayBuffer">

To <span id="arraybuffer-transfer" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="ArrayBuffer" dfn-type="dfn" export="">transfer</span> an
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>
`arrayBuffer`, optionally given a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm①⑥" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `targetRealm`:

1.  Let `jsArrayBuffer` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤②"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `arrayBuffer` to a JavaScript
    value.

2.  If <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-isdetachedbuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-isdetachedbuffer③"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDetachedBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`)
    is false, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③③"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③③"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

3.  Let `arrayBufferData` be `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ArrayBufferData\]\].

4.  Let `arrayBufferByteLength` be
    `jsArrayBuffer`.\[\[ArrayBufferByteLength\]\].

5.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-detacharraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-detacharraybuffer①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">DetachArrayBuffer</a>(`jsArrayBuffer`).

6.  If `targetRealm` is not given, let `targetRealm` be the
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm"
    id="ref-for-current-realm①" data-link-type="dfn">current realm</a>.

7.  Let `jsTransferred` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-allocatearraybuffer"
    id="ref-for-sec-allocatearraybuffer①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">AllocateArrayBuffer</a>(`targetRealm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-constructor①" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%ArrayBuffer%</code></a>\]\], 0).

8.  Set `jsTransferred`.\[\[ArrayBufferData\]\] to `arrayBufferData`.

9.  Set `jsTransferred`.\[\[ArrayBufferByteLength\]\] to
    `arrayBufferByteLength`.

10. Return the result of <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `jsTransferred` to an IDL value
    of type <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⑦"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

<div id="note-ArrayBuffer-transfer-exceptions" class="note" role="note">

<a href="#note-ArrayBuffer-transfer-exceptions" class="self-link"></a>
This will throw an exception under any of the following circumstances:

- `arrayBuffer` cannot be
  <a href="#buffersource-detached" id="ref-for-buffersource-detached①"
  data-link-type="dfn">detached</a>, for the reasons [explained in that
  algorithm’s definition](#note-ArrayBuffer-detach-exceptions);

- `arrayBuffer` is already
  <a href="#buffersource-detached" id="ref-for-buffersource-detached②"
  data-link-type="dfn">detached</a>;

- Sufficient memory cannot be allocated in `realm`. Generally this will
  only be the case if `realm` is in a different <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#sec-agent-clusters"
  id="ref-for-sec-agent-clusters" data-link-type="dfn">agent cluster</a>
  than the one in which `arrayBuffer` was allocated. If they are in the
  same <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#sec-agent-clusters"
  id="ref-for-sec-agent-clusters①" data-link-type="dfn">agent cluster</a>,
  then implementations will just change the backing pointers to get the
  same observable results with better performance and no allocations.

</div>

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.27. </span><span id="es-frozen-array" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Frozen arrays — FrozenArray\<`T`\></span><a href="#js-frozen-array" class="self-link"></a>

Values of frozen array types are represented by frozen JavaScript Array
object references.

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="convert a JavaScript value to frozen array">

A JavaScript value `V` is <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to an IDL
<a href="#idl-frozen-array" id="ref-for-idl-frozen-array③"
class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface">FrozenArray&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> value by
running the following algorithm:

1.  Let `values` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑥⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to IDL type
    <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type②⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a>.

2.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-create-frozen-array" id="ref-for-dfn-create-frozen-array③"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating a frozen array</a> from `values`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create a frozen array">

To <span id="dfn-create-frozen-array" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="create a frozen array|creating a frozen array">create a frozen
array</span> from a sequence of values of type `T`, follow these steps:

1.  Let `array` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤③"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> the sequence of values of type
    `T` to a JavaScript value.

2.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-setintegritylevel"
    id="ref-for-sec-setintegritylevel"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">SetIntegrityLevel</a>(`array`,
    "`frozen`").

3.  Return `array`.

</div>

The result of <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤④"
data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> an IDL
<a href="#idl-frozen-array" id="ref-for-idl-frozen-array④"
class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface">FrozenArray&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> value to
a JavaScript value is the Object value that represents a reference to
the same object that the IDL
<a href="#idl-frozen-array" id="ref-for-idl-frozen-array⑤"
class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface">FrozenArray&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a>
represents.

##### <span class="secno">3.2.27.1. </span><span class="content">Creating a frozen array from an iterable</span><a href="#create-frozen-array-from-iterable"
id="ref-for-create-frozen-array-from-iterable①" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create frozen array from iterable">

To create an IDL value of type
<a href="#idl-frozen-array" id="ref-for-idl-frozen-array⑥"
class="idl-code"
data-link-type="interface">FrozenArray&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> given an
iterable `iterable` and an iterator getter `method`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `values` be the result of
    <a href="#create-sequence-from-iterable"
    id="ref-for-create-sequence-from-iterable②"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating a sequence</a> of type
    <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type②①"
    data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a> from
    `iterable` and `method`.

2.  Return the result of
    <a href="#dfn-create-frozen-array" id="ref-for-dfn-create-frozen-array④"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating a frozen array</a> from `values`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.2.28. </span><span id="es-observable-array" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Observable arrays — ObservableArray\<`T`\></span><a href="#js-observable-array" class="self-link"></a>

Values of observable array types are represented by
<a href="#observable-array-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object"
data-link-type="dfn">observable array exotic objects</a>.

Instead of the usual conversion algorithms, observable array types have
special handling as part of the
<a href="#dfn-attribute-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-getter①"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute getter</a> and
<a href="#dfn-attribute-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-setter①"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute setter</a> algorithms.

In the JavaScript binding, JavaScript objects that represent
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object①③"
data-link-type="dfn">platform objects</a> have a
<span id="backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">backing observable
array exotic object</span> for each
<a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute①①"
data-link-type="dfn">regular attribute</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-observable-array-type"
id="ref-for-dfn-observable-array-type③" data-link-type="dfn">observable
array type</a>. These are created and managed as part of the
<a href="#define-the-attributes" id="ref-for-define-the-attributes"
data-link-type="dfn">define the attributes</a> algorithm.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="observable array backing list">

The <a href="#observable-array-attribute-backing-list"
id="ref-for-observable-array-attribute-backing-list"
data-link-type="dfn">backing list</a> for an observable array attribute
in the JavaScript binding, given a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object①④"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `obj` and an attribute
`attribute`, is the
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①④"
data-link-type="dfn">list</a> returned by the following algorithm:

1.  Assert: `obj` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> with the
    <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular attribute</a> `attribute`.

2.  Let `oa` be `obj`’s
    <a href="#backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
    id="ref-for-backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
    data-link-type="dfn">backing observable array exotic object</a> for
    `attribute`.

3.  Return `oa`.\[\[ProxyHandler\]\].\[\[BackingList\]\].

</div>

### <span class="secno">3.3. </span><span id="es-extended-attributes" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Extended attributes</span><a href="#js-extended-attributes" class="self-link"></a>

This section defines a number of
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute④⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attributes</a> whose presence affects the
JavaScript binding.

#### <span class="secno">3.3.1. </span><span class="content">\[AllowResizable\]</span><a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⑨"
class="self-link"></a>

If the \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①①"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> appears on a
<a href="#buffer-types" id="ref-for-buffer-types⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer type</a>, it creates a new IDL type that
allows for the respective corresponding JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> or <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects③" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> object to be resizable.

If the \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤①"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> appears on one of the
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types②"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view types</a> and the
\[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared⑦"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤②"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> does not, it creates a new
IDL type that allows the buffer view type to be backed by a JavaScript
<a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> that is resizable, instead of only by
a fixed-length <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-arraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-arraybuffer-objects⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

If the \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤③"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> and the
\[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared⑧"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤④"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> both appear on one of the
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types③"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view types</a>, it creates a new IDL type
that allows the buffer view type to be additionally backed by a
JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-sharedarraybuffer-objects④" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a> that is growable.

The \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①④"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
extended attribute must
<a href="#dfn-xattr-no-arguments" id="ref-for-dfn-xattr-no-arguments"
data-link-type="dfn">take no arguments</a>.

A type that is not a
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source type</a> must not be
<a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
\[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⑤"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
extended attribute.

See the rules for converting JavaScript values to IDL
<a href="#dfn-buffer-source-type" id="ref-for-dfn-buffer-source-type①⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer source types</a> in [§ 3.2.26 Buffer source
types](#js-buffer-source-types) for the specific requirements that the
use of \[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\]
entails.

See the [example](#example-allowresizable-allowshared) in
<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①⑧">§ 3.3.2
[AllowShared]</a> for example usage of both
\[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⑦"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\] and
\[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared⑨"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\].

#### <span class="secno">3.3.2. </span><span class="content">\[AllowShared\]</span><a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①⑨" class="self-link"></a>

If the \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①⓪"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> appears on one of the
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types④"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view types</a>, it creates a new IDL type
that allows the object to be backed by an
<a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①①"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
instead of only by an
<a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⑧"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a>.

The \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①①"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\] extended
attribute must
<a href="#dfn-xattr-no-arguments" id="ref-for-dfn-xattr-no-arguments①"
data-link-type="dfn">take no arguments</a>.

A type that is not a
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view type</a> must not be
<a href="#idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with"
id="ref-for-idl-type-extended-attribute-associated-with②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">associated with</a> the
\[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\] extended
attribute.

See the rules for converting JavaScript values to IDL
<a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">buffer view types</a> in [§ 3.2.26 Buffer source
types](#js-buffer-source-types) for the specific requirements that the
use of \[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\] entails.

<div id="example-allowresizable-allowshared" class="example">

<a href="#example-allowresizable-allowshared" class="self-link"></a> The
following <a href="#dfn-idl-fragment" id="ref-for-dfn-idl-fragment③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">IDL fragment</a> demonstrates the possible
combinations of the
\[<a href="#AllowResizable" id="ref-for-AllowResizable①⑧"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowResizable</code></a>\] and
\[<a href="#AllowShared" id="ref-for-AllowShared①④"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">AllowShared</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute⑤⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>:

``` highlight
[Exposed=Window]
interface ExampleBufferFeature {
  undefined writeInto(ArrayBufferView dest);
  undefined writeIntoResizable([AllowResizable] ArrayBufferView dest);
  undefined writeIntoShared([AllowShared] ArrayBufferView dest);
  undefined writeIntoSharedResizable([AllowResizable, AllowShared] ArrayBufferView dest);
};
```

With this definition,

- A call to `writeInto` with any
  <a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types⑦"
  data-link-type="dfn">buffer view type</a> backed by either a resizable
  <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer①⑨"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> instance
  or a
  <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①②"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
  instance, will throw a
  <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror⑨"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> exception.
- A call to `writeIntoResizable` with any
  <a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types⑧"
  data-link-type="dfn">buffer view type</a> backed by a
  <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①③"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
  instance, will throw a
  <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①⓪"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> exception.
- A call to `writeIntoShared` with any
  <a href="#buffer-view-types" id="ref-for-buffer-view-types⑨"
  data-link-type="dfn">buffer view type</a> backed by a resizable
  <a href="#idl-ArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-ArrayBuffer②⓪"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">ArrayBuffer</code></a> instance
  or a growable
  <a href="#idl-SharedArrayBuffer" id="ref-for-idl-SharedArrayBuffer①④"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">SharedArrayBuffer</code></a>
  instance, will throw a
  <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①①"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> exception.
