<span class="allow-rfc2119">optional</span> argument at this position,
then we will choose that overload. If there is no valid overload for the
type of value passed in here, then we throw a
<a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>. Generally,
the inspection of the value at the distinguishing argument index does
not have any side effects, and the only side effects in the overload
resolution algorithm are the result of converting the JavaScript values
to IDL values. (An exception exists when one of the overloads has an
<a href="#async-sequence-type" id="ref-for-async-sequence-type⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">async sequence type</a>,
<a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type②④"
data-link-type="dfn">sequence type</a> or
<a href="#dfn-frozen-array-type" id="ref-for-dfn-frozen-array-type⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">frozen array type</a> at the distinguishing
argument index. In this case, we attempt to get the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②①" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a> / <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②②" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a> property to determine the
appropriate overload, and perform the conversion of the distinguishing
argument separately before continuing with the next step.)

At this point, we have determined which overload to use. We now convert
the remaining arguments, from the distinguishing argument onwards, again
ignoring any additional arguments that were ignored due to being passed
after the last possible argument.

When converting an <span class="allow-rfc2119">optional</span>
argument’s JavaScript value to its equivalent IDL value, undefined will
be converted into the <a href="#dfn-optional-argument-default-value"
id="ref-for-dfn-optional-argument-default-value①⑤" class="allow-2119"
data-link-type="dfn">optional argument’s default value</a>, if it has
one, or a special value “missing” otherwise.

<span class="allow-2119">Optional</span> arguments corresponding to a
final, variadic argument do not treat undefined as a special “missing”
value, however. The undefined value is converted to the type of variadic
argument as would be done for a
non-<span class="allow-rfc2119">optional</span> argument.

</div>

### <span class="secno">3.7. </span><span id="es-interfaces" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Interfaces</span><a href="#js-interfaces" class="self-link"></a>

For every <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that is
<a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in a given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②③" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> and that is not
declared with the
\[<a href="#LegacyNoInterfaceObject" id="ref-for-LegacyNoInterfaceObject⑨"
data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">LegacyNoInterfaceObject</code></a>\] or
\[<a href="#LegacyNamespace" id="ref-for-LegacyNamespace⑦"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyNamespace</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②①"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attributes</a>, a corresponding property
exists on the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②④" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a>’s <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
id="ref-for-concept-realm-global②" data-link-type="dfn">global
object</a>. The name of the property is the
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑥⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of the interface, and its value is
an object called the <span id="dfn-interface-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">interface
object</span>. The characteristics of an interface object are described
in [§ 3.7.1 Interface object](#interface-object).

If the \[<a href="#LegacyWindowAlias" id="ref-for-LegacyWindowAlias①②"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyWindowAlias</code></a>\]
extended attribute was specified on an
<a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> interface, then for each
<a href="#legacywindowalias-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacywindowalias-identifier②"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> in
\[<a href="#LegacyWindowAlias" id="ref-for-LegacyWindowAlias①③"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyWindowAlias</code></a>\]'s
<a href="#legacywindowalias-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacywindowalias-identifier③"
data-link-type="dfn">identifiers</a> there exists a corresponding
property on the <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window"
id="ref-for-window⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Window</code></a> global object. The name of the property is
the given <a href="#legacywindowalias-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacywindowalias-identifier④"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, and its value is a reference to the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> for the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>.

In addition, for every
\[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction①⑤"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]
extended attribute on an
<a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> interface, a corresponding property
exists on the JavaScript global object. The name of the property is the
\[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction①⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]'s
<a href="#legacyfactoryfunction-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacyfactoryfunction-identifier②"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, and its value is an object called a
<span id="dfn-legacy-factory-function" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""><span id="dfn-named-constructor"
class="bs-old-id"></span>legacy factory function</span>, which allows
creation of objects that implement the interface. The characteristics of
a legacy factory function are described in [§ 3.7.2 Legacy factory
functions](#legacy-factory-functions).

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="implementation-check an object">

Some JavaScript methods defined in this section will perform an
implementation check in their opening steps, to ensure they’re being
called on the correct kind of object and that the method is valid to
call from the current context.

To <span id="implementation-check-an-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" local-lt="implementation check|implementation-check"
noexport="">implementation-check an object</span> `jsValue` against the
interface `interface`, with the identifier `name` and the type `type`:

1.  Let `object` to
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑤⑨" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-toobject" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(`jsValue`).

2.  If `object` is a
    <a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a>, then
    <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check" data-link-type="dfn">perform a
    security check</a>, passing:

    - the platform object `object`

    - the identifier `name`

    - the type `type`

3.  If `object` does not <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①①"
    data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `interface`, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③⑥"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

4.  Return `object`.

This algo is not yet consistently used everywhere.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.1. </span><span id="es-constructible-interfaces" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-interface-call" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Interface object</span><a href="#interface-object" class="self-link"></a>

The <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects④"
data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a>. It has properties
that correspond to the
<a href="#dfn-constant" id="ref-for-dfn-constant③⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">constants</a> and
<a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①④"
data-link-type="dfn">static operations</a> defined on that interface, as
described in sections [§ 3.7.5 Constants](#js-constants) and [§ 3.7.7
Operations](#js-operations).

If the <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is declared with a
<a href="#idl-constructors" id="ref-for-idl-constructors②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">constructor operation</a>, then the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> can be called as a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#constructor"
id="ref-for-constructor④" data-link-type="dfn">constructor</a> to create
an object that <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①②"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> that interface. Calling that
interface as a function will throw an exception.

<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①②"
data-link-type="dfn">Interface objects</a> whose
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interfaces</a> are not declared with a
<a href="#idl-constructors" id="ref-for-idl-constructors②①"
data-link-type="dfn">constructor operation</a> will throw when called,
both as a function and as a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#constructor"
id="ref-for-constructor⑤" data-link-type="dfn">constructor</a>.

An <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> for an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> has an associated object called the
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>. This object has
properties that correspond to the
<a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②③"
data-link-type="dfn">regular attributes</a> and
<a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③④"
data-link-type="dfn">regular operations</a> defined on the interface,
and is described in more detail in [§ 3.7.3 Interface prototype
object](#interface-prototype-object).

<span class="marker">Note:</span> Since an
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> is a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>
the `typeof` operator will return "function" when applied to an
interface object.

An interface may have <span id="overridden-constructor-steps"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">overridden constructor
steps</span>, which can change the behavior of the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> when called or constructed. By
default interfaces do not have such steps.

In general, constructors are described by defining a
<a href="#idl-constructors" id="ref-for-idl-constructors②②"
data-link-type="dfn">constructor operation</a> and its behavior. The
<a href="#overridden-constructor-steps"
id="ref-for-overridden-constructor-steps"
data-link-type="dfn">overridden constructor steps</a> are used only for
more complicated situations. Editors who wish to use this feature are
strongly advised to discuss this by [filing an
issue](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/issues/new?title=Intent%20to%20use%20constructor%20steps)
before proceeding.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create an interface object">

The <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` with
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑥⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` and in <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②⑤" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm` is
<span id="create-an-interface-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="create an interface object"
noexport="">created</span> as follows:

1.  Let `steps` be `I`’s <a href="#overridden-constructor-steps"
    id="ref-for-overridden-constructor-steps①"
    data-link-type="dfn">overridden constructor steps</a> if they exist,
    or the following steps otherwise:

    1.  If `I` was not declared with a
        <a href="#idl-constructors" id="ref-for-idl-constructors②③"
        data-link-type="dfn">constructor operation</a>, then
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③⑦"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  If
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
        id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects⑤" data-link-type="idl"
        data-refhint-key="d89aa3d8"><code class="idl">NewTarget</code></a>
        is undefined, then
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    3.  Let `args` be the passed arguments.

    4.  Let `n` be the
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="ref-for-list-size⑤" data-link-type="dfn">size</a> of `args`.

    5.  Let `id` be the identifier of interface `I`.

    6.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
        id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set①"
        data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a> for
        constructors with
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑥⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on
        <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` and with argument count
        `n`, and let `S` be the result.

    7.  Let \<`constructor`, `values`\> be the result of passing `S` and
        `args` to the <a href="#dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm"
        id="ref-for-dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm③"
        data-link-type="dfn">overload resolution algorithm</a>.

    8.  Let `object` be the result of
        <a href="#internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface"
        id="ref-for-internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface"
        data-link-type="dfn">internally creating a new object implementing</a>
        `I`, with `realm` and
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
        id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects⑥" data-link-type="idl"
        data-refhint-key="d89aa3d8"><code class="idl">NewTarget</code></a>.

    9.  Perform the
        <a href="#constructor-steps" id="ref-for-constructor-steps②"
        data-link-type="dfn">constructor steps</a> of `constructor` with
        `object` as
        <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②⑧" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
        and `values` as the argument values.

    10. Let `O` be `object`,
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    11. Assert: `O` is an object that
        <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①③"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> `I`.

    12. Assert: `O`.\[\[Realm\]\] is `realm`.

    13. Return `O`.

2.  Let `constructorProto` be `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-function-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-function-prototype-object"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Function.prototype%</code></a>\]\].

3.  If `I` inherits from some other interface `P`, then set
    `constructorProto` to the
    <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> of `P` in `realm`.

4.  Let `unforgeables` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(null).

5.  <a href="#define-the-unforgeable-regular-operations"
    id="ref-for-define-the-unforgeable-regular-operations"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the unforgeable regular operations</a>
    of `I` on `unforgeables`, given `realm`.

6.  <a href="#define-the-unforgeable-regular-attributes"
    id="ref-for-define-the-unforgeable-regular-attributes"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the unforgeable regular attributes</a>
    of `I` on `unforgeables`, given `realm`.

7.  Set `F`.\[\[Unforgeables\]\] to `unforgeables`.

    <span class="marker">Note:</span> this object is never exposed to
    user code. It exists only to ensure all instances of an interface
    with an unforgeable member use the same JavaScript function objects
    for
    <a href="#dfn-attribute-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-getter②"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute getters</a>,
    <a href="#dfn-attribute-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-setter②"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute setters</a> and
    <a href="#dfn-create-operation-function"
    id="ref-for-dfn-create-operation-function"
    data-link-type="dfn">operation functions</a>.

8.  Let `length` be 0.

9.  If `I` was declared with a
    <a href="#idl-constructors" id="ref-for-idl-constructors②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">constructor operation</a>, then

    1.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
        id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set②"
        data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a> for
        constructors with
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑥⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on
        <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑥⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` and with argument count
        0, and let `S` be the result.

    2.  Set `length` to the length of the shortest argument list of the
        entries in `S`.

10. Let `F` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction④"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
    `length`, `id`, « \[\[Unforgeables\]\] », `realm`,
    `constructorProto`).

11. Let `proto` be the result of
    <a href="#create-an-interface-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-create-an-interface-prototype-object"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating an interface prototype object</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` in `realm`.

12. Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
    id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`F`,
    "`prototype`", PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Value\]\]: `proto`,
    \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false,
    \[\[Configurable\]\]: false}).

13. <a href="#define-the-constants" id="ref-for-define-the-constants"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the constants</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦①"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` on `F` given `realm`.

14. <a href="#define-the-static-attributes"
    id="ref-for-define-the-static-attributes" data-link-type="dfn">Define
    the static attributes</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦②"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` on `F` given `realm`.

15. <a href="#define-the-static-operations"
    id="ref-for-define-the-static-operations" data-link-type="dfn">Define
    the static operations</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦③"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` on `F` given `realm`.

16. Return `F`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.2. </span><span id="named-constructors" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Legacy factory functions</span><a href="#legacy-factory-functions" class="self-link"></a>

A <a href="#dfn-legacy-factory-function"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-factory-function②" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
factory function</a> that exists due to one or more
\[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction①⑦"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②②"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attributes</a> with a given
<a href="#legacyfactoryfunction-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacyfactoryfunction-identifier③"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> is a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a>. It allows
constructing objects that implement the interface on which the
\[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction①⑧"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]
extended attributes appear.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create a legacy factory function">

The <a href="#dfn-legacy-factory-function"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-factory-function③" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
factory function</a> with <a href="#legacyfactoryfunction-identifier"
id="ref-for-legacyfactoryfunction-identifier④"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` in <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②⑥" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm` is
<span id="create-a-legacy-factory-function" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="create a legacy factory function"
noexport="">created</span> as follows:

1.  Let `steps` be the following steps:

    1.  If
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
        id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects⑧" data-link-type="idl"
        data-refhint-key="d89aa3d8"><code class="idl">NewTarget</code></a>
        is undefined, then
        <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw③⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror③⑨"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  Let `args` be the passed arguments.

    3.  Let `n` be the
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="ref-for-list-size⑥" data-link-type="dfn">size</a> of `args`.

    4.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
        id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set③"
        data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a> for
        legacy factory functions with
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑥⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on
        <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` and with argument count
        `n`, and let `S` be the result.

    5.  Let \<`constructor`, `values`\> be the result of passing `S` and
        `args` to the <a href="#dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm"
        id="ref-for-dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm④"
        data-link-type="dfn">overload resolution algorithm</a>.

    6.  Let `object` be the result of
        <a href="#internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface"
        id="ref-for-internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface①"
        data-link-type="dfn">internally creating a new object implementing</a>
        `I`, with `realm` and
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
        id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects⑨" data-link-type="idl"
        data-refhint-key="d89aa3d8"><code class="idl">NewTarget</code></a>.

    7.  Perform the
        <a href="#constructor-steps" id="ref-for-constructor-steps③"
        data-link-type="dfn">constructor steps</a> of `constructor` with
        `object` as
        <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this②⑨" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
        and `values` as the argument values.

    8.  Let `O` be `object`,
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    9.  Assert: `O` is an object that
        <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①④"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> `I`.

    10. Assert: `O`.\[\[Realm\]\] is `realm`.

    11. Return `O`.

2.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
    id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set④"
    data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a> for
    legacy factory functions with
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` and with argument count 0,
    and let `S` be the result.

3.  Let `length` be the length of the shortest argument list of the
    entries in `S`.

4.  Let `F` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction⑤"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
    `length`, `id`, « », `realm`).

5.  Let `proto` be the <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` in `realm`.

6.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥①" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
    id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`F`,
    "`prototype`", PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Value\]\]: `proto`,
    \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false,
    \[\[Configurable\]\]: false}).

7.  Return `F`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.3. </span><span class="content">Interface prototype object</span><a href="#interface-prototype-object" class="self-link"></a>

There will exist an <span id="dfn-interface-prototype-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">interface prototype
object</span> for every
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> defined, regardless of whether the
interface was declared with the \[<a href="#LegacyNoInterfaceObject"
id="ref-for-LegacyNoInterfaceObject①⓪" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">LegacyNoInterfaceObject</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②③"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create an interface prototype object">

The <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑦⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `interface` and <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②⑦" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm` is
<span id="create-an-interface-prototype-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="create an interface prototype object"
noexport="">created</span> as follows:

1.  Let `proto` be null.

2.  If `interface` is declared with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①④" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, and `interface`
    <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties④" data-link-type="dfn">supports
    named properties</a>, then set `proto` to the result of
    <a href="#create-a-named-properties-object"
    id="ref-for-create-a-named-properties-object"
    data-link-type="dfn">creating a named properties object</a> for
    `interface` and `realm`.

3.  Otherwise, if `interface` is declared to inherit from another
    interface, then set `proto` to the
    <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> in `realm` of
    that <a href="#dfn-inherited-interfaces"
    id="ref-for-dfn-inherited-interfaces①⑧" data-link-type="dfn">inherited
    interface</a>.

4.  Otherwise, if `interface` is the
    <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④④"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, then set `proto` to
    `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-error-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-error-prototype-object"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Error.prototype%</code></a>\]\].

5.  Otherwise, set `proto` to `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object④"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Object.prototype%</code></a>\]\].

6.  Assert: `proto` <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-object-type②⑤" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a>.

7.  Let `interfaceProtoObj` be null.

8.  If `realm`’s <a href="#realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable"
    id="ref-for-realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable"
    data-link-type="dfn">is global prototype chain mutable</a> is true,
    then:

    1.  Set `interfaceProtoObj` to <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
        id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(`proto`).

9.  Otherwise, if `interface` is declared with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, or `interface` is in
    the set of <a href="#dfn-inherited-interfaces"
    id="ref-for-dfn-inherited-interfaces①⑨" data-link-type="dfn">inherited
    interfaces</a> of an interface that is declared with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

    1.  Set `interfaceProtoObj` to <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-makebasicobject"
        id="ref-for-sec-makebasicobject"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">MakeBasicObject</a>(«
        \[\[Prototype\]\], \[\[Extensible\]\] »).

    2.  Set `interfaceProtoObj`.\[\[Prototype\]\] to `proto`.

    3.  Set the internal methods of `interfaceProtoObj` which are
        specific to <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#immutable-prototype-exotic-object"
        id="ref-for-immutable-prototype-exotic-object"
        data-link-type="dfn">immutable prototype exotic objects</a> to
        the definitions specified in <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-immutable-prototype-exotic-objects"
        id="ref-for-sec-immutable-prototype-exotic-objects"
        data-link-type="dfn">ECMA-262 Immutable prototype exotic objects</a>.

10. Otherwise, set `interfaceProtoObj` to <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate④"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(`proto`).

11. If `interface` has any
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②①"
    data-link-type="dfn">member</a> declared with the
    \[<a href="#Unscopable" id="ref-for-Unscopable⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Unscopable</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

    1.  Let `unscopableObject` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
        id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate⑤"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(null).

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="ref-for-list-iterate①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
        <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a>
        <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②②"
        data-link-type="dfn">member</a> `member` of `interface` that is
        declared with the
        \[<a href="#Unscopable" id="ref-for-Unscopable⑥"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Unscopable</code></a>\]
        <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>:

        1.  Let `id` be `member`’s
            <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦①"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

        2.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥②" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow②"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`unscopableObject`,
            `id`, true).

    3.  Let `desc` be the PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Value\]\]:
        `unscopableObject`, \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Enumerable\]\]:
        false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true}.

    4.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥③" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow②"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`interfaceProtoObj`,
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②③" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.unscopables%</code></a>, `desc`).

12. If `interface` is not declared with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

    1.  <a href="#define-the-regular-attributes"
        id="ref-for-define-the-regular-attributes" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the regular attributes</a> of `interface` on `interfaceProtoObj`
        given `realm`.

    2.  <a href="#define-the-regular-operations"
        id="ref-for-define-the-regular-operations" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the regular operations</a> of `interface` on `interfaceProtoObj`
        given `realm`.

    3.  <a href="#define-the-iteration-methods"
        id="ref-for-define-the-iteration-methods" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the iteration methods</a> of `interface` on `interfaceProtoObj`
        given `realm`.

    4.  <a href="#define-the-asynchronous-iteration-methods"
        id="ref-for-define-the-asynchronous-iteration-methods"
        data-link-type="dfn">Define the asynchronous iteration methods</a>
        of `interface` on `interfaceProtoObj` given `realm`.

13. <a href="#define-the-constants" id="ref-for-define-the-constants①"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the constants</a> of `interface` on
    `interfaceProtoObj` given `realm`.

14. If the \[<a href="#LegacyNoInterfaceObject"
    id="ref-for-LegacyNoInterfaceObject①①" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">LegacyNoInterfaceObject</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> was not specified on
    `interface`, then:

    1.  Let `constructor` be the
        <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> of `interface` in
        `realm`.

    2.  Let `desc` be the PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Writable\]\]: true,
        \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true,
        \[\[Value\]\]: `constructor`}.

    3.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥④" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`interfaceProtoObj`,
        "`constructor`", `desc`).

15. Return `interfaceProtoObj`.

</div>

Additionally, <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype objects</a> get properties
declaratively from:

- [§ 3.7.8 Stringifiers](#js-stringifier),

- [§ 3.7.11 Maplike declarations](#js-maplike), and

- [§ 3.7.12 Setlike declarations](#js-setlike).

Define those properties imperatively instead.

<div class="note" role="note">

The <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that is defined with the
\[<a href="#LegacyNoInterfaceObject"
id="ref-for-LegacyNoInterfaceObject①②" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">LegacyNoInterfaceObject</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③①"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> will be accessible. For
example, with the following IDL:

``` highlight
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyNoInterfaceObject]
interface Foo {
};

partial interface Window {
  attribute Foo foo;
};
```

it is not possible to access the interface prototype object through the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> (since it does not exist as
`window.Foo`). However, an instance of `Foo` can expose the interface
prototype object by calling its \[\[GetPrototypeOf\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn" data-refhint-key="0096ec3e">internal method</a> –
`Object.getPrototypeOf(window.foo)` in this example.

</div>

The <a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string①"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> is the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>’s
<a href="#qualified-name" id="ref-for-qualified-name"
data-link-type="dfn">qualified name</a>.

#### <span class="secno">3.7.4. </span><span class="content">Named properties object</span><a href="#named-properties-object" class="self-link"></a>

For every <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> declared with the
\[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①⑧" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③②"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> that
<a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties⑤" data-link-type="dfn">supports
named properties</a>, there will exist an object known as the
<span id="dfn-named-properties-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">named properties object</span> for that
interface on which named properties are exposed.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create a named properties object">

The <a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object③" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `interface` and <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②⑧" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, is
<span id="create-a-named-properties-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="create a named properties object"
noexport="">created</span> as follows:

1.  Let `proto` be null.

2.  If `interface` is declared to inherit from another interface, then
    set `proto` to the <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> in `realm` for
    the <a href="#dfn-inherited-interfaces"
    id="ref-for-dfn-inherited-interfaces②⓪" data-link-type="dfn">inherited
    interface</a>.

3.  Otherwise, set `proto` to `realm`.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Object.prototype%</code></a>\]\].

4.  Let `obj` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-makebasicobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-makebasicobject①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">MakeBasicObject</a>(«
    \[\[Prototype\]\], \[\[Extensible\]\] »).

5.  Set `obj`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] as specified in [§ 3.7.4.1
    \[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#named-properties-object-getownproperty).

6.  Set `obj`.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] as specified in [§ 3.7.4.2
    \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]](#named-properties-object-defineownproperty).

7.  Set `obj`.\[\[Delete\]\] as specified in [§ 3.7.4.3
    \[\[Delete\]\]](#named-properties-object-delete).

8.  Set `obj`.\[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] as specified in [§ 3.7.4.4
    \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\]](#named-properties-object-setprototypeof).

9.  Set `obj`.\[\[PreventExtensions\]\] as specified in [§ 3.7.4.5
    \[\[PreventExtensions\]\]](#named-properties-object-preventextensions).

10. Set `obj`.\[\[Prototype\]\] to `proto`.

11. Return `obj`.

</div>

<span class="marker">Note:</span> The \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] internal
method of a named properties object continues to use <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryownpropertykeys"
id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryownpropertykeys"
data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryOwnPropertyKeys</a>, unlike the
counterpart for <a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object②" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform objects</a>. Since named properties are not “real” own
properties, they will not be returned by this internal method.

The <a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string②"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object④" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> is the concatenation of the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>’s
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦②"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> and the string "`Properties`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.4.1. </span><span class="content">\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]</span><a href="#named-properties-object-getownproperty" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the internal [[GetOwnProperty]] method of named properties object">

When the \[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object⑤" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> `O` is called with property key `P`, the following
steps are taken:

1.  Let `A` be the
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> for the
    <a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object⑥" data-link-type="dfn">named
    properties object</a> `O`.

2.  Let `object` be `O`.\[\[Realm\]\]'s <a
    href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
    id="ref-for-concept-realm-global③" data-link-type="dfn">global
    object</a>.

3.  Assert: `object` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> `A`.

4.  If the result of running the
    <a href="#dfn-named-property-visibility"
    id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-visibility" data-link-type="dfn">named
    property visibility algorithm</a> with property name `P` and object
    `object` is true, then:

    1.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the named
        property getter.

    2.  Let `value` be an uninitialized variable.

    3.  If `operation` was defined without an
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦③"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then set `value` to the
        result of performing the steps listed in the interface
        description to
        <a href="#dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property"
        id="ref-for-dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property"
        data-link-type="dfn">determine the value of a named property</a>
        with `P` as the name.

    4.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier. Set
        `value` to the result of performing the steps listed in the
        description of `operation` with `P` as the only argument value.

    5.  Let `desc` be a newly created <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
        id="ref-for-sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
        data-link-type="dfn">Property Descriptor</a> with no fields.

    6.  Set `desc`.\[\[Value\]\] to the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `value` to a JavaScript
        value.

    7.  If `A` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with the
        \[<a href="#LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties"
        id="ref-for-LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties④"
        data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties</code></a>\]
        <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③③"
        data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then set
        `desc`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] to false, otherwise set it to true.

    8.  Set `desc`.\[\[Writable\]\] to true and
        `desc`.\[\[Configurable\]\] to true.

    9.  Return `desc`.

5.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarygetownproperty"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarygetownproperty"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryGetOwnProperty</a>(`O`, `P`).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.4.2. </span><span class="content">\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]</span><a href="#named-properties-object-defineownproperty"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[DefineOwnProperty]] internal method of named properties object">

When the \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object⑦" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> is called, the following steps are taken:

1.  Return false.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.4.3. </span><span class="content">\[\[Delete\]\]</span><a href="#named-properties-object-delete" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[Delete]] internal method of named properties object">

When the \[\[Delete\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object⑧" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> is called, the following steps are taken:

1.  Return false.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.4.4. </span><span class="content">\[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\]</span><a href="#named-properties-object-setprototypeof" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[SetPrototypeOf]] internal method of a named properties object">

When the \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object⑨" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> `O` is called with JavaScript language value `V`,
the following step is taken:

1.  If `O`’s
    <a href="#dfn-associated-realm" id="ref-for-dfn-associated-realm"
    data-link-type="dfn">associated realm</a>’s
    <a href="#realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable"
    id="ref-for-realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable①"
    data-link-type="dfn">is global prototype chain mutable</a> is true,
    return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarysetprototypeof"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarysetprototypeof"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinarySetPrototypeOf</a>(`O`, `V`).

2.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-set-immutable-prototype"
    id="ref-for-sec-set-immutable-prototype"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">SetImmutablePrototype</a>(`O`, `V`).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.4.5. </span><span class="content">\[\[PreventExtensions\]\]</span><a href="#named-properties-object-preventextensions"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[PreventExtensions]] internal method of named properties object">

When the \[\[PreventExtensions\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> is called, the following steps are taken:

1.  Return false.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> this keeps
<a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object①①" data-link-type="dfn">named
properties object</a> extensible by making \[\[PreventExtensions\]\]
fail.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.5. </span><span id="es-constants" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Constants</span><a href="#js-constants" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#dfn-constant" id="ref-for-dfn-constant③⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">Constants</a> are exposed on
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface objects</a>,
<a href="#dfn-legacy-callback-interface-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-callback-interface-object①"
data-link-type="dfn">legacy callback interface objects</a>,
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype objects</a>, and on the single
object that <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> the interface, when an interface is
declared with the
\[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global①⑨" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③④"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the constants">

To <span id="define-the-constants" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the constants</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>,
<a href="#dfn-callback-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-interface③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">callback interface</a>, or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace③⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm②⑨" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①①" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
    <a href="#dfn-constant" id="ref-for-dfn-constant④⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">constant</a> `const` that is a
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②③"
    data-link-type="dfn">member</a> of `definition`:

    1.  If `const` is not
        <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="ref-for-iteration-continue" data-link-type="dfn">continue</a>.

    2.  Let `value` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `const`’s IDL value to a
        JavaScript value.

    3.  Let `desc` be the PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Writable\]\]: false,
        \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: false,
        \[\[Value\]\]: `value`}.

    4.  Let `id` be `const`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦④"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    5.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow④"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        `id`, `desc`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.6. </span><span id="es-attributes" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Attributes</span><a href="#js-attributes" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#dfn-static-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-static-attribute①⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">Static attributes</a> are exposed on the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object②①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a>.
<a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②④"
data-link-type="dfn">Regular attributes</a> are exposed on the
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>, unless the
attribute is <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface①"
data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> or if the interface was declared
with the
\[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②⓪" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, in which case they are
exposed on every object that
<a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> the interface.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the regular attributes">

To <span id="define-the-regular-attributes" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the regular attributes</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace③⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⓪" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `attributes` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular attributes</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
    id="ref-for-list-remove" data-link-type="dfn">Remove</a> from
    `attributes` all the
    <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑤⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">attributes</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
    id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface②"
    data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a>.

3.  <a href="#define-the-attributes" id="ref-for-define-the-attributes①"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the attributes</a> `attributes` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the static attributes">

To <span id="define-the-static-attributes" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the static attributes</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑧⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③①" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `attributes` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-static-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-static-attribute①①"
    data-link-type="dfn">static attributes</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="#define-the-attributes" id="ref-for-define-the-attributes②"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the attributes</a> `attributes` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="define the unforgeable regular attributes">

To <span id="define-the-unforgeable-regular-attributes"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the
unforgeable regular attributes</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④①"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③②" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `attributes` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
    id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface③"
    data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a>
    <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular attributes</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="#define-the-attributes" id="ref-for-define-the-attributes③"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the attributes</a> `attributes` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the attributes">

To <span id="define-the-attributes" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the attributes</span> `attributes` of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④②"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target` given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③③" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①②" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
    <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑤⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> `attr` of `attributes`:

    1.  If `attr` is not
        <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="ref-for-iteration-continue①" data-link-type="dfn">continue</a>.

    2.  Let `getter` be the result of creating an
        <a href="#dfn-attribute-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-getter③"
        data-link-type="dfn">attribute getter</a> given `attr`,
        `definition`, and `realm`.

    3.  Let `setter` be the result of creating an
        <a href="#dfn-attribute-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-setter③"
        data-link-type="dfn">attribute setter</a> given `attr`,
        `definition`, and `realm`.

        <span class="marker">Note:</span> the algorithm to create an
        <a href="#dfn-attribute-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-setter④"
        data-link-type="dfn">attribute setter</a> returns undefined if
        `attr` is <a href="#dfn-read-only" id="ref-for-dfn-read-only①⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">read only</a>.

    4.  Let `configurable` be false if `attr` is
        <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
        id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface④"
        data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> and true otherwise.

    5.  Let `desc` be the PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Get\]\]: `getter`,
        \[\[Set\]\]: `setter`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true,
        \[\[Configurable\]\]: `configurable`}.

    6.  Let `id` be `attr`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    7.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow⑤"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        `id`, `desc`).

    8.  If `attr`’s type is an <a href="#dfn-observable-array-type"
        id="ref-for-dfn-observable-array-type④" data-link-type="dfn">observable
        array type</a> with type argument `T`, then set `target`’s
        <a href="#backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
        id="ref-for-backing-observable-array-exotic-object①"
        data-link-type="dfn">backing observable array exotic object</a>
        for `attr` to the result of
        <a href="#creating-an-observable-array-exotic-object"
        id="ref-for-creating-an-observable-array-exotic-object"
        data-link-type="dfn">creating an observable array exotic object</a>
        in `realm`, given `T`, `attr`’s
        <a href="#observable-array-attribute-set-an-indexed-value"
        id="ref-for-observable-array-attribute-set-an-indexed-value④"
        data-link-type="dfn">set an indexed value</a> algorithm, and
        `attr`’s
        <a href="#observable-array-attribute-delete-an-indexed-value"
        id="ref-for-observable-array-attribute-delete-an-indexed-value④"
        data-link-type="dfn">delete an indexed value</a> algorithm.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="attribute getter">

The <span id="dfn-attribute-getter" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">attribute getter</span> is created as follows,
given an <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑤⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> `attribute`, a
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④③"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> or
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `target`, and a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③④" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps:

    1.  Try running the following steps:

        1.  Let `idlObject` be null.

        2.  If `target` is an
            <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨③"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, and `attribute` is a
            <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">regular attribute</a>:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be the this value, if it is not null or
                undefined, or `realm`’s <a
                href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
                id="ref-for-concept-realm-global④" data-link-type="dfn">global
                object</a> otherwise. (This will subsequently cause a
                <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①④"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>
                in a few steps, if the global object does not implement
                `target` and
                \[<a href="#LegacyLenientThis" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientThis⑥"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientThis</code></a>\]
                is not specified.)

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object②"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, `attribute`’s
                <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, and "getter".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements①⑨"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `target`, then:

                1.  If `attribute` was specified with the
                    \[<a href="#LegacyLenientThis" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientThis⑦"
                    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientThis</code></a>\]
                    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⑥"
                    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then
                    return undefined.

                2.  Otherwise,
                    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⓪"
                    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⓪"
                    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  If `attribute`’s type is an
                <a href="#dfn-observable-array-type"
                id="ref-for-dfn-observable-array-type⑤" data-link-type="dfn">observable
                array type</a>, then return `jsValue`’s
                <a href="#backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
                id="ref-for-backing-observable-array-exotic-object②"
                data-link-type="dfn">backing observable array exotic object</a>
                for `attribute`.

            5.  Set `idlObject` to the IDL
                <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface①⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
                represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        3.  Let `R` be the result of running the
            <a href="#getter-steps" id="ref-for-getter-steps⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">getter steps</a> of `attribute` with
            `idlObject` as
            <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③⓪" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>.

        4.  Return the result of
            <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑤⑨"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `R` to a JavaScript
            value of the type `attribute` is declared as.

    And then, if
    <a href="#an-exception-was-thrown" id="ref-for-an-exception-was-thrown"
    data-link-type="dfn">an exception <var>E</var> was thrown</a>:

    1.  If `attribute`’s type is a
        <a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type⑨"
        data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a>, then return
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑥⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call⑥" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-promise.reject"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise.reject" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise.reject%</code></a>, <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>, «`E`»).

    2.  Otherwise, end these steps and allow the exception to propagate.

2.  Let `name` be the string "`get `" prepended to `attribute`’s
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

3.  Let `F` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction⑥"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`, 0,
    `name`, « », `realm`).

4.  Return `F`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="attribute setter">

The <span id="dfn-attribute-setter" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">attribute setter</span> is created as follows,
given an <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑤⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> `attribute`, a
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④④"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> or
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `target`, and a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⑤" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  If `target` is a
    <a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a>:

    1.  Assert: `attribute` is
        <a href="#dfn-read-only" id="ref-for-dfn-read-only②⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">read only</a>.

    2.  Return undefined.

2.  If `attribute` is
    <a href="#dfn-read-only" id="ref-for-dfn-read-only②①"
    data-link-type="dfn">read only</a> and does not have a
    \[<a href="#LegacyLenientSetter" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientSetter①①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientSetter</code></a>\],
    \[<a href="#PutForwards" id="ref-for-PutForwards①⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">PutForwards</code></a>\] or
    \[<a href="#Replaceable" id="ref-for-Replaceable①①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Replaceable</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, return undefined; there
    is no
    <a href="#dfn-attribute-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute-setter⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">attribute setter</a> function.

3.  Assert: `attribute`’s type is not a
    <a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a>.

4.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps:

    1.  Let `V` be undefined.

    2.  If any arguments were passed, then set `V` to the value of the
        first argument passed.

    3.  Let `id` be `attribute`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    4.  Let `idlObject` be null.

    5.  If `attribute` is a
        <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">regular attribute</a>:

        1.  Let `jsValue` be the this value, if it is not null or
            undefined, or `realm`’s <a
            href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
            id="ref-for-concept-realm-global⑤" data-link-type="dfn">global
            object</a> otherwise. (This will subsequently cause a
            <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①⑤"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>
            in a few steps, if the global object does not implement
            `target` and
            \[<a href="#LegacyLenientThis" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientThis⑧"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientThis</code></a>\]
            is not specified.)

        2.  If `jsValue`
            <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object③"
            data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
            <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
            id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check②" data-link-type="dfn">perform
            a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, `id`, and "setter".

        3.  Let `validThis` be true if `jsValue`
            <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> `target`, or false
            otherwise.

        4.  If `validThis` is false and `attribute` was not specified
            with the
            \[<a href="#LegacyLenientThis" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientThis⑨"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientThis</code></a>\]
            <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⑧"
            data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then
            <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④①"
            data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
            id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④①"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

        5.  If `attribute` is declared with the
            \[<a href="#Replaceable" id="ref-for-Replaceable①②"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Replaceable</code></a>\]
            extended attribute, then:

            1.  Perform
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
                id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow③"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`jsValue`,
                `id`, `V`).

            2.  Return undefined.

        6.  If `validThis` is false, then return undefined.

        7.  If `attribute` is declared with a
            \[<a href="#LegacyLenientSetter" id="ref-for-LegacyLenientSetter①②"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyLenientSetter</code></a>\]
            extended attribute, then return undefined.

        8.  If `attribute` is declared with a
            \[<a href="#PutForwards" id="ref-for-PutForwards①⑥"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">PutForwards</code></a>\]
            extended attribute, then:

            1.  Let `Q` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦①" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-get-o-p"
                id="ref-for-sec-get-o-p②" data-link-type="abstract-op">Get</a>(`jsValue`,
                `id`).

            2.  If `Q`
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
                id="ref-for-sec-object-type②⑥" data-link-type="dfn"
                data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>, then
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④②"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④②"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.
