            3.  Let `forwardId` be the identifier argument of the
                \[<a href="#PutForwards" id="ref-for-PutForwards①⑦"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">PutForwards</code></a>\]
                extended attribute.

            4.  Perform
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦②" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-set-o-p-v-throw"
                id="ref-for-sec-set-o-p-v-throw" data-link-type="abstract-op">Set</a>(`Q`,
                `forwardId`, `V`, false).

            5.  Return undefined.

        9.  Set `idlObject` to the IDL
            <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface①⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
            represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        10. If `attribute`’s type is an
            <a href="#dfn-observable-array-type"
            id="ref-for-dfn-observable-array-type⑥" data-link-type="dfn">observable
            array type</a> with type argument `T`:

            1.  Let `newValues` be the result of
                <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
                id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑦②"
                data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value
                of type
                <a href="#sequence-type" id="ref-for-sequence-type②⑤"
                data-link-type="dfn">sequence&lt;<var>T</var>&gt;</a>.

            2.  Let `oa` be `idlObject`’s `attribute`’s
                <a href="#backing-observable-array-exotic-object"
                id="ref-for-backing-observable-array-exotic-object③"
                data-link-type="dfn">backing observable array exotic object</a>.

            3.  <a href="#observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-length"
                id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-length"
                data-link-type="dfn">Set the length</a> of
                `oa`.\[\[ProxyHandler\]\] to 0.

            4.  Let `i` be 0.

            5.  While `i` \< `newValues`’s
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
                id="ref-for-list-size⑦" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>:

                1.  Perform the algorithm steps given by
                    `oa`.\[\[ProxyHandler\]\].\[\[SetAlgorithm\]\],
                    given `newValues`\[`i`\] and `i`.

                2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
                    id="ref-for-list-append①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">Append</a>
                    `newValues`\[`i`\] to
                    `oa`.\[\[ProxyHandler\]\].\[\[BackingList\]\].

            6.  Return undefined.

    6.  Let `idlValue` be determined as follows:

        `attribute`’s type is an <a href="#dfn-enumeration" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration①⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">enumeration</a>  
        1.  Let `S` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-tostring"
            id="ref-for-sec-tostring⑥" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToString</a>(`V`).

        2.  If `S` is not one of the
            <a href="#dfn-enumeration-value" id="ref-for-dfn-enumeration-value⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">enumeration’s values</a>, then return
            undefined.

        3.  Otherwise, `idlValue` is the enumeration value equal to `S`.

        Otherwise  
        `idlValue` is the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑦③"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value of
        `attribute`’s type.

    7.  Perform the <a href="#setter-steps" id="ref-for-setter-steps④"
        data-link-type="dfn">setter steps</a> of `attribute`, with
        `idlObject` as
        <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③①" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
        and `idlValue` as
        <a href="#the-given-value" id="ref-for-the-given-value②"
        data-link-type="dfn">the given value</a>.

    8.  Return undefined

5.  Let `name` be the string "`set `" prepended to `id`.

6.  Let `F` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction⑦"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`, 1,
    `name`, « », `realm`).

7.  Return `F`.

</div>

<span class="marker">Note:</span> Although there is only a single
property for an IDL attribute, since accessor property getters and
setters are passed a
<a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③②" data-link-type="dfn">this</a> value
for the object on which property corresponding to the IDL attribute is
accessed, they are able to expose instance-specific data.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> Attempting to assign to a property
corresponding to a <a href="#dfn-read-only" id="ref-for-dfn-read-only②②"
data-link-type="dfn">read only</a>
<a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑤⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a> results in different behavior
depending on whether the script doing so is in strict mode. When in
strict mode, such an assignment will result in a
<a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a> being
thrown. When not in strict mode, the assignment attempt will be ignored.

#### <span class="secno">3.7.7. </span><span id="es-operations" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Operations</span><a href="#js-operations" class="self-link"></a>

For each unique <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑦⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①①"
data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a>
<a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation⑤⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> defined on the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, there exist a corresponding
property.
<a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">Static operations</a> are exposed of the
<a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object②②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a>.
<a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">Regular operations</a> are exposed on the
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>, unless the
operation is <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> or the interface was declared with
the \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②①" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①③⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, in which case they are
exposed on every object that
<a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②①"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> the interface.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the regular operations">

To <span id="define-the-regular-operations" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the regular operations</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⑥" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `operations` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular operations</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
    id="ref-for-list-remove①" data-link-type="dfn">Remove</a> from
    `operations` all the
    <a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation⑥⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">operations</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
    id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a>.

3.  <a href="#define-the-operations" id="ref-for-define-the-operations"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the operations</a> `operations` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the static operations">

To <span id="define-the-static-operations" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the static operations</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⑦" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `operations` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list①⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">static operations</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="#define-the-operations" id="ref-for-define-the-operations①"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the operations</a> `operations` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="define the unforgeable regular operations">

To <span id="define-the-unforgeable-regular-operations"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the
unforgeable regular operations</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⑧" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  Let `operations` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of
    <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
    id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a>
    <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular operations</a> that are
    <a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">members</a> of `definition`.

2.  <a href="#define-the-operations" id="ref-for-define-the-operations②"
    data-link-type="dfn">Define the operations</a> `operations` of
    `definition` on `target` given `realm`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the operations">

To <span id="define-the-operations" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the operations</span> `operations` of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface①⑨⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> or
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace④⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm③⑨" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①③" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
    <a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation⑥①"
    data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> `op` of `operations`:

    1.  If `op` is not <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①②"
        data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="ref-for-iteration-continue②" data-link-type="dfn">continue</a>.

    2.  Let `method` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-create-operation-function"
        id="ref-for-dfn-create-operation-function①"
        data-link-type="dfn">creating an operation function</a> given
        `op`, `definition`, and `realm`.

    3.  Let `modifiable` be false if `op` is
        <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
        id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> and true otherwise.

    4.  Let `desc` be the PropertyDescriptor{\[\[Value\]\]: `method`,
        \[\[Writable\]\]: `modifiable`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true,
        \[\[Configurable\]\]: `modifiable`}.

    5.  Let `id` be `op`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⓪"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    6.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦④" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow⑥"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        `id`, `desc`).

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="creating an operation function">

To <span id="dfn-create-operation-function" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="creating an operation function" noexport="">create an
operation function</span>, given an
<a href="#dfn-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-operation⑥②"
data-link-type="dfn">operation</a> `op`, a
<a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace⑤⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> or
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `target`, and a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⓪" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `id` be `op`’s
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧①"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

2.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps, given function
    argument values `args`:

    1.  Try running the following steps:

        1.  Let `idlObject` be null.

        2.  If `target` is an
            <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪①"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, and `op` is not a
            <a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">static operation</a>:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be the this value, if it is not null or
                undefined, or `realm`’s <a
                href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
                id="ref-for-concept-realm-global⑥" data-link-type="dfn">global
                object</a> otherwise. (This will subsequently cause a
                <a href="#exceptiondef-typeerror" id="ref-for-exceptiondef-typeerror①⑦"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>
                in a few steps, if the global object does not implement
                `target`.)

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object④"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check③" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, `id`, and
                "method".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②②"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> the interface
                `target`,
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④③"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④③"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  Set `idlObject` to the IDL
                <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface①⑧"
                data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
                represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        3.  Let `n` be the
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
            id="ref-for-list-size⑧" data-link-type="dfn">size</a> of
            `args`.

        4.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
            id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a>
            for
            <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③⑧"
            data-link-type="dfn">regular operations</a> (if `op` is a
            regular operation) or for
            <a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①⑧"
            data-link-type="dfn">static operations</a> (if `op` is a
            static operation) with
            <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧②"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on `target` and
            with argument count `n`, and let `S` be the result.

        5.  Let \<`operation`, `values`\> be the result of passing `S`
            and `args` to the
            <a href="#dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm"
            id="ref-for-dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">overload resolution algorithm</a>.

        6.  Let `R` be null.

        7.  If `operation` is declared with a
            \[<a href="#Default" id="ref-for-Default⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">Default</code></a>\]
            <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

            1.  Assert: `operation` <a href="#has-default-method-steps"
                id="ref-for-has-default-method-steps①" data-link-type="dfn">has default
                method steps</a>.

            2.  Set `R` to the result of running the
                <a href="#default-method-steps" id="ref-for-default-method-steps①"
                data-link-type="dfn">default method steps</a> for
                `operation`, with `idlObject` as
                <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③③" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
                and `values` as the argument values.

        8.  Otherwise, set `R` to the result of running the
            <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation`, with
            `idlObject` as
            <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③④" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
            and `values` as the argument values.

        9.  Return `R`, <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

            `R` is assumed to be an IDL value of the type `op` is
            declared to return. [\[whatwg/webidl Issue
            \#674\]](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/issues/674)

    And then, if
    <a href="#an-exception-was-thrown" id="ref-for-an-exception-was-thrown①"
    data-link-type="dfn">an exception <var>E</var> was thrown</a>:

    1.  If `op` has a
        <a href="#dfn-return-type" id="ref-for-dfn-return-type⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">return type</a> that is a
        <a href="#dfn-promise-type" id="ref-for-dfn-promise-type①①"
        data-link-type="dfn">promise type</a>, then return
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call⑦" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-promise.reject"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise.reject①" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise.reject%</code></a>, <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>, «`E`»).

    2.  Otherwise, end these steps and allow the exception to propagate.

3.  <a href="#compute-the-effective-overload-set"
    id="ref-for-compute-the-effective-overload-set⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">Compute the effective overload set</a> for
    <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation③⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular operations</a> (if `op` is a regular
    operation) or for
    <a href="#dfn-static-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-static-operation①⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">static operations</a> (if `op` is a static
    operation) with
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧③"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` on `target` and with
    argument count 0, and let `S` be the result.

4.  Let `length` be the length of the shortest argument list in the
    entries in `S`.

5.  Let `F` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction⑧"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
    `length`, `id`, « », `realm`).

6.  Return `F`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.7.1. </span><span id="es-default-operations" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Default operations</span><a href="#js-default-operations" class="self-link"></a>

A <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">regular operation</a>
<span id="has-default-method-steps" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" lt="has default method steps|have default method steps"
noexport="">has default method steps</span> if its
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧④"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> appears in the first column of the
following table. In that case, its <span id="default-method-steps"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">default method
steps</span> are those given by the algorithm linked from the second
column of the table, and the operation must have the return type given
in the third column of the table.

| <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">Identifier</a> | <a href="#default-method-steps" id="ref-for-default-method-steps②"
data-link-type="dfn">Default method steps</a> | <a href="#dfn-return-type" id="ref-for-dfn-return-type⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">Return type</a> |
|----|----|----|
| "`toJSON`" | The <a href="#default-tojson-steps" id="ref-for-default-tojson-steps①"
data-link-type="dfn">default toJSON steps</a> | <a href="#idl-object" id="ref-for-idl-object②⑥"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">object</code></a> |

A <a href="#dfn-regular-operation" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-operation④①"
data-link-type="dfn">regular operation</a> that does not
<a href="#has-default-method-steps"
id="ref-for-has-default-method-steps②" data-link-type="dfn">have default
method steps</a> must not be declared with a
\[<a href="#Default" id="ref-for-Default⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Default</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④①"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>.

###### <span class="secno">3.7.7.1.1. </span><span id="es-default-tojson" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Default toJSON operation</span><a href="#js-default-tojson" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="default toJSON steps">

The <span id="default-tojson-steps" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">default toJSON steps</span> for an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I` are:

1.  Let `map` be a new
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="ref-for-ordered-map⑨" data-link-type="dfn">ordered map</a>.

2.  Let `stack` be the result of <a href="#create-an-inheritance-stack"
    id="ref-for-create-an-inheritance-stack" data-link-type="dfn">creating
    an inheritance stack</a> for
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪③"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I`.

3.  Invoke <a href="#collect-attribute-values-of-an-inheritance-stack"
    id="ref-for-collect-attribute-values-of-an-inheritance-stack"
    data-link-type="dfn">collect attribute values of an inheritance
    stack</a> given
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③⑤" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>,
    `stack`, and `map`.

4.  Let `result` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate⑥"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-properties-of-the-object-prototype-object⑥"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Object.prototype%</code></a>).

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-iterate"
    id="ref-for-map-iterate①" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `key` →
    `value` of `map`,

    1.  Let `k` be `key` <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥①"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    2.  Let `v` be `value`
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥②"
        data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

    3.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⑥" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow④"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`result`,
        `k`, `v`).

6.  Return `result`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="collect attribute values of an inheritance stack">

To <span id="collect-attribute-values-of-an-inheritance-stack"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">collect attribute
values of an inheritance stack</span> given a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `object`, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack" id="ref-for-stack"
data-link-type="dfn">stack</a> `stack`, and an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="ref-for-ordered-map①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">ordered map</a> `map`:

1.  Let `I` be the result of
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack-pop"
    id="ref-for-stack-pop" data-link-type="dfn">popping</a> from
    `stack`.

2.  Invoke <a href="#collect-attribute-values"
    id="ref-for-collect-attribute-values" data-link-type="dfn">collect
    attribute values</a> given `object`, `I`, and `map`.

3.  If `stack` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
    id="ref-for-list-is-empty①" data-link-type="dfn">is not empty</a>,
    then invoke
    <a href="#collect-attribute-values-of-an-inheritance-stack"
    id="ref-for-collect-attribute-values-of-an-inheritance-stack①"
    data-link-type="dfn">collect attribute values of an inheritance
    stack</a> given `object`, `stack`, and `map`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="collect attribute values">

To <span id="collect-attribute-values" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">collect attribute values</span> given a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `object`, an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I`, and an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="ref-for-ordered-map①①" data-link-type="dfn">ordered map</a> `map`:

1.  If a `toJSON` operation with a
    \[<a href="#Default" id="ref-for-Default⑧" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Default</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④②"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> is declared on `I`, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①④" data-link-type="dfn">for each</a>
    <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①③"
    data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a>
    <a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">regular attribute</a> `attr` that is an
    <a href="#dfn-interface-member" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-member②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface member</a> of `I`, in order:

    1.  Let `id` be the
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of `attr`.

    2.  Let `value` be the result of running the
        <a href="#getter-steps" id="ref-for-getter-steps⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">getter steps</a> of `attr` with `object` as
        <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③⑥" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>.

    3.  If `value` is a
        <a href="#dfn-json-types" id="ref-for-dfn-json-types①③"
        data-link-type="dfn">JSON type</a>, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set" id="ref-for-map-set③"
        data-link-type="dfn">set</a> `map`\[`id`\] to `value`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create an inheritance stack">

To <span id="create-an-inheritance-stack" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">create an inheritance stack</span> for
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `I`, run the following steps:

1.  Let `stack` be a new
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack" id="ref-for-stack①"
    data-link-type="dfn">stack</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack-push"
    id="ref-for-stack-push" data-link-type="dfn">Push</a> `I` onto
    `stack`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
    id="ref-for-iteration-while①" data-link-type="dfn">While</a> `I`
    <a href="#dfn-inherit" id="ref-for-dfn-inherit①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">inherits</a> from an
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>,

    1.  Let `I` be that
        <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack-push"
        id="ref-for-stack-push①" data-link-type="dfn">Push</a> `I` onto
        `stack`.

4.  Return `stack`.

</div>

<div id="example-tojson-default-inheritance-and-mixins" class="example">

<a href="#example-tojson-default-inheritance-and-mixins"
class="self-link"></a>

Only
<a href="#dfn-regular-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-regular-attribute③⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">regular attributes</a> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">interfaces</a> that declare a `toJSON` operation
with a
\[<a href="#Default" id="ref-for-Default⑨" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Default</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④③"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> are included, even if an
<a href="#dfn-inherited-interfaces"
id="ref-for-dfn-inherited-interfaces②①" data-link-type="dfn">inherited
interface</a> declares such a `toJSON` operation. For example, consider
the following
<a href="#dfn-idl-fragment" id="ref-for-dfn-idl-fragment④⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">IDL fragment</a>:

``` webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface A {
  [Default] object toJSON();
  attribute DOMString a;
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface B : A {
  attribute DOMString b;
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface C : B {
  [Default] object toJSON();
  attribute DOMString c;
};
```

Calling the `toJSON()` method of an object implementing interface `C`
defined above would return the following JSON object:

``` highlight
{
    "a": "...",
    "c": "..."
}
```

Calling the `toJSON()` method of an object implementing interface `A`
(or `B`) defined above would return:

``` highlight
{
    "a": "..."
}
```

A `toJSON` operation can also be declared on an
<a href="#interface-mixin" id="ref-for-interface-mixin⑤⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface mixin</a> (or
<a href="#dfn-partial-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-partial-interface②⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">partial interface</a>) and is equivalent to
declaring it on the original
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②⓪⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>. For example, consider the following
<a href="#dfn-idl-fragment" id="ref-for-dfn-idl-fragment④⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">IDL fragment</a>:

``` webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface D {
  attribute DOMString d;
};

interface mixin M {
  [Default] object toJSON();
  attribute DOMString m;
};

D includes M;
```

Calling the `toJSON()` method of an object implementing interface `D`
defined above would return:

``` highlight
{
    "d": "...",
    "m": "..."
}
```

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.7.8. </span><span id="es-stringifier" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Stringifiers</span><a href="#js-stringifier" class="self-link"></a>

If the <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> has an
<a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①④"
data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a>
<a href="#dfn-stringifier" id="ref-for-dfn-stringifier④"
data-link-type="dfn">stringifier</a>, then there must exist a property
with the following characteristics:

- The name of the property is "`toString`".

- If the <a href="#dfn-stringifier" id="ref-for-dfn-stringifier⑤"
  data-link-type="dfn">stringifier</a> is
  <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
  id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface⑨"
  data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> on the interface or if the
  interface was declared with the
  \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②②" data-link-type="idl"><code
  class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
  <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④④"
  data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then the property exists
  on every object that <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②③"
  data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> the interface. Otherwise, the
  property exists on the <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
  id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②⓪"
  data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>.

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: `B`,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: `B` }, where `B` is
  false if the stringifier is <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
  id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface①⓪"
  data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> on the interface, and true
  otherwise.

- <div class="algorithm"
  algorithm="to invoke the toString method of interfaces">

  The value of the property is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①⓪"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a>, which behaves as
  follows:

  1.  Let `thisValue` be the this value.

  2.  Let `O` be
      <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
      id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
      <a
      href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
      id="ref-for-sec-toobject①" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(`thisValue`).

  3.  If `O`
      <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object⑤"
      data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
      <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
      id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check④" data-link-type="dfn">perform
      a security check</a>, passing:

      - the platform object `O`,

      - the <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of the
        <a href="#dfn-stringifier" id="ref-for-dfn-stringifier⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">stringifier</a>, and

      - the type "`method`".

  4.  If `O` does not <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②④"
      data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> the
      <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①①"
      data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> on which the stringifier was
      declared, then
      <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④④"
      data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
      href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
      id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④④"
      data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

  5.  Let `V` be an uninitialized variable.

  6.  Depending on how `stringifier` was specified:

      as a declaration  
      Set `V` to the result of performing the
      <a href="#dfn-stringification-behavior"
      id="ref-for-dfn-stringification-behavior①"
      data-link-type="dfn">stringification behavior</a> of the
      interface.

      on an <a href="#dfn-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-attribute⑥⓪"
      data-link-type="dfn">attribute</a>  
      Set `V` to the result of running the
      <a href="#getter-steps" id="ref-for-getter-steps⑦"
      data-link-type="dfn">getter steps</a> of the attribute (or those
      listed in the <a href="#getter-steps" id="ref-for-getter-steps⑧"
      data-link-type="dfn">getter steps</a> of the inherited attribute,
      if this attribute is declared to
      <a href="#dfn-inherit-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-inherit-getter①"
      data-link-type="dfn">inherit its getter</a>), with `O` as
      <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③⑦" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>.

  7.  Return the result of
      <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥③"
      data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to a String value.

  </div>

- The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object①①" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `length` property is the Number value 0.

- The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object①②" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `name` property is the String value "`toString`".

#### <span class="secno">3.7.9. </span><span id="es-iterable" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Iterable declarations</span><a href="#js-iterable" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="define the iteration methods">

To <span id="define-the-iteration-methods" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport=""><span id="es-iterable-values"
class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-iterable-keys"
class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-iterable-entries"
class="bs-old-id"></span>define the iteration methods</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④①" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  If `definition` has an <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-getter"
    id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-getter⑦" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
    property getter</a>, then:

    1.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②④" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>,
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-array.prototype.values"
        id="ref-for-sec-array.prototype.values" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Array.prototype.values%</code></a>, false).

    2.  If `definition` has a
        <a href="#dfn-value-iterator" id="ref-for-dfn-value-iterator⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">value iterator</a>, then:

        1.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow⑤"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`entries`",
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-array.prototype.entries"
            id="ref-for-sec-array.prototype.entries" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Array.prototype.entries%</code></a>).

        2.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑦⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow⑥"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`keys`",
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-array.prototype.keys"
            id="ref-for-sec-array.prototype.keys" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Array.prototype.keys%</code></a>).

        3.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow⑦"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`values`",
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-array.prototype.values"
            id="ref-for-sec-array.prototype.values①" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Array.prototype.values%</code></a>).

        4.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧①" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow⑧"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`forEach`",
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-array.prototype.foreach"
            id="ref-for-sec-array.prototype.foreach" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Array.prototype.forEach%</code></a>).

2.  Otherwise, if `definition` has a
    <a href="#dfn-pair-iterator" id="ref-for-dfn-pair-iterator③"
    data-link-type="dfn">pair iterator</a>, then:

    1.  Define the <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a> and `entries` methods:

        1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧②" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-toobject②" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
                value).

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check⑤" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`,
                "`%Symbol.iterator%`", and "`method`".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⑤"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⑤"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⑤"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  Return a newly created
                <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
                id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object" data-link-type="dfn">default
                iterator object</a> for `definition`, with `jsValue` as
                its <a href="#default-iterator-object-target"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-target"
                data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`key+value`" as its
                <a href="#default-iterator-object-kind"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-kind" data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>,
                and <a href="#default-iterator-object-index"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-index"
                data-link-type="dfn">index</a> set to 0.

        2.  Let `F` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
            id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction⑨"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
            0, "`entries`", « », `realm`).

        3.  Perform <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
            id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty①"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
            id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a>, `F`, false).

        4.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧③" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow⑨"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`entries`", `F`).

    2.  Define the `keys` method:

        1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-toobject③" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
                value).

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object⑦"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check⑥" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, "`keys`", and
                "`method`".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⑥"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  Return a newly created
                <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
                id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object①" data-link-type="dfn">default
                iterator object</a> for `definition`, with `jsValue` as
                its <a href="#default-iterator-object-target"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-target①"
                data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`key`" as its
                <a href="#default-iterator-object-kind"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-kind①" data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>,
                and <a href="#default-iterator-object-index"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-index①"
                data-link-type="dfn">index</a> set to 0.

        2.  Let `F` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
            id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⓪"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
            0, "`keys`", « », `realm`).

        3.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①⓪"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`keys`", `F`).

    3.  Define the `values` method:

        1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-toobject④" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
                value).

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object⑧"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check⑦" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, "`values`", and
                "`method`".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⑦"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⑦"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⑦"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  Return a newly created
                <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
                id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object②" data-link-type="dfn">default
                iterator object</a> for `definition`, with `jsValue` as
                its <a href="#default-iterator-object-target"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-target②"
                data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`value`" as its
                <a href="#default-iterator-object-kind"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-kind②" data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>,
                and <a href="#default-iterator-object-index"
                id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-index②"
                data-link-type="dfn">index</a> set to 0.

        2.  Let `F` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
            id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①①"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
            0, "`values`", « », `realm`).

        3.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①①"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`values`", `F`).

    4.  Define the `forEach` method:

        1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps, given function
            argument values `callback` and `thisArg`:

            1.  Let `jsValue` be
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
                id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
                <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-toobject⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
                value).

            2.  If `jsValue`
                <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object⑨"
                data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
                <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
                id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check⑧" data-link-type="dfn">perform
                a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, "`forEach`",
                and "`method`".

            3.  If `jsValue` does not
                <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⑧"
                data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
                <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⑧"
                data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
                id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⑧"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

            4.  Let `idlCallback` be `callback`,
                <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
                id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑦④"
                data-link-type="dfn">converted</a> to a
                <a href="#Function" id="ref-for-Function" data-link-type="idl"><code
                class="idl">Function</code></a>.

            5.  Let `idlObject` be the IDL
                <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface①⑨"
                data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
                represents a reference to `jsValue`.

            6.  Let `pairs` be `idlObject`’s list of
                <a href="#dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over"
                id="ref-for-dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over①" data-link-type="dfn">value
                pairs to iterate over</a>.

            7.  Let `i` be 0.

            8.  While `i` \< `pairs`’s
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
                id="ref-for-list-size⑨" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>:

                1.  Let `pair` be `pairs`\[`i`\].

                2.  <a href="#invoke-a-callback-function"
                    id="ref-for-invoke-a-callback-function" data-link-type="dfn">Invoke</a>
                    `idlCallback` with « `pair`’s
                    <a href="#value-pair-value" id="ref-for-value-pair-value①"
                    data-link-type="dfn">value</a>, `pair`’s
                    <a href="#value-pair-key" id="ref-for-value-pair-key①"
                    data-link-type="dfn">key</a>, `idlObject` » and with
                    `thisArg` as the
                    <a href="#dfn-callback-this-value" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-this-value"
                    data-link-type="dfn">callback this value</a>.

                3.  Set `pairs` to `idlObject`’s current list of
                    <a href="#dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over"
                    id="ref-for-dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over②" data-link-type="dfn">value
                    pairs to iterate over</a>. (It might have changed.)

                4.  Set `i` to `i` + 1.

        2.  Let `F` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
            id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①②"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
            1, "`forEach`", « », `realm`).

        3.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑧⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①②"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
            "`forEach`", `F`).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.9.1. </span><span id="es-default-iterator-object" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Default iterator objects</span><a href="#js-default-iterator-object" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="dfn-default-iterator-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">default iterator object</span> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, target and iteration kind is an
object whose \[\[Prototype\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a> is the
<a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object①"
data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> for the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>.

A <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object③" data-link-type="dfn">default
iterator object</a> has three internal values:

- its <span id="default-iterator-object-target" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="default iterator object" dfn-type="dfn"
  noexport="">target</span>, which is an object whose values are to be
  iterated,

- its <span id="default-iterator-object-kind" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="default iterator object" dfn-type="dfn"
  noexport="">kind</span>, which is the iteration kind,

- its <span id="default-iterator-object-index" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
  dfn-for="default iterator object" dfn-type="dfn"
  noexport="">index</span>, which is the current index into the values
  to be iterated.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> Default iterator objects are only used
for <a href="#dfn-pair-iterator" id="ref-for-dfn-pair-iterator④"
data-link-type="dfn">pair iterators</a>;
<a href="#dfn-value-iterator" id="ref-for-dfn-value-iterator⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">value iterators</a>, as they are currently
restricted to iterating over an object’s
<a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">supported indexed properties</a>, use standard
JavaScript Array iterator objects.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object④" data-link-type="dfn">Default
iterator objects</a> do not have
<a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string③"
data-link-type="dfn">class strings</a>; when
`Object.prototype.toString()` is called on a
<a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object⑤" data-link-type="dfn">default
iterator object</a> of a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, the
<a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string④"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of the
<a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object②"
data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> of that
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is used.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.9.2. </span><span id="es-iterator-prototype-object" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Iterator prototype object</span><a href="#js-iterator-prototype-object" class="self-link"></a>

The <span id="dfn-iterator-prototype-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">iterator prototype object</span> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is an object that exists for every
interface that has a
<a href="#dfn-pair-iterator" id="ref-for-dfn-pair-iterator⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">pair iterator</a>. It serves as the prototype for
<a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object⑥" data-link-type="dfn">default
iterator objects</a> for the interface.

The \[\[Prototype\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object③"
data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> must be <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-%25iterator.prototype%25-object"
id="ref-for-sec-%25iterator.prototype%25-object"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%Iterator.prototype%</code></a>.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="iterator result">

The <span id="iterator-result" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
noexport="">iterator result</span> for a
<a href="#value-pair" id="ref-for-value-pair⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">value pair</a> `pair` and a kind `kind` is given by
the following steps:

1.  Let `result` be a value determined by the value of `kind`:

    "`key`"  
    1.  Let `idlKey` be `pair`’s
        <a href="#value-pair-key" id="ref-for-value-pair-key②"
        data-link-type="dfn">key</a>.

    2.  Let `key` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥④"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `idlKey` to a JavaScript
        value.

    3.  `result` is `key`.

    "`value`"  
    1.  Let `idlValue` be `pair`’s
        <a href="#value-pair-value" id="ref-for-value-pair-value②"
        data-link-type="dfn">value</a>.

    2.  Let `value` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `idlValue` to a JavaScript
        value.

    3.  `result` is `value`.

    "`key+value`"  
    1.  Let `idlKey` be `pair`’s
        <a href="#value-pair-key" id="ref-for-value-pair-key③"
        data-link-type="dfn">key</a>.

    2.  Let `idlValue` be `pair`’s
        <a href="#value-pair-value" id="ref-for-value-pair-value③"
        data-link-type="dfn">value</a>.

    3.  Let `key` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `idlKey` to a JavaScript
        value.

    4.  Let `value` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `idlValue` to a JavaScript
        value.

    5.  Let `array` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-arraycreate"
        id="ref-for-sec-arraycreate"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">ArrayCreate</a>(2).

    6.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨①" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`array`,
        "`0`", `key`).

    7.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨②" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①④"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`array`,
        "`1`", `value`).

    8.  `result` is `array`.

2.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`result`,
    false).

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the next property of iterators">

An <a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object④"
data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> must have a `next`
data property with attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
\[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true } and whose value
is a <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①①"
data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> that behaves as
follows:

1.  Let `interface` be the
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> for which the
    <a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> exists.

2.  Let `thisValue` be the this value.

3.  Let `object` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-toobject⑥" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(`thisValue`).

4.  If `object`
    <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
    <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check⑨" data-link-type="dfn">perform
    a security check</a>, passing:

    - the platform object `object`,

    - the identifier "`next`", and

    - the type "`method`".

5.  If `object` is not a <a href="#dfn-default-iterator-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-default-iterator-object⑦" data-link-type="dfn">default
    iterator object</a> for `interface`, then
    <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw④⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror④⑨"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

6.  Let `index` be `object`’s <a href="#default-iterator-object-index"
    id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-index③"
    data-link-type="dfn">index</a>.

7.  Let `kind` be `object`’s <a href="#default-iterator-object-kind"
    id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-kind③" data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>.

8.  Let `values` be `object`’s <a href="#default-iterator-object-target"
    id="ref-for-default-iterator-object-target③"
    data-link-type="dfn">target</a>’s
    <a href="#dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over"
    id="ref-for-dfn-value-pairs-to-iterate-over③" data-link-type="dfn">value
    pairs to iterate over</a>.

9.  Let `len` be the length of `values`.

10. If `index` is greater than or equal to `len`, then return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(undefined,
    true).

11. Let `pair` be the entry in `values` at index `index`.

12. Set `object`’s index to `index` + 1.

13. Return the <a href="#iterator-result" id="ref-for-iterator-result"
    data-link-type="dfn">iterator result</a> for `pair` and `kind`.

</div>

The <a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-iterator-prototype-object⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">iterator prototype object</a> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is the result of concatenating the
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> and the string "` Iterator`".

#### <span class="secno">3.7.10. </span><span id="es-asynchronous-iterable" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Asynchronous iterable declarations</span><a href="#js-asynchronous-iterable" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="define the asynchronous iteration methods">

To <span id="define-the-asynchronous-iteration-methods"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the
asynchronous iteration methods</span> of
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `definition` on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④②" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, run the
following steps:

1.  If `definition` does not have an an
    <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration①⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a> (of
    either sort), then return.

2.  Assert: `definition` does not have an
    <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-getter"
    id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-getter⑧" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
    property getter</a> or an <a href="#dfn-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-dfn-iterable-declaration①②" data-link-type="dfn">iterable
    declaration</a>.

3.  If `definition` has a
    <a href="#pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration②"
    data-link-type="dfn">pair asynchronously iterable declaration</a>,
    then define the <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
    id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a> and `entries` methods:

    1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps, given function
        argument values `args`:

        1.  Let `jsValue` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-toobject⑦" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
            value).

        2.  If `jsValue`
            <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①①"
            data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
            <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
            id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">perform
            a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`,
            "`%Symbol.asyncIterator%`", and "`method`".

        3.  If `jsValue` does not
            <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements②⑨"
            data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
            <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw⑤⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
            id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤⓪"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

        4.  Let `idlObject` be the IDL
            <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface②⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
            represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        5.  Let `idlArgs` be the result of
            <a href="#converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method"
            id="ref-for-converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting arguments for an asynchronous iterator
            method</a> given `args`.

        6.  Let `iterator` be a newly created
            <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
            id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
            data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject` as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
            data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`key+value`" as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
            data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>, and
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
            data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> set to false.

        7.  Run the
            <a href="#asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps"
            id="ref-for-asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps②"
            data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator initialization steps</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject`, `iterator`, and
            `idlArgs`, if any such steps exist.

        8.  Return `iterator`.

    2.  Let `F` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
        0, "`entries`", « », `realm`).

    3.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty②"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②⑧" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a>, `F`, false).

    4.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①⑤"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        "`entries`", `F`).

4.  If `definition` has a
    <a href="#pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration③"
    data-link-type="dfn">pair asynchronously iterable declaration</a>,
    then define the `keys` method:

    1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps, given function
        argument values `args`:

        1.  Let `jsValue` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-toobject⑧" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
            value).

        2.  If `jsValue`
            <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①②"
            data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
            <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
            id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①①" data-link-type="dfn">perform
            a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, "`keys`", and
            "`method`".

        3.  If `jsValue` does not
            <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
            <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw⑤①"
            data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
            id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤①"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

        4.  Let `idlObject` be the IDL
            <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface②①"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
            represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        5.  Let `idlArgs` be the result of
            <a href="#converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method"
            id="ref-for-converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method①"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting arguments for an asynchronous iterator
            method</a> given `args`.

        6.  Let `iterator` be a newly created
