            <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
            id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object①"
            data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject` as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target①"
            data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`key`" as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind①"
            data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>, and
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished①"
            data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> set to false.

        7.  Run the
            <a href="#asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps"
            id="ref-for-asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps③"
            data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator initialization steps</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject`, `iterator`, and
            `idlArgs`, if any such steps exist.

        8.  Return `iterator`.

    2.  Let `F` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①④"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
        0, "`keys`, « », `realm`).

    3.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①⑥"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        "`keys`", `F`).

5.  Define the `values`, and possibly <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
    id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols②⑨" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a>, methods:

    1.  Let `steps` be the following series of steps, given function
        argument values `args`:

        1.  Let `jsValue` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-toobject⑨" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(this
            value).

        2.  If `jsValue`
            <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①③"
            data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
            <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
            id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①②" data-link-type="dfn">perform
            a security check</a>, passing `jsValue`, "`values`", and
            "`method`".

        3.  If `jsValue` does not
            <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③①"
            data-link-type="dfn">implement</a> `definition`, then
            <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw⑤②"
            data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
            id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤②"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

        4.  Let `idlObject` be the IDL
            <a href="#idl-interface" id="ref-for-idl-interface②②"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface type</a> value that
            represents a reference to `jsValue`.

        5.  Let `idlArgs` be the result of
            <a href="#converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method"
            id="ref-for-converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method②"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting arguments for an asynchronous iterator
            method</a> given `args`.

        6.  Let `iterator` be a newly created
            <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
            id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object②"
            data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject` as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target②"
            data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, "`value`" as its
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind②"
            data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>, and
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished②"
            data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> set to false.

        7.  Run the
            <a href="#asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps"
            id="ref-for-asynchronous-iterator-initialization-steps④"
            data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator initialization steps</a>
            for `definition` with `idlObject`, `iterator`, and
            `idlArgs`, if any such steps exist.

        8.  Return `iterator`.

    2.  Let `F` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⑤"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`steps`,
        0, "`values`", « », `realm`).

    3.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands⑨⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createdatapropertyorthrow"
        id="ref-for-sec-createdatapropertyorthrow①⑦"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateDataPropertyOrThrow</a>(`target`,
        "`values`", `F`).

    4.  If `definition` has a
        <a href="#value-asynchronously-iterable-declaration"
        id="ref-for-value-asynchronously-iterable-declaration①"
        data-link-type="dfn">value asynchronously iterable declaration</a>,
        then perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
        id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols③⓪" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Symbol.asyncIterator%</code></a>, `F`, false).

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="converting arguments for an asynchronous iterator method">

To <span id="converting-arguments-for-an-asynchronous-iterator-method"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
lt="converting arguments for an asynchronous iterator method"
noexport="">convert arguments for an asynchronous iterator
method</span>, given an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `definition` that has an
<a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration①⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a> and a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②①"
data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of JavaScript values `args`:

1.  Let `idlArgs` be an empty list.

2.  Let `argCount` be the number of arguments of `definition`’s
    <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a>, or 0
    if the <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
    id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration①⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a> does
    not have an argument list.

3.  Let `i` be 0.

4.  While `i` \< `argCount`:

    1.  If `i` ≥ `args`’s
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="ref-for-list-size①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>, or if
        `args`\[`i`\] is undefined, then:

        1.  If the argument to the
            <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
            id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration②⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a>
            at index `i` is declared with a
            <a href="#dfn-optional-argument-default-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-optional-argument-default-value①⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">default value</a>, then
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="ref-for-list-append①①" data-link-type="dfn">append</a>
            that default value to `idlArgs`.

        2.  Otherwise,
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="ref-for-list-append①②" data-link-type="dfn">append</a>
            to `idlArgs` the special value "missing".

    2.  Otherwise, <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="ref-for-list-append①③" data-link-type="dfn">append</a> to
        `idlArgs` the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑦⑤"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `args`\[`i`\] to the IDL
        type given in the <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
        id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration②①"
        data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a>’s
        argument list at index `i`.

    3.  Set `i` to `i` + 1.

5.  Return `idlArgs`.

This is essentially a hyper-specialization of the
<a href="#dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm"
id="ref-for-dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">overload resolution algorithm</a> for the case
where no overloads are allowed and all arguments are optional.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.10.1. </span><span id="es-default-asynchronous-iterator-object" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Default asynchronous iterator objects</span><a href="#js-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="default asynchronous iterator object">default asynchronous iterator
object</span> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, target and iteration kind is an
object whose \[\[Prototype\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots①⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a> is the
<a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> for the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>.

A <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object③"
data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a> has
internal values:

- its <span id="default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
  class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="default asynchronous iterator object"
  dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">target</span>, which is an object whose
  values are to be iterated,

- its <span id="default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
  class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="default asynchronous iterator object"
  dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">kind</span>, which is the iteration kind,

- its <span id="default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
  class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="default asynchronous iterator object"
  dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">ongoing promise</span>, which is a
  <a href="#idl-promise" id="ref-for-idl-promise②⓪"
  data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">Promise</code></a> or null,

- its <span id="default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
  class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-for="default asynchronous iterator object"
  dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">is finished</span>, which is a boolean.

<span class="marker">Note:</span>
<a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object④"
data-link-type="dfn">Default asynchronous iterator objects</a> do not
have <a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">class strings</a>; when
`Object.prototype.toString()` is called on a
<a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a> of a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, the
<a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of the
<a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object①"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> of that
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is used.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.10.2. </span><span id="es-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Asynchronous iterator prototype object</span><a href="#js-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
class="self-link"></a>

The <span id="dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">asynchronous iterator
prototype object</span> for a given
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is an object that exists for every
interface that has an <a href="#dfn-async-iterable-declaration"
id="ref-for-dfn-async-iterable-declaration②②"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronously iterable declaration</a>. It serves
as the prototype for <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator objects</a> for the
interface.

The \[\[Prototype\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots②⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object②"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> must be
<a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-asynciteratorprototype"
id="ref-for-sec-asynciteratorprototype" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">%AsyncIteratorPrototype%</code></a>.

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the next property of asynchronous iterators">

An <a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object③"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> must
have a `next` data property with attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
\[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true } and whose value
is a <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①②"
data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> that behaves as
follows:

1.  Let `interface` be the
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> for which the
    <a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object④"
    data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a>
    exists.

2.  Let `thisValidationPromiseCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪①" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability⑤"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

3.  Let `thisValue` be the this value.

4.  Let `object` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-completion-record-specification-type③"
    data-link-type="abstract-op" data-refhint-key="8231699a">Completion</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-toobject①⓪" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(`thisValue`)).

5.  <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-ifabruptrejectpromise"
    id="ref-for-sec-ifabruptrejectpromise"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IfAbruptRejectPromise</a>(`object`,
    `thisValidationPromiseCapability`).

6.  If `object`
    <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
    <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①③" data-link-type="dfn">perform
    a security check</a>, passing:

    - the platform object `object`,

    - the identifier "`next`", and

    - the type "`method`".

    If this threw an exception `e`, then:

    1.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪②" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call⑧" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`thisValidationPromiseCapability`.\[\[Reject\]\],
        undefined, « `e` »).

    2.  Return `thisValidationPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

7.  If `object` is not a
    <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a> for
    `interface`, then:

    1.  Let `error` be a new <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤③"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪③" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call⑨" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`thisValidationPromiseCapability`.\[\[Reject\]\],
        undefined, « `error` »).

    3.  Return `thisValidationPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

8.  Let `nextSteps` be the following steps:

    1.  Let `nextPromiseCapability` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪④" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
        id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability⑥"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor⑧" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

    2.  If `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished③"
        data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> is true, then:

        1.  Let `result` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject②"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(undefined,
            true).

        2.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⑤" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
            id="ref-for-sec-call①⓪" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`nextPromiseCapability`.\[\[Resolve\]\],
            undefined, « `result` »).

        3.  Return `nextPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

    3.  Let `kind` be `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-kind③"
        data-link-type="dfn">kind</a>.

    4.  Let `nextPromise` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-get-the-next-iteration-result"
        id="ref-for-dfn-get-the-next-iteration-result①"
        data-link-type="dfn">getting the next iteration result</a> with
        `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target③"
        data-link-type="dfn">target</a> and `object`.

    5.  Let `fulfillSteps` be the following steps, given `next`:

        1.  Set `object`’s
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
            data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to null.

        2.  If `next` is
            <a href="#end-of-iteration" id="ref-for-end-of-iteration③"
            data-link-type="dfn">end of iteration</a>, then:

            1.  Set `object`’s
                <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
                id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished④"
                data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> to true.

            2.  Return <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject③"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(undefined,
                true).

        3.  Otherwise, if `interface` has a
            <a href="#pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration"
            id="ref-for-pair-asynchronously-iterable-declaration④"
            data-link-type="dfn">pair asynchronously iterable declaration</a>:

            1.  Assert: `next` is a
                <a href="#value-pair" id="ref-for-value-pair⑦"
                data-link-type="dfn">value pair</a>.

            2.  Return the
                <a href="#iterator-result" id="ref-for-iterator-result①"
                data-link-type="dfn">iterator result</a> for `next` and
                `kind`.

        4.  Otherwise:

            1.  Assert: `interface` has a
                <a href="#value-asynchronously-iterable-declaration"
                id="ref-for-value-asynchronously-iterable-declaration②"
                data-link-type="dfn">value asynchronously iterable declaration</a>.

            2.  Assert: `next` is a value of the type that appears in
                the declaration.

            3.  Let `value` be `next`,
                <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
                id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⑧"
                data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

            4.  Return <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
                id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject④"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`value`,
                false).

    6.  Let `onFulfilled` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⑥"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`fulfillSteps`,
        1, "", « »).

    7.  Let `rejectSteps` be the following steps, given `reason`:

        1.  Set `object`’s
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise①"
            data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to null.

        2.  Set `object`’s
            <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
            id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> to true.

        3.  <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw⑤③"
            data-link-type="dfn">Throw</a> `reason`.

    8.  Let `onRejected` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⑦"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`rejectSteps`,
        1, "", « »).

    9.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
        id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen②"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`nextPromise`,
        `onFulfilled`, `onRejected`, `nextPromiseCapability`).

    10. Return `nextPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

9.  Let `ongoingPromise` be `object`’s
    <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
    id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise②"
    data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a>.

10. If `ongoingPromise` is not null, then:

    1.  Let `afterOngoingPromiseCapability` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⑥" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
        id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability⑦"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor⑨" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

    2.  Let `onSettled` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⑧"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`nextSteps`,
        0, "", « »).

    3.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
        id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen③"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`ongoingPromise`,
        `onSettled`, `onSettled`, `afterOngoingPromiseCapability`).

    4.  Set `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise③"
        data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to
        `afterOngoingPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

11. Otherwise:

    1.  Set `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise④"
        data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to the result of
        running `nextSteps`.

12. Return `object`’s
    <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
    id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a>.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the return property of asynchronous iterators">

If an <a href="#asynchronous-iterator-return"
id="ref-for-asynchronous-iterator-return"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator return</a> algorithm is
defined for the <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②②⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, then the
<a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> must
have a `return` data property with attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
\[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true } and whose value
is a <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①③"
data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a>, taking one argument
`value`, that behaves as follows:

1.  Let `interface` be the
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> for which the
    <a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a>
    exists.

2.  Let `returnPromiseCapability` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
    id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability⑧"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
    id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor①⓪" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

3.  Let `thisValue` be the this value.

4.  Let `object` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-completion-record-specification-type④"
    data-link-type="abstract-op" data-refhint-key="8231699a">Completion</a>(<a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-toobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-toobject①①" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToObject</a>(`thisValue`)).

5.  <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-ifabruptrejectpromise"
    id="ref-for-sec-ifabruptrejectpromise①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">IfAbruptRejectPromise</a>(`object`,
    `returnPromiseCapability`).

6.  If `object`
    <a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a>, then
    <a href="#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
    id="ref-for-dfn-perform-a-security-check①④" data-link-type="dfn">perform
    a security check</a>, passing:

    - the platform object `object`,

    - the identifier "`return`", and

    - the type "`method`".

    If this threw an exception `e`, then:

    1.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call①①" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Reject\]\],
        undefined, « `e` »).

    2.  Return `returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

7.  If `object` is not a
    <a href="#dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object"
    id="ref-for-dfn-default-asynchronous-iterator-object⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">default asynchronous iterator object</a> for
    `interface`, then:

    1.  Let `error` be a new <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤④"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

    2.  Perform
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①⓪⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
        id="ref-for-sec-call①②" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Reject\]\],
        undefined, « `error` »).

    3.  Return `returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

8.  Let `returnSteps` be the following steps:

    1.  Let `returnPromiseCapability` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
        id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability⑨"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor①①" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

    2.  If `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> is true, then:

        1.  Let `result` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject⑤"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`value`,
            true).

        2.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①①" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
            id="ref-for-sec-call①③" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Resolve\]\],
            undefined, « `result` »).

        3.  Return `returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

    3.  Set `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-is-finished⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">is finished</a> to true.

    4.  Return the result of running the
        <a href="#asynchronous-iterator-return"
        id="ref-for-asynchronous-iterator-return①"
        data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator return</a> algorithm
        for `interface`, given `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-target④"
        data-link-type="dfn">target</a>, `object`, and `value`.

9.  Let `ongoingPromise` be `object`’s
    <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
    id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a>.

10. If `ongoingPromise` is not null, then:

    1.  Let `afterOngoingPromiseCapability` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①②" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-newpromisecapability"
        id="ref-for-sec-newpromisecapability①⓪"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">NewPromiseCapability</a>(<a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-promise-constructor"
        id="ref-for-sec-promise-constructor①②" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">%Promise%</code></a>).

    2.  Let `onSettled` be <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
        id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction①⑨"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`returnSteps`,
        0, "", « »).

    3.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
        id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen④"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`ongoingPromise`,
        `onSettled`, `onSettled`, `afterOngoingPromiseCapability`).

    4.  Set `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to
        `afterOngoingPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

11. Otherwise:

    1.  Set `object`’s
        <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
        id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a> to the result of
        running `returnSteps`.

12. Let `fulfillSteps` be the following steps:

    1.  Return <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
        id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject⑥"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`value`,
        true).

13. Let `onFulfilled` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-createbuiltinfunction"
    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction②⓪"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(`fulfillSteps`,
    1, "", « »).

14. Perform <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-performpromisethen"
    id="ref-for-sec-performpromisethen⑤"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">PerformPromiseThen</a>(`object`’s
    <a href="#default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise"
    id="ref-for-default-asynchronous-iterator-object-ongoing-promise⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">ongoing promise</a>, `onFulfilled`, undefined,
    `returnPromiseCapability`).

15. Return `returnPromiseCapability`.\[\[Promise\]\].

</div>

The <a href="#dfn-class-string" id="ref-for-dfn-class-string⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">class string</a> of an
<a href="#dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-asynchronous-iterator-prototype-object⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">asynchronous iterator prototype object</a> for a
given <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> is the result of concatenating the
<a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑧⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> of the
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> and the string "` AsyncIterator`".

#### <span class="secno">3.7.11. </span><span id="es-maplike" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Maplike declarations</span><a href="#js-maplike" class="self-link"></a>

If an <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `A` is declared with a
<a href="#dfn-maplike-declaration" id="ref-for-dfn-maplike-declaration⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">maplike declaration</a>, then there exists a number
of additional properties on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>. These additional
properties are described in the sub-sections below.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.11.1. </span><span id="es-map-size" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">size</span><a href="#js-map-size" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a `size` property on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Get\]\]: `G`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]:
  true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }, where `G` is the interface’s
  <span id="dfn-map-size-getter" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
  export="">map size getter</span>, defined below.

- <div class="algorithm" algorithm="to invoke the size method of Maps">

  The <a href="#dfn-map-size-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-map-size-getter"
  data-link-type="dfn">map size getter</a> is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①④"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> whose behavior when
  invoked is as follows:

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`size`" and type "`getter`".

  2.  Let `map` be the
      <a href="#dfn-map-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-map-entries①"
      data-link-type="dfn">map entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Return `map`’s
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-size" id="ref-for-map-size"
      data-link-type="dfn">size</a>,
      <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑥⑨"
      data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

  </div>

  The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object①③" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `length` property is the Number value 0.

  The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object①④" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `name` property is the String value "`get size`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.11.2. </span><span id="es-iterators" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-iterator" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-map-iterator" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">%Symbol.iterator%</span><a href="#js-map-iterator" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a data property whose name is the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols③①" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a> symbol on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with attributes {
\[\[Writable\]\]: true, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]:
true } and whose value is the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object①⑤" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>
that is the value of the `entries` property.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create a map iterator">

To <span id="create-a-map-iterator" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">create a map iterator</span> from a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="ref-for-ordered-map①②" data-link-type="dfn">map</a> `map` and a
`kind` which is either "`key+value`", "`key`", or "`value`":

1.  Let `closure` be a new
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-abstract-closure"
    id="ref-for-sec-abstract-closure" data-link-type="dfn">Abstract
    Closure</a> with no parameters that captures `map` and `kind` and
    performs the following steps when called:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-iterate"
        id="ref-for-map-iterate②" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
        `key` → `value` of `map`:

        1.  Set `key` and `value` to each
            <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

        2.  If `kind` is "`key`", let `result` be `key`.

        3.  Else if `kind` is "`value`", let `result` be `value`.

        4.  Else, let `result` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createarrayfromlist"
            id="ref-for-sec-createarrayfromlist"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateArrayFromList</a>(«
            `key`, `value` »).

        5.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-generatoryield"
            id="ref-for-sec-generatoryield"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">GeneratorYield</a>(<a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject⑦"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`result`,
            false)).

        <span class="marker">Note:</span> The
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-size" id="ref-for-map-size①"
        data-link-type="dfn">size</a> of `map`, and the order of its
        entries, might have changed while execution of this abstract
        operation was paused by <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-yield"
        id="ref-for-sec-yield" data-link-type="abstract-op">Yield</a>.

    2.  Return undefined.

2.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-createiteratorfromclosure"
    id="ref-for-sec-createiteratorfromclosure"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorFromClosure</a>(`closure`,
    "`%MapIteratorPrototype%`", <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/keyed-collections.html#sec-%25mapiteratorprototype%25-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-%25mapiteratorprototype%25-object"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%MapIteratorPrototype%</code></a>).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.11.3. </span><span id="es-map-entries" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">entries</span><a href="#js-map-entries" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist an `entries` data property on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects①⑤"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> whose behavior when
  invoked is as follows:

  <div class="algorithm"
  algorithm="to invoke the entries method of Maps">

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`entries`" and type "`method`".

  2.  Let `map` be the
      <a href="#dfn-map-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-map-entries②"
      data-link-type="dfn">map entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Return the result of
      <a href="#create-a-map-iterator" id="ref-for-create-a-map-iterator"
      data-link-type="dfn">creating a map iterator</a> from `map` with
      kind "`key+value`".

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object①⑥" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 0.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object①⑦" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`entries`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.11.4. </span><span id="es-map-keys-values" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-map-keys" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">keys</span><a href="#js-map-keys" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a `keys` data property on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object②⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a

data-link-type="dfn">setlike declaration</a>, then there exists a number
of additional properties on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object③③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a>. These additional
properties are described in the sub-sections below.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.1. </span><span id="es-set-size" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">size</span><a href="#js-set-size" class="self-link"></a>

A `size` property must exist on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object③④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Get\]\]: `G`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]:
  true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }, where `G` is the interface’s
  <span id="dfn-set-size-getter" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
  export="">set size getter</span>, defined below.

- <div class="algorithm" algorithm="to invoke the size method of Sets">

  The <a href="#dfn-set-size-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-set-size-getter"
  data-link-type="dfn">set size getter</a> is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects②④"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> whose behavior when
  invoked is as follows:

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①⓪"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`size`" and type "`getter`".

  2.  Let `set` be the
      <a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries①"
      data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Return `set`’s <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
      id="ref-for-list-size①①" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>,
      <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦③"
      data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

  </div>

  The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object③④" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `length` property is the Number value 0.

  The value of the <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
  id="ref-for-function-object③⑤" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
  `name` property is the String value "`get size`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.2. </span><span id="es-set-iterator" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">%Symbol.iterator%</span><a href="#js-set-iterator" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a data property whose name is the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-well-known-symbols"
id="ref-for-sec-well-known-symbols③②" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">%Symbol.iterator%</code></a> symbol on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with attributes {
\[\[Writable\]\]: true, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]:
true } and whose value is the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object③⑥" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>
that is the value of the `values` property.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="create a set iterator">

To <span id="create-a-set-iterator" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">create a set iterator</span> from a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
id="ref-for-ordered-set⑦" data-link-type="dfn">set</a> `set` and a
`kind` which is either "`key+value`" or "`value`":

1.  Let `closure` be a new
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-abstract-closure"
    id="ref-for-sec-abstract-closure①" data-link-type="dfn">Abstract
    Closure</a> with no parameters that captures `set` and `kind` and
    performs the following steps when called:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="ref-for-list-iterate①⑤" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
        `entry` of `set`:

        1.  Set `entry` to be `entry`
            <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦④"
            data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

        2.  If `kind` is "`value`", let `result` be `entry`.

        3.  Else, let `result` be <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createarrayfromlist"
            id="ref-for-sec-createarrayfromlist①"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateArrayFromList</a>(«
            `entry`, `entry` »).

        4.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-generatoryield"
            id="ref-for-sec-generatoryield①"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">GeneratorYield</a>(<a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-createiterresultobject"
            id="ref-for-sec-createiterresultobject⑧"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorResultObject</a>(`result`,
            false)).

        <span class="marker">Note:</span> The
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="ref-for-list-size①②" data-link-type="dfn">size</a> of `set`,
        and the order of its entries, might have changed while execution
        of this abstract operation was paused by <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-yield"
        id="ref-for-sec-yield①" data-link-type="abstract-op">Yield</a>.

    2.  Return undefined.

2.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/control-abstraction-objects.html#sec-createiteratorfromclosure"
    id="ref-for-sec-createiteratorfromclosure①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateIteratorFromClosure</a>(`closure`,
    "`%SetIteratorPrototype%`", <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/keyed-collections.html#sec-%25setiteratorprototype%25-object"
    id="ref-for-sec-%25setiteratorprototype%25-object"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">%SetIteratorPrototype%</code></a>).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.3. </span><span id="es-set-entries-keys" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-set-entries" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">entries</span><a href="#js-set-entries" class="self-link"></a>

id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following

  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects②⑤"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> whose behavior when

  algorithm="to invoke the entries method of Sets">

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object③⑦" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 0.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object③⑧" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`entries`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.4. </span><span id="es-set-keys" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">keys</span><a href="#js-set-keys" class="self-link"></a>

The value of the <a

id="ref-for-function-object④⓪" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s

The value of the <a

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.6. </span><span id="es-set-forEach" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">forEach</span><a href="#js-set-forEach" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a `forEach` data property on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object③⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects②⑦"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> whose behavior when
  invoked is as follows:

  <div class="algorithm"
  algorithm="to invoke the forEach method of Sets">

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①③"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`forEach`" and type "`method`".

  2.  Let `set` be the
      <a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries④"
      data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Let `callbackFn` be the first argument passed to the function, or
      undefined if not supplied.

  4.  If <a
      href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iscallable"
      id="ref-for-sec-iscallable⑧" data-link-type="abstract-op">IsCallable</a>(`callbackFn`)
      is false,
      <a href="#javascript-throw" id="ref-for-javascript-throw⑤⑤"
      data-link-type="dfn">throw</a> a <a
      href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/fundamental-objects.html#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
      id="ref-for-sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror⑤⑥"
      data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">TypeError</code></a>.

  5.  Let `thisArg` be the second argument passed to the function, or
      undefined if not supplied.

  6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-iterate"
      id="ref-for-map-iterate④" data-link-type="dfn">For each</a>
      `value` of `set`:

      1.  Let `jsValue` be `value`
          <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
          id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦⑤"
          data-link-type="dfn">converted to a JavaScript value</a>.

      2.  Perform
          <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
          id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
          <a
          href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-call"
          id="ref-for-sec-call①⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">Call</a>(`callbackFn`,
          `thisArg`, « `jsValue`, `jsValue`, `O`»).

  7.  Return undefined.

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④②" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 1.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④③" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`forEach`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.7. </span><span id="es-set-has" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">has</span><a href="#js-set-has" class="self-link"></a>

There must exist a `has` data property on `A`’s
<a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects②⑧"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> that behaves as
  follows when invoked:

  <div class="algorithm" algorithm="to invoke the has method of Sets">

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①④"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`has`" and type "`method`".

  2.  Let `set` be the
      <a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries⑤"
      data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Let `valueType` be the value type specified in the
      <a href="#dfn-setlike-declaration"
      id="ref-for-dfn-setlike-declaration①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">setlike
      declaration</a>.

  4.  Let `valueArg` be the first argument passed to this function, or
      undefined if not supplied.

  5.  Let `value` be `valueArg`
      <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑧①"
      data-link-type="dfn">converted to an IDL value</a> of type
      `valueType`.

  6.  If `value` is -0, set `value` to +0.

  7.  If `set` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
      id="ref-for-list-contain" data-link-type="dfn">contains</a>
      `value`, then return true, otherwise return false.

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④④" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is a Number value 1.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④⑤" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`has`".

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.8. </span><span id="es-add-delete" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-set-add" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">add</span><a href="#js-set-add" class="self-link"></a>

If `A` does not declare a
<a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member③③"
data-link-type="dfn">member</a> with identifier "`add`", and `A` was
declared with a read–write setlike declaration, then there must exist an
`add` data property on `A`’s <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a

  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects②⑨"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> that behaves as
  follows when invoked:

  <div class="algorithm" algorithm="to invoke the add method of Sets">

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①⑤"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`add`" and type "`method`".

  2.  Let `set` be the
      <a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries⑥"
      data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  Let `valueType` be the value type specified in the
      <a href="#dfn-setlike-declaration"
      id="ref-for-dfn-setlike-declaration①①" data-link-type="dfn">setlike
      declaration</a>.

  4.  Let `valueArg` be the first argument passed to this function, or
      undefined if not supplied.

  5.  Let `value` be `valueArg`
      <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑧②"
      data-link-type="dfn">converted to an IDL value</a> of type
      `valueType`.

  6.  If `value` is -0, set `value` to +0.

  7.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
      id="ref-for-set-append⑧" data-link-type="dfn">Append</a> `value`
      to `set`.

  8.  Return `O`.

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④⑥" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 1.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④⑦" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`add`".

If the interface does declare an `add` method, it should similarly map a
-0 value to +0, and must return the value that was set.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.9. </span><span id="es-set-delete" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">delete</span><a href="#js-set-delete" class="self-link"></a>
