  3.  Let `valueType` be the value type specified in the
      <a href="#dfn-setlike-declaration"
      id="ref-for-dfn-setlike-declaration①②" data-link-type="dfn">setlike
      declaration</a>.

  4.  Let `valueArg` be the first argument passed to this function, or
      undefined if not supplied.

  5.  Let `value` be `valueArg`
      <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
      id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑧③"
      data-link-type="dfn">converted to an IDL value</a> of type
      `valueType`.

  6.  If `value` is -0, set `value` to +0.

  7.  Let `retVal` be true if `set`
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
      id="ref-for-list-contain①" data-link-type="dfn">contains</a>
      `value`, or else false.

  8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
      id="ref-for-list-remove②" data-link-type="dfn">Remove</a> `value`
      from `set`.

  9.  Return `retVal`.

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④⑧" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 1.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object④⑨" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`delete`".

If the interface does declare a `delete` method, it should similarly map
a -0 value to +0, and must return a
<a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②①"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a> indicating
whether the value was present or not.

##### <span class="secno">3.7.12.10. </span><span id="es-set-clear" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">clear</span><a href="#js-set-clear" class="self-link"></a>

If `A` does not declare a
<a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">member</a> with identifier "`clear`", and `A` was
declared with a read–write setlike declaration, then there must exist a
`clear` data property on `A`’s <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> with the following
characteristics:

- The property has attributes { \[\[Writable\]\]: true,
  \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

- The value of the property is a
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects"
  id="ref-for-sec-built-in-function-objects③①"
  data-link-type="dfn">built-in function object</a> that behaves as
  follows when invoked:

  <div class="algorithm" algorithm="to invoke the clear method of Sets">

  1.  Let `O` be the this value,
      <a href="#implementation-check-an-object"
      id="ref-for-implementation-check-an-object①⑦"
      data-link-type="dfn">implementation-checked</a> against `A` with
      identifier "`clear`" and type "`method`".

  2.  Let `set` be the
      <a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries⑧"
      data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> of the IDL value that
      represents a reference to `O`.

  3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-empty"
      id="ref-for-list-empty" data-link-type="dfn">Empty</a> `set`.

      <span class="marker">Note:</span> The
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
      id="ref-for-ordered-set⑧" data-link-type="dfn">set</a> is
      preserved because there may be existing iterators, currently
      suspended, iterating over it.

  4.  Return undefined.

  </div>

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object⑤⓪" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`length` property is the Number value 0.

The value of the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#function-object"
id="ref-for-function-object⑤①" data-link-type="dfn">function object</a>’s
`name` property is the String value "`clear`".

If the interface does declare a `clear` method, it must preserve the
<a href="#dfn-set-entries" id="ref-for-dfn-set-entries⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">set entries</a> object (rather than generating a
new one) and must return
<a href="#idl-undefined" id="ref-for-idl-undefined①⑨"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">undefined</code></a>.

### <span class="secno">3.8. </span><span id="es-platform-objects" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Platform objects implementing interfaces</span><a href="#js-platform-objects" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="is a platform object">

A JavaScript value `value` <span id="is-a-platform-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">is a platform
object</span> if `value`
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
id="ref-for-sec-object-type②⑦" data-link-type="dfn">is an Object</a> and
if `value` has a \[\[PrimaryInterface\]\] internal slot.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="implements">

A JavaScript value `value` <span id="implements" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">implements</span> an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `interface` if `value`
<a href="#is-a-platform-object" id="ref-for-is-a-platform-object①⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">is a platform object</a> and the
<a href="#interface-inclusive-inherited-interfaces"
id="ref-for-interface-inclusive-inherited-interfaces"
data-link-type="dfn">inclusive inherited interfaces</a> of
`value`.\[\[PrimaryInterface\]\]
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
id="ref-for-list-contain②" data-link-type="dfn">contains</a>
`interface`.

Specifications may reference the concept "`object` implements
`interface`" in various ways, including "`object` is an `interface`
object".

</div>

Every <a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②①"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> is associated with a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④③" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a>, just as the
<a href="#dfn-initial-object" id="ref-for-dfn-initial-object③"
data-link-type="dfn">initial objects</a> are. This realm is stored in
the <a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②②"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a>’s \[\[Realm\]\] slot. It is the
responsibility of specifications using Web IDL to state which realm (or,
by proxy, which global object) each platform object is associated with.
In particular, the algorithms below associate the new
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②③"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> with the realm given as an
argument.

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="new">

To <span id="new" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="new">create a new object implementing the interface</span>
`interface`, with a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④④" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Return the result of
    <a href="#internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface"
    id="ref-for-internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface②"
    data-link-type="dfn">internally creating a new object implementing</a>
    `interface`, with `realm` and undefined.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="internally create a new object implementing the interface">

To <span id="internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">internally create a
new object implementing the interface</span> `interface`, with a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⑤" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm` and a
JavaScript value `newTarget`, perform the following steps:

1.  Assert: `interface` is
    <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`.

2.  If `newTarget` is undefined, then:

    1.  Let `prototype` be the <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
        id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④④"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> for
        `interface` in `realm`.

3.  Otherwise:

    1.  Assert: <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-iscallable"
        id="ref-for-sec-iscallable⑨" data-link-type="abstract-op">IsCallable</a>(`newTarget`)
        is true.

    2.  Let `prototype` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
        <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-get-o-p"
        id="ref-for-sec-get-o-p③" data-link-type="abstract-op">Get</a>(`newTarget`,
        "prototype").

    3.  If `prototype`
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type"
        id="ref-for-sec-object-type②⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="df9c128d">is not an Object</a>, then:

        1.  Let `targetRealm` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⑧" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
            <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-getfunctionrealm"
            id="ref-for-sec-getfunctionrealm"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">GetFunctionRealm</a>(`newTarget`).

        2.  Set `prototype` to the
            <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
            id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> for
            `interface` in `targetRealm`.

4.  Let `slots` be « \[\[Prototype\]\], \[\[Extensible\]\],
    \[\[Realm\]\], \[\[PrimaryInterface\]\] ».

5.  If `interface` is
    <a href="#idl-DOMException" id="ref-for-idl-DOMException④⑤"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">DOMException</code></a>,
    append \[\[ErrorData\]\] to `slots`.

6.  Let `instance` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-makebasicobject"
    id="ref-for-sec-makebasicobject②"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">MakeBasicObject</a>(`slots`).

7.  Set `instance`.\[\[Realm\]\] to `realm`.

8.  Set `instance`.\[\[PrimaryInterface\]\] to `interface`.

9.  Set `instance`.\[\[Prototype\]\] to `prototype`.

10. Let `interfaces` be the
    <a href="#interface-inclusive-inherited-interfaces"
    id="ref-for-interface-inclusive-inherited-interfaces①"
    data-link-type="dfn">inclusive inherited interfaces</a> of
    `interface`.

11. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①⑥" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> `ancestor interface` in
    `interfaces`:

    1.  Let `unforgeables` be the value of the \[\[Unforgeables\]\] slot
        of the
        <a href="#dfn-interface-object" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-object②③"
        data-link-type="dfn">interface object</a> of
        `ancestor interface` in `realm`.

    2.  Let `keys` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①①⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a>
        `unforgeables`.\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]().

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②②"
        data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> element `key` of `keys`:

        1.  Let `descriptor` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⓪" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a>
            `unforgeables`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](`key`).

        2.  Perform
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
            id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②①" data-link-type="dfn"
            data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
            id="ref-for-sec-definepropertyorthrow⑦"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(`instance`,
            `key`, `descriptor`).

12. If `interface` is declared with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②③" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

    1.  <a href="#define-the-regular-operations"
        id="ref-for-define-the-regular-operations①" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the regular operations</a> of `interface` on `instance`, given
        `realm`.

    2.  <a href="#define-the-regular-attributes"
        id="ref-for-define-the-regular-attributes①" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the regular attributes</a> of `interface` on `instance`, given
        `realm`.

    3.  <a href="#define-the-iteration-methods"
        id="ref-for-define-the-iteration-methods①" data-link-type="dfn">Define
        the iteration methods</a> of `interface` on `instance` given
        `realm`.

    4.  <a href="#define-the-asynchronous-iteration-methods"
        id="ref-for-define-the-asynchronous-iteration-methods①"
        data-link-type="dfn">Define the asynchronous iteration methods</a>
        of `interface` on `instance` given `realm`.

    5.  <a href="#define-the-global-property-references"
        id="ref-for-define-the-global-property-references"
        data-link-type="dfn">Define the global property references</a>
        on `instance`, given `realm`.

    6.  Set `instance`.\[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] as defined in [§ 3.8.1
        \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\]](#platform-object-setprototypeof).

13. Otherwise, if `interfaces` contains an
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> which
    <a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports indexed properties</a>,
    <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties⑥" data-link-type="dfn">named
    properties</a>, or both:

    1.  Set `instance`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] as defined in
        <a href="#legacy-platform-object-getownproperty"
        id="ref-for-legacy-platform-object-getownproperty①">§ 3.9.1
        [[GetOwnProperty]]</a>.

    2.  Set `instance`.\[\[Set\]\] as defined in [§ 3.9.2
        \[\[Set\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-set).

    3.  Set `instance`.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] as defined in [§ 3.9.3
        \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-defineownproperty).

    4.  Set `instance`.\[\[Delete\]\] as defined in [§ 3.9.4
        \[\[Delete\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-delete).

    5.  Set `instance`.\[\[PreventExtensions\]\] as defined in [§ 3.9.5
        \[\[PreventExtensions\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-preventextensions).

    6.  Set `instance`.\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] as defined in [§ 3.9.6
        \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-ownpropertykeys).

14. Return `instance`.

</div>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="define the global property references">

To <span id="define-the-global-property-references"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">define the global
property references</span> on `target`, given <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⑥" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, perform the
following steps:

1.  Let `interfaces` be a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②③"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> that contains every
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that is
    <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`.

2.  Sort `interfaces` in such a way that if `A` and `B` are
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
    id="ref-for-list-item⑥" data-link-type="dfn">items</a> of
    `interfaces`, and `A`
    <a href="#dfn-inherit" id="ref-for-dfn-inherit①⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">inherits</a> from `B`, `A` has a higher index
    in `interfaces` than `B`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate①⑦" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
    `interface` of `interfaces`:

    1.  If `interface` is not declared with the
        \[<a href="#LegacyNoInterfaceObject"
        id="ref-for-LegacyNoInterfaceObject①③" data-link-type="idl"><code
        class="idl">LegacyNoInterfaceObject</code></a>\] or
        \[<a href="#LegacyNamespace" id="ref-for-LegacyNamespace⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyNamespace</code></a>\]
        <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">extended attributes</a>, then:

        1.  Let `id` be `interface`’s
            <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨⓪"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

        2.  Let `interfaceObject` be the result of
            <a href="#create-an-interface-object"
            id="ref-for-create-an-interface-object" data-link-type="dfn">creating an
            interface object</a> for `interface` with `id` in `realm`.

        3.  Perform <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
            id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty④"
            data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
            `id`, `interfaceObject`, false).

        4.  If the `interface` is declared with a
            \[<a href="#LegacyWindowAlias" id="ref-for-LegacyWindowAlias①④"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyWindowAlias</code></a>\]
            <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, and `target`
            implements the <a
            href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window"
            id="ref-for-window⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">Window</code></a>
            <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②③⑨"
            data-link-type="dfn">interface</a>, then:

            1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
                id="ref-for-list-iterate①⑧" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
                <a href="#legacywindowalias-identifier"
                id="ref-for-legacywindowalias-identifier⑤"
                data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` in
                \[<a href="#LegacyWindowAlias" id="ref-for-LegacyWindowAlias①⑤"
                data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyWindowAlias</code></a>\]'s
                <a href="#legacywindowalias-identifier"
                id="ref-for-legacywindowalias-identifier⑥"
                data-link-type="dfn">identifiers</a>:

                1.  Perform <a
                    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
                    id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty⑤"
                    data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
                    `id`, `interfaceObject`, false).

    2.  If the `interface` is declared with a
        \[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction①⑨"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]
        <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
            id="ref-for-list-iterate①⑨" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
            <a href="#legacyfactoryfunction-identifier"
            id="ref-for-legacyfactoryfunction-identifier⑤"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a> `id` in
            \[<a href="#LegacyFactoryFunction" id="ref-for-LegacyFactoryFunction②⓪"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyFactoryFunction</code></a>\]'s
            <a href="#legacyfactoryfunction-identifier"
            id="ref-for-legacyfactoryfunction-identifier⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifiers</a>:

            1.  Let `legacyFactoryFunction` be the result of
                <a href="#create-a-legacy-factory-function"
                id="ref-for-create-a-legacy-factory-function"
                data-link-type="dfn">creating a legacy factory function</a>
                with `id` for `interface` in `realm`.

            2.  Perform <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
                id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty⑥"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
                `id`, `legacyFactoryFunction`, false).

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate②⓪" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
    <a href="#dfn-callback-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-callback-interface③⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">callback interface</a> `interface` that is
    <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm` and on which
    <a href="#dfn-constant" id="ref-for-dfn-constant④①"
    data-link-type="dfn">constants</a> are defined:

    1.  Let `id` be `interface`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨①"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    2.  Let `interfaceObject` be the result of
        <a href="#create-a-legacy-callback-interface-object"
        id="ref-for-create-a-legacy-callback-interface-object"
        data-link-type="dfn">creating a legacy callback interface object</a>
        for `interface` with `id` in `realm`.

    3.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty⑦"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
        `id`, `interfaceObject`, false).

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ref-for-list-iterate②①" data-link-type="dfn">For every</a>
    <a href="#dfn-namespace" id="ref-for-dfn-namespace⑤①"
    data-link-type="dfn">namespace</a> `namespace` that is
    <a href="#dfn-exposed" id="ref-for-dfn-exposed①⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">exposed</a> in `realm`:

    1.  Let `id` be `namespace`’s
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨②"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>.

    2.  Let `namespaceObject` be the result of
        <a href="#create-a-namespace-object"
        id="ref-for-create-a-namespace-object" data-link-type="dfn">creating a
        namespace object</a> for `namespace` in `realm`.

    3.  Perform <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-definemethodproperty"
        id="ref-for-sec-definemethodproperty⑧"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">DefineMethodProperty</a>(`target`,
        `id`, `namespaceObject`, false).

</div>

<div class="note" role="note">

The set of interfaces that a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②④"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a>
<a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③②"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> does not change over the lifetime of
the object.

Multiple
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">platform objects</a> with different <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-global"
id="ref-for-concept-realm-global⑦" data-link-type="dfn">global
objects</a> will share a reference to the same
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> in their \[\[PrimaryInterface\]\]
internal slots. For example, a page could contain a same-origin iframe,
with the iframe’s method being called on the main page’s element of the
same kind, with no exception thrown.

<a href="#interface-mixin" id="ref-for-interface-mixin⑤①"
data-link-type="dfn">Interface mixins</a> do not participate directly in
the evaluation of the <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③③"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> algorithm. Instead, each
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④①"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that the
<a href="#interface-mixin" id="ref-for-interface-mixin⑤②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface mixin</a> is
<a href="#include" id="ref-for-include①②"
data-link-type="dfn">included</a> in has its own "copy" of each
<a href="#dfn-member" id="ref-for-dfn-member③⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">member</a> of the
<a href="#interface-mixin" id="ref-for-interface-mixin⑤③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface mixin</a>, and the corresponding
<a href="#dfn-create-operation-function"
id="ref-for-dfn-create-operation-function②"
data-link-type="dfn">operation function</a> checks that the receiver
<a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③④"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> the particular
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④②"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> which
<a href="#include" id="ref-for-include①③"
data-link-type="dfn">includes</a> the
<a href="#interface-mixin" id="ref-for-interface-mixin⑤④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface mixin</a>.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="primary interface">

The <span id="dfn-primary-interface" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">primary interface</span> of a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> is the value of the object’s
\[\[PrimaryInterface\]\] internal slot, which is the most-derived
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④③"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that it
<a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">implements</a>.

</div>

The <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⑦" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> that a given
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⑦"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> is associated with can
<span id="dfn-change-global-environment" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-for="realm" dfn-type="dfn" export="">change</span> after it has been
created. When the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⑧" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> associated with a
platform object is changed, its \[\[Prototype\]\] <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots"
id="ref-for-sec-object-internal-methods-and-internal-slots②①"
data-link-type="dfn">internal slot</a> must be immediately updated to be
the <a href="#dfn-interface-prototype-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-interface-prototype-object④⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface prototype object</a> of the
<a href="#dfn-primary-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-primary-interface"
data-link-type="dfn">primary interface</a> from the
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⑧"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a>’s newly associated <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm④⑨" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a>.

Additionally,
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object②⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">platform objects</a> which implement an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④④"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> which has a
\[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②④" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①④⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> get properties declaratively
from:

- [§ 3.7.8 Stringifiers](#js-stringifier),

- [§ 3.7.11 Maplike declarations](#js-maplike), and

- [§ 3.7.12 Setlike declarations](#js-setlike).

Define those properties imperatively instead.

#### <span class="secno">3.8.1. </span><span id="platformobjectsetprototypeof" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\]</span><a href="#platform-object-setprototypeof" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the internal [[SetPrototypeOf]] method of a platform object that implements an interface with [Global] extended attribute">

When the \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object③⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `O` that implements an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> with the
\[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②⑤" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤⓪"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> is called with JavaScript
language value `V`, the following step is taken:

1.  If `O`’s
    <a href="#dfn-associated-realm" id="ref-for-dfn-associated-realm①"
    data-link-type="dfn">associated realm</a>’s
    <a href="#realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable"
    id="ref-for-realm-is-global-prototype-chain-mutable②"
    data-link-type="dfn">is global prototype chain mutable</a> is true,
    return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②②" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarysetprototypeof"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarysetprototypeof①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinarySetPrototypeOf</a>(`O`, `V`).

2.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-set-immutable-prototype"
    id="ref-for-sec-set-immutable-prototype①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">SetImmutablePrototype</a>(`O`, `V`).

</div>

<span class="marker">Note:</span> For <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window"
id="ref-for-window⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Window</code></a> objects, it is unobservable whether this
is implemented, since the presence of the <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#windowproxy"
id="ref-for-windowproxy" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">WindowProxy</code></a> object ensures that
\[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] is never called on a <a
href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#window"
id="ref-for-window⑧" data-link-type="idl"><code
class="idl">Window</code></a> object directly. For other global objects,
however, this is necessary.

### <span class="secno">3.9. </span><span id="indexed-and-named-properties" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="es-legacy-platform-objects" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Legacy platform objects</span><a href="#js-legacy-platform-objects" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object③" data-link-type="dfn">Legacy
platform objects</a> will appear to have additional properties that
correspond to their
<a href="#idl-indexed-properties" id="ref-for-idl-indexed-properties①"
data-link-type="dfn">indexed</a> and
<a href="#idl-named-properties" id="ref-for-idl-named-properties②"
data-link-type="dfn">named properties</a>. These properties are not
“real” own properties on the object, but are made to look like they are
by being exposed by the <a href="#legacy-platform-object-getownproperty"
id="ref-for-legacy-platform-object-getownproperty②">[[GetOwnProperty]]
internal method</a> .

It is permissible for an object to implement multiple interfaces that
support indexed properties. However, if so, and there are conflicting
definitions as to the object’s <a href="#dfn-supported-property-indices"
id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-indices③"
data-link-type="dfn">supported property indices</a>, then it is
undefined what additional properties the object will appear to have, or
what its exact behavior will be with regard to its indexed properties.
The same applies for named properties.

The <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-getter"
id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-getter⑨" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
property getter</a> that is defined on the derived-most interface that
the legacy platform object implements is the one that defines the
behavior when indexing the object with an <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#array-index"
id="ref-for-array-index" data-link-type="dfn">array index</a>. Similarly
for <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-setter"
id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-setter③" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
property setters</a>. This way, the definitions of these special
operations from ancestor interfaces can be overridden.

A property name is an <span id="dfn-unforgeable-property-name"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn" export="">unforgeable property
name</span> on a given platform object `O` if the object implements an
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⑥"
data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> that has an
<a href="#dfn-interface-member" id="ref-for-dfn-interface-member②⑤"
data-link-type="dfn">interface member</a> with that identifier and that
interface member is <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface"
id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-on-an-interface①①"
data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable</a> on any of the interfaces that `O`
implements.

Support for <a href="#dfn-getter" id="ref-for-dfn-getter"
data-link-type="dfn">getters</a> is handled in
<a href="#legacy-platform-object-getownproperty"
id="ref-for-legacy-platform-object-getownproperty③">§ 3.9.1
[[GetOwnProperty]]</a>, and for
<a href="#dfn-setter" id="ref-for-dfn-setter"
data-link-type="dfn">setters</a> in [§ 3.9.3
\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-defineownproperty)
and [§ 3.9.2 \[\[Set\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-set).

Additionally, <a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object④" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform objects</a> have internal methods as defined in:

- [§ 3.9.4 \[\[Delete\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-delete),

- [§ 3.9.5
  \[\[PreventExtensions\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-preventextensions),
  and

- [§ 3.9.6
  \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]](#legacy-platform-object-ownpropertykeys).

#### <span class="secno">3.9.1. </span><span id="getownproperty" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-getownproperty"
id="ref-for-legacy-platform-object-getownproperty④"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[GetOwnProperty]] internal method of legacy platform objects">

The \[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] internal method of every
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object⑤" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> `O` must behave as follows when called with property
name `P`:

1.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②④" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a href="#LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty"
    id="ref-for-LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty</a>(`O`,
    `P`, false).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.2. </span><span id="platformobjectset" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[Set\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-set" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[Set]] internal method of legacy platform objects">

The \[\[Set\]\] internal method of every
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object⑥" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> `O` must behave as follows when called with property
name `P`, value `V`, and JavaScript language value `Receiver`:

1.  If `O` and `Receiver` are the same object, then:

    1.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⑥"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with an
        <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-setter"
        id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-setter④" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
        property setter</a> and `P`
        <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index"
        data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

        1.  <a href="#invoke-indexed-setter" id="ref-for-invoke-indexed-setter"
            data-link-type="dfn">Invoke the indexed property setter</a>
            on `O` with `P` and `V`.

        2.  Return true.

    2.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with a
        <a href="#dfn-named-property-setter"
        id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-setter③" data-link-type="dfn">named
        property setter</a> and `P` <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type"
        id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type③"
        data-link-type="dfn">is a String</a>, then:

        1.  <a href="#invoke-named-setter" id="ref-for-invoke-named-setter"
            data-link-type="dfn">Invoke the named property setter</a> on
            `O` with `P` and `V`.

        2.  Return true.

2.  Let `ownDesc` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a href="#LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty"
    id="ref-for-LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty</a>(`O`,
    `P`, true).

3.  Perform
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⑥" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarysetwithowndescriptor"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarysetwithowndescriptor"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinarySetWithOwnDescriptor</a>(`O`,
    `P`, `V`, `Receiver`, `ownDesc`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.3. </span><span id="defineownproperty" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-defineownproperty"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[DefineOwnProperty]] internal method of legacy platform objects">

When the \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object⑦" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> `O` is called with property key `P` and <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
id="ref-for-sec-property-descriptor-specification-type①"
data-link-type="dfn">Property Descriptor</a> `Desc`, the following steps
must be taken:

1.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties①①"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports indexed properties</a> and `P`
    <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index①"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  If the result of calling <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-isdatadescriptor"
        id="ref-for-sec-isdatadescriptor"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDataDescriptor</a>(`Desc`) is
        false, then return false.

    2.  If `O` does not implement an interface with an
        <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-setter"
        id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-setter⑤" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
        property setter</a>, then return false.

    3.  <a href="#invoke-indexed-setter" id="ref-for-invoke-indexed-setter①"
        data-link-type="dfn">Invoke the indexed property setter</a> on
        `O` with `P` and `Desc`.\[\[Value\]\].

    4.  Return true.

2.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties⑦" data-link-type="dfn">supports
    named properties</a>, `O` does not implement an
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②⑥" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤①"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, `P` <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type④"
    data-link-type="dfn">is a String</a>, and `P` is not an
    <a href="#dfn-unforgeable-property-name"
    id="ref-for-dfn-unforgeable-property-name"
    data-link-type="dfn">unforgeable property name</a> of `O`, then:

    1.  Let `creating` be true if `P` is not a
        <a href="#dfn-supported-property-names"
        id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-names③"
        data-link-type="dfn">supported property name</a>, and false
        otherwise.

    2.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with the
        \[<a href="#LegacyOverrideBuiltIns" id="ref-for-LegacyOverrideBuiltIns⑧"
        data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyOverrideBuiltIns</code></a>\]
        <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤②"
        data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> or `O` does not have
        an own property named `P`, then:

        1.  If `creating` is false and `O` does not implement an
            interface with a <a href="#dfn-named-property-setter"
            id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-setter④" data-link-type="dfn">named
            property setter</a>, then return false.

        2.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements③⑨"
            data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with a
            <a href="#dfn-named-property-setter"
            id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-setter⑤" data-link-type="dfn">named
            property setter</a>, then:

            1.  If the result of calling <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-isdatadescriptor"
                id="ref-for-sec-isdatadescriptor①"
                data-link-type="abstract-op">IsDataDescriptor</a>(`Desc`)
                is false, then return false.

            2.  <a href="#invoke-named-setter" id="ref-for-invoke-named-setter①"
                data-link-type="dfn">Invoke the named property setter</a>
                on `O` with `P` and `Desc`.\[\[Value\]\].

            3.  Return true.

3.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⑦" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarydefineownproperty"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarydefineownproperty"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryDefineOwnProperty</a>(`O`, `P`,
    `Desc`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.4. </span><span id="delete" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[Delete\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-delete" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the [[Delete]] internal method of legacy platform objects">

The \[\[Delete\]\] internal method of every
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object⑧" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> `O` must behave as follows when called with property
name `P`.

1.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties①②"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports indexed properties</a> and `P`
    <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index②"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  Let `index` be the result of calling
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⑧" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-touint32"
        id="ref-for-sec-touint32②" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

    2.  If `index` is not a <a href="#dfn-supported-property-indices"
        id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-indices④"
        data-link-type="dfn">supported property index</a>, then return
        true.

    3.  Return false.

2.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties⑧" data-link-type="dfn">supports
    named properties</a>, `O` does not implement an
    <a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">interface</a> with the
    \[<a href="#Global" id="ref-for-Global②⑦" data-link-type="idl"><code
    class="idl">Global</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤③"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> and the result of
    calling the <a href="#dfn-named-property-visibility"
    id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-visibility①" data-link-type="dfn">named
    property visibility algorithm</a> with property name `P` and object
    `O` is true, then:

    1.  If `O` does not implement an interface with a
        <a href="#dfn-named-property-deleter"
        id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-deleter④" data-link-type="dfn">named
        property deleter</a>, then return false.

    2.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the named
        property deleter.

    3.  If `operation` was defined without an
        <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨③"
        data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then:

        1.  Perform the steps listed in the interface description to
            <a href="#dfn-delete-an-existing-named-property"
            id="ref-for-dfn-delete-an-existing-named-property"
            data-link-type="dfn">delete an existing named property</a>
            with `P` as the name.

        2.  If the steps indicated that the deletion failed, then return
            false.

    4.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier:

        1.  Perform <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps⑧"
            data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation` with
            `O` as
            <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this③⑨" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
            and « `P` » as the argument values.

        2.  If `operation` was declared with a
            <a href="#dfn-return-type" id="ref-for-dfn-return-type⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">return type</a> of
            <a href="#idl-boolean" id="ref-for-idl-boolean②②"
            data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">boolean</code></a>
            and the steps returned false, then return false.

    5.  Return true.

3.  If `O` has an own property with name `P`, then:

    1.  If the property is not configurable, then return false.

    2.  Otherwise, remove the property from `O`.

4.  Return true.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.5. </span><span id="preventextensions" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[PreventExtensions\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-preventextensions"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the internal [[PreventExtensions]] method of legacy platform objects">

When the \[\[PreventExtensions\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object⑨" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> is called, the following steps are taken:

1.  Return false.

<span class="marker">Note:</span> this keeps
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object①⓪" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform objects</a> extensible by making \[\[PreventExtensions\]\] fail
for them.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.6. </span><span id="legacy-platform-object-property-enumeration" class="bs-old-id"></span><span id="property-enumeration" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-ownpropertykeys" class="self-link"></a>

This document does not define a complete property enumeration order for
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object③①"
data-link-type="dfn">platform objects</a> implementing
<a href="#dfn-interface" id="ref-for-dfn-interface②④⑨"
data-link-type="dfn">interfaces</a> (or for
<a href="#js-exception-objects"
id="ref-for-js-exception-objects">platform objects representing
exceptions</a>). However, it does for
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object①①" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform objects</a> by defining the \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] internal
method as follows.

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to invoke the internal [[OwnPropertyKeys]] method of legacy platform objects">

When the \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] internal method of a
<a href="#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="ref-for-dfn-legacy-platform-object①②" data-link-type="dfn">legacy
platform object</a> `O` is called, the following steps are taken:

1.  Let `keys` be a new empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②④"
    data-link-type="dfn">list</a> of JavaScript String and Symbol
    values.

2.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties①③"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports indexed properties</a>, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">for each</a> `index` of `O`’s
    <a href="#dfn-supported-property-indices"
    id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-indices⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">supported property indices</a>, in ascending
    numerical order,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">append</a>
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①②⑨" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-tostring"
    id="ref-for-sec-tostring⑦" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToString</a>(`index`)
    to `keys`.

3.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties⑨" data-link-type="dfn">supports
    named properties</a>, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⑦"
    data-link-type="dfn">for each</a> `P` of `O`’s
    <a href="#dfn-supported-property-names"
    id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-names④"
    data-link-type="dfn">supported property names</a> that is visible
    according to the <a href="#dfn-named-property-visibility"
    id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-visibility②" data-link-type="dfn">named
    property visibility algorithm</a>,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⑧"
    data-link-type="dfn">append</a> `P` to `keys`.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list②⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `P` of `O`’s own property keys
    that is a String, in ascending chronological order of property
    creation,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list③⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">append</a> `P` to `keys`.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list③①"
    data-link-type="dfn">For each</a> `P` of `O`’s own property keys
    that is a Symbol, in ascending chronological order of property
    creation,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="ref-for-list③②"
    data-link-type="dfn">append</a> `P` to `keys`.

6.  Assert: `keys` has no duplicate items.

7.  Return `keys`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.9.7. </span><span class="content">Abstract operations</span><a href="#legacy-platform-object-abstract-ops" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="to determine if a property name is an array index">

To determine if a property name `P` <span id="is-an-array-index"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
lt="is an array index|is not an array index"
noexport=""><span id="dfn-array-index-property-name"
class="bs-old-id"></span>is an <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#array-index"
id="ref-for-array-index①" data-link-type="dfn">array index</a></span>,
the following algorithm is applied:

1.  If `P` <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type"
    id="ref-for-sec-ecmascript-language-types-string-type⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn" data-refhint-key="da7b0a98">is not a String</a>,
    then return false.

2.  Let `index` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-canonicalnumericindexstring"
    id="ref-for-sec-canonicalnumericindexstring"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CanonicalNumericIndexString</a>(`P`).

3.  If `index` is undefined, then return false.

4.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isinteger"
    id="ref-for-sec-isinteger" data-link-type="abstract-op">IsInteger</a>(`index`)
    is false, then return false.

5.  If `index` is −0, then return false.

6.  If `index` \< 0, then return false.

7.  If `index` ≥ 2<sup>32</sup> − 1, then return false.

    <span class="marker">Note:</span> 2<sup>32</sup> − 1 is the maximum
    array length allowed by JavaScript.

8.  Return true.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="named property visibility algorithm">

The <span id="dfn-named-property-visibility" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export="">named property visibility algorithm</span> is
used to determine if a given named property is exposed on an object.
Some named properties are not exposed on an object depending on whether
the
\[<a href="#LegacyOverrideBuiltIns" id="ref-for-LegacyOverrideBuiltIns⑨"
data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyOverrideBuiltIns</code></a>\]
<a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤④"
data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a> was used. The algorithm
operates as follows, with property name `P` and object `O`:

1.  If `P` is not a <a href="#dfn-supported-property-names"
    id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-names⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">supported property name</a> of `O`, then return
    false.

2.  If `O` has an own property named `P`, then return false.

    <span class="marker">Note:</span> This will include cases in which
    `O` has unforgeable properties, because in practice those are always
    set up before objects have any supported property names, and once
    set up will make the corresponding named properties invisible.

3.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements④⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface that has the
    \[<a href="#LegacyOverrideBuiltIns" id="ref-for-LegacyOverrideBuiltIns①⓪"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyOverrideBuiltIns</code></a>\]
    <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then return true.

4.  Let `prototype` be `O`.\[\[GetPrototypeOf\]\]().

5.  While `prototype` is not null:

    1.  If `prototype` is not a <a href="#dfn-named-properties-object"
        id="ref-for-dfn-named-properties-object①②" data-link-type="dfn">named
        properties object</a>, and `prototype` has an own property named
        `P`, then return false.

    2.  Set `prototype` to `prototype`.\[\[GetPrototypeOf\]\]().

6.  Return true.

</div>

<div class="note" role="note">

This ensures that for objects with named properties, property resolution
is done in the following order:

1.  Indexed properties.

2.  Own properties, including unforgeable attributes and operations.

3.  Then, if
    \[<a href="#LegacyOverrideBuiltIns" id="ref-for-LegacyOverrideBuiltIns①①"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyOverrideBuiltIns</code></a>\]:

    1.  Named properties.

    2.  Properties from the prototype chain.

4.  Otherwise, if not
    \[<a href="#LegacyOverrideBuiltIns" id="ref-for-LegacyOverrideBuiltIns①②"
    data-link-type="idl"><code class="idl">LegacyOverrideBuiltIns</code></a>\]:

    1.  Properties from the prototype chain.

    2.  Named properties.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="invoke the indexed property setter">

To <span id="invoke-indexed-setter" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" export=""
lt="invoke the indexed property setter"><span id="invoking-indexed-setter"
class="bs-old-id"></span>invoke an indexed property setter</span> on a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object③②"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `O` with property name `P` and
JavaScript value `V`, the following steps must be performed:

1.  Let `index` be the result of calling
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①③⓪" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-touint32"
    id="ref-for-sec-touint32③" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

2.  Let `creating` be true if `index` is not a
    <a href="#dfn-supported-property-indices"
    id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-indices⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">supported property index</a>, and false
    otherwise.

3.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the indexed
    property setter.

4.  Let `T` be the type of the second argument of `operation`.

5.  Let `value` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑧④"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value of type `T`.

6.  If `operation` was defined without an
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨④"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then:

    1.  If `creating` is true, then perform the steps listed in the
        interface description to
        <a href="#dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property"
        id="ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property"
        data-link-type="dfn">set the value of a new indexed property</a>
        with `index` as the index and `value` as the value.

    2.  Otherwise, `creating` is false. Perform the steps listed in the
        interface description to
        <a href="#dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property"
        id="ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property"
        data-link-type="dfn">set the value of an existing indexed property</a>
        with `index` as the index and `value` as the value.

7.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier. Perform the
    <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps⑨"
    data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation` with `O` as
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this④⓪" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
    and « `index`, `value` » as the argument values.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="invoke the named property setter">

To <span id="invoke-named-setter" class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
export=""
lt="invoke the named property setter"><span id="invoking-named-setter"
class="bs-old-id"></span>invoke a named property setter</span> on a
<a href="#dfn-platform-object" id="ref-for-dfn-platform-object③③"
data-link-type="dfn">platform object</a> `O` with property name `P` and
JavaScript value `V`, the following steps must be performed:

1.  Let `creating` be true if `P` is not a
    <a href="#dfn-supported-property-names"
    id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-names⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">supported property name</a>, and false
    otherwise.

2.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the named property
    setter.

3.  Let `T` be the type of the second argument of `operation`.

4.  Let `value` be the result of
    <a href="#dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value"
    id="ref-for-dfn-convert-ecmascript-to-idl-value⑧⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `V` to an IDL value of type `T`.

5.  If `operation` was defined without an
    <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then:

    1.  If `creating` is true, then perform the steps listed in the
        interface description to
        <a href="#dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-named-property"
        id="ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-named-property"
        data-link-type="dfn">set the value of a new named property</a>
        with `P` as the name and `value` as the value.

    2.  Otherwise, `creating` is false. Perform the steps listed in the
        interface description to
        <a href="#dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-named-property"
        id="ref-for-dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-named-property"
        data-link-type="dfn">set the value of an existing named property</a>
        with `P` as the name and `value` as the value.

6.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier. Perform the
    <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation` with `O` as
    <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this④①" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
    and « `P`, `value` » as the argument values.

</div>

<div class="algorithm" algorithm="LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty">

The <span id="LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="abstract-op"
export=""><span id="getownproperty-guts"
class="bs-old-id"></span>LegacyPlatformObjectGetOwnProperty</span>
abstract operation performs the following steps when called with an
object `O`, a property name `P`, and a boolean `ignoreNamedProps` value:

1.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-indexed-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-indexed-properties①④"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports indexed properties</a> and `P`
    <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index③"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  Let `index` be the result of calling
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①③①" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-touint32"
        id="ref-for-sec-touint32④" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

    2.  If `index` is a <a href="#dfn-supported-property-indices"
        id="ref-for-dfn-supported-property-indices⑦"
        data-link-type="dfn">supported property index</a>, then:

        1.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the indexed
            property getter.

        2.  Let `value` be an uninitialized variable.

        3.  If `operation` was defined without an
            <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then set `value` to the
            result of performing the steps listed in the interface
            description to
            <a href="#dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property"
            id="ref-for-dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property"
            data-link-type="dfn">determine the value of an indexed property</a>
            with `index` as the index.

        4.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier. Set
            `value` to the result of performing the
            <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps①①"
            data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation` with
            `O` as
            <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this④②" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
            and « `index` » as the argument values.

        5.  Let `desc` be a newly created <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
            id="ref-for-sec-property-descriptor-specification-type②"
            data-link-type="dfn">Property Descriptor</a> with no fields.

        6.  Set `desc`.\[\[Value\]\] to the result of
            <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `value` to a JavaScript
            value.

        7.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements④①"
            data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with an
            <a href="#dfn-indexed-property-setter"
            id="ref-for-dfn-indexed-property-setter⑥" data-link-type="dfn">indexed
            property setter</a>, then set `desc`.\[\[Writable\]\] to
            true, otherwise set it to false.

        8.  Set `desc`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] and
            `desc`.\[\[Configurable\]\] to true.

        9.  Return `desc`.

    3.  Set `ignoreNamedProps` to true.

2.  If `O` <a href="#dfn-support-named-properties"
    id="ref-for-dfn-support-named-properties①⓪"
    data-link-type="dfn">supports named properties</a> and
    `ignoreNamedProps` is false, then:

    1.  If the result of running the
        <a href="#dfn-named-property-visibility"
        id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-visibility③" data-link-type="dfn">named
        property visibility algorithm</a> with property name `P` and
        object `O` is true, then:

        1.  Let `operation` be the operation used to declare the named
            property getter.

        2.  Let `value` be an uninitialized variable.

        3.  If `operation` was defined without an
            <a href="#dfn-identifier" id="ref-for-dfn-identifier⑨⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">identifier</a>, then set `value` to the
            result of performing the steps listed in the interface
            description to
            <a href="#dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property"
            id="ref-for-dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property①"
            data-link-type="dfn">determine the value of a named property</a>
            with `P` as the name.

        4.  Otherwise, `operation` was defined with an identifier. Set
            `value` to the result of performing the
            <a href="#method-steps" id="ref-for-method-steps①②"
            data-link-type="dfn">method steps</a> of `operation` with
            `O` as
            <a href="#this" id="ref-for-this④③" data-link-type="dfn">this</a>
            and « `P` » as the argument values.

        5.  Let `desc` be a newly created <a
            href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
            id="ref-for-sec-property-descriptor-specification-type③"
            data-link-type="dfn">Property Descriptor</a> with no fields.

        6.  Set `desc`.\[\[Value\]\] to the result of
            <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
            id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦⑦"
            data-link-type="dfn">converting</a> `value` to a JavaScript
            value.

        7.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements④②"
            data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with a
            <a href="#dfn-named-property-setter"
            id="ref-for-dfn-named-property-setter⑥" data-link-type="dfn">named
            property setter</a>, then set `desc`.\[\[Writable\]\] to
            true, otherwise set it to false.

        8.  If `O` <a href="#implements" id="ref-for-implements④③"
            data-link-type="dfn">implements</a> an interface with the
            \[<a href="#LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties"
            id="ref-for-LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties⑤"
            data-link-type="idl"><code
            class="idl">LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties</code></a>\]
            <a href="#dfn-extended-attribute" id="ref-for-dfn-extended-attribute①⑤⑥"
            data-link-type="dfn">extended attribute</a>, then set
            `desc`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] to false, otherwise set it to
            true.

        9.  Set `desc`.\[\[Configurable\]\] to true.

        10. Return `desc`.

3.  Return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinarygetownproperty"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinarygetownproperty①"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryGetOwnProperty</a>(`O`, `P`).

</div>

### <span class="secno">3.10. </span><span id="es-observable-arrays" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">Observable array exotic objects</span><a href="#js-observable-arrays" class="self-link"></a>

An <span id="observable-array-exotic-object" class="dfn dfn-paneled"
dfn-type="dfn" noexport="">observable array exotic object</span> is a
specific type of JavaScript <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#proxy-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-proxy-exotic-object" data-link-type="dfn">Proxy exotic
object</a> which is created using the proxy traps defined in this
section. They are defined in this manner because the JavaScript
specification includes special treatment for <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#proxy-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-proxy-exotic-object①" data-link-type="dfn">Proxy exotic
objects</a> that have `Array` instances as their proxy target, and we
want to ensure that <a href="#dfn-observable-array-type"
id="ref-for-dfn-observable-array-type⑦" data-link-type="dfn">observable
array types</a> are exposed to JavaScript code with this special
treatment intact.

The proxy traps used by observable array exotic objects work to ensure a
number of invariants beyond those of normal `Array` instances:

- The arrays have no holes, i.e. every property in the inclusive range 0
  through `observableArray.length` − 1 will be filled with a value
  compatible with the specified Web IDL type, and no <a
  href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#array-index"
  id="ref-for-array-index②" data-link-type="dfn">array index</a>
  properties will exist outside that range.

- The property descriptors for important properties cannot be changed
  from their default configuration; indexed properties always remain as
  configurable, enumerable, and writable data properties, while the
  `length` property remains as a non-configurable, non-enumerable, and
  writable data property.

- Adding additional properties to the array cannot be prevented using,
  for example, `Object.preventExtensions()`.

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="creating an observable array exotic object">

To <span id="creating-an-observable-array-exotic-object"
class="dfn dfn-paneled" dfn-type="dfn"
lt="creating an observable array exotic object" noexport="">create an
observable array exotic object</span> in a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/executable-code-and-execution-contexts.html#realm"
id="ref-for-realm⑤⓪" data-link-type="dfn">realm</a> `realm`, given Web
IDL type `T` and algorithms `setAlgorithm` and `deleteAlgorithm`:

1.  Let `innerArray` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①③②" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a

2.  Let `handler` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ordinary-and-exotic-objects-behaviours.html#sec-ordinaryobjectcreate"
    id="ref-for-sec-ordinaryobjectcreate⑦"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">OrdinaryObjectCreate</a>(null, «
    \[\[Type\]\], \[\[SetAlgorithm\]\], \[\[DeleteAlgorithm\]\],
    \[\[BackingList\]\] »).

3.  Set `handler`.\[\[Type\]\] to `T`.

4.  Set `handler`.\[\[SetAlgorithm\]\] to `setAlgorithm`.

5.  Set `handler`.\[\[DeleteAlgorithm\]\] to `deleteAlgorithm`.

6.  Let `defineProperty` be <a

8.  Let `deleteProperty` be <a

9.  Perform

10. Let `get` be <a

    id="ref-for-sec-createbuiltinfunction②③"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">CreateBuiltinFunction</a>(the steps
    from [§ 3.10.3 get](#js-observable-array-get), 3, "", « », `realm`).

11. Perform

#### <span class="secno">3.10.1. </span><span id="es-observable-array-defineProperty" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">`defineProperty`</span><a href="#js-observable-array-defineProperty" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="observable array exotic object defineProperty trap">

The steps for the `defineProperty` proxy trap for
<a href="#observable-array-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object①"
data-link-type="dfn">observable array exotic objects</a>, given `O`,
`P`, and `descriptorObj` are as follows:

1.  Let `handler` be the this value.

2.  Let `descriptor` be
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④②" data-link-type="dfn"
    data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-topropertydescriptor"
    id="ref-for-sec-topropertydescriptor"
    data-link-type="abstract-op">ToPropertyDescriptor</a>(`descriptorObj`).

3.  If `P` is "length", then:

    1.  If <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-isaccessordescriptor"
        id="ref-for-sec-isaccessordescriptor"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">IsAccessorDescriptor</a>(`descriptor`)
        is true, then return false.

    2.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Configurable\]\] is present and has the
        value true, then return false.

    3.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] is present and has the value
        true, then return false.

    4.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Writable\]\] is present and has the value
        false, then return false.

    5.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Value\]\] is present, then return the result
        of <a href="#observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-length"
        id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-length①"
        data-link-type="dfn">setting the length</a> given `handler` and
        `descriptor`.\[\[Value\]\].

    6.  Return true.

4.  If `P` <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index④"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  If <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/ecmascript-data-types-and-values.html#sec-isaccessordescriptor"
        id="ref-for-sec-isaccessordescriptor①"
        data-link-type="abstract-op">IsAccessorDescriptor</a>(`descriptor`)
        is true, then return false.

    2.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Configurable\]\] is present and has the
        value false, then return false.

    3.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Enumerable\]\] is present and has the value
        false, then return false.

    4.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Writable\]\] is present and has the value
        false, then return false.

    5.  If `descriptor`.\[\[Value\]\] is present, then return the result
        of
        <a href="#observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-indexed-value"
        id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object-set-the-indexed-value"
        data-link-type="dfn">setting the indexed value</a> given
        `handler`, `P`, and `descriptor`.\[\[Value\]\].

    6.  Return true.

5.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④③" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    `O`.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\](`P`, `descriptor`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.10.2. </span><span id="es-observable-array-deleteProperty" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">`deleteProperty`</span><a href="#js-observable-array-deleteProperty" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="observable array exotic object deleteProperty trap">

The steps for the `deleteProperty` proxy trap for
<a href="#observable-array-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object②"
data-link-type="dfn">observable array exotic objects</a>, given `O` and
`P`, are as follows:

1.  Let `handler` be the this value.

2.  If `P` is "length", then return false.

3.  If `P` <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index⑤"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  Let `oldLen` be `handler`.\[\[BackingList\]\]'s
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="ref-for-list-size①③" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>.

    2.  Let `index` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④④" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-touint32"
        id="ref-for-sec-touint32⑤" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

    3.  If `index` ≠ `oldLen` − 1, then return false.

    4.  Perform the algorithm steps given by
        `handler`.\[\[DeleteAlgorithm\]\], given
        `handler`.\[\[BackingList\]\]\[`index`\] and `index`.

    5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
        id="ref-for-list-remove③" data-link-type="dfn">Remove</a> the
        last item from `handler`.\[\[BackingList\]\].

    6.  Return true.

4.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④⑤" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    `O`.\[\[Delete\]\](`P`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">3.10.3. </span><span id="es-observable-array-get" class="bs-old-id"></span><span class="content">`get`</span><a href="#js-observable-array-get" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="algorithm"
algorithm="observable array exotic object get trap">

The steps for the `get` proxy trap for
<a href="#observable-array-exotic-object"
id="ref-for-observable-array-exotic-object③"
data-link-type="dfn">observable array exotic objects</a>, given `O`,
`P`, and `Receiver`, are as follows:

1.  Let `handler` be the this value.

2.  Let `length` be `handler`.\[\[BackingList\]\]'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="ref-for-list-size①④" data-link-type="dfn">size</a>.

3.  If `P` is "length", then return `length`.

4.  If `P` <a href="#is-an-array-index" id="ref-for-is-an-array-index⑥"
    data-link-type="dfn">is an array index</a>, then:

    1.  Let `index` be
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
        id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④⑥" data-link-type="dfn"
        data-refhint-key="548dbb6b">!</a> <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/abstract-operations.html#sec-touint32"
        id="ref-for-sec-touint32⑥" data-link-type="abstract-op">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

    2.  If `index` ≥ `length`, then return undefined.

    3.  Let `jsValue` be the result of
        <a href="#dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value"
        id="ref-for-dfn-convert-idl-to-javascript-value⑦⑧"
        data-link-type="dfn">converting</a>
        `handler`.\[\[BackingList\]\]\[`index`\] to a JavaScript value.

    4.  Assert: the above step never throws an exception.

    5.  Return `jsValue`.

5.  Return
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands"
    id="ref-for-sec-returnifabrupt-shorthands①④⑦" data-link-type="dfn">?</a>
    `O`.\[\[Get\]\](`P`, `Receiver`).

</div>
